recipes.Blurb: You can make and chill ahead of time.  When ready to serve, spoon on the sauce and bake.
recipes.Ingredients:
½  lb. Skinless, boneless chicken breasts
2 tbsp. All-purpose flour
4 cups torn fresh spinach or 1/2 of one 10 pkg. Frozen chopped spinach, thawed and well-drained.
¼ tsp. Ground cumin
¼ cup thinly sliced green onion
1  8-oz. Carton light dairy sour cream
¼ cup plain fat-free yogurt.
⅓ cup shredded reduced-fat cheddar or Monterey Jack cheese (1 1/2 oz.)
¼ tsp. Salt
½ cup skim milk
6  7-inch flour tortillas
1  4-oz. can diced green Chile peppers, drained.
Thinly sliced green onion (optional)
Chopped tomato or salsa (optional)
recipes.Procedure: In a 3-qt. Saucepan, place chicken in enough water to cover.  Bring to boiling; reduce heat.  Cover; simmer about 15 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink.  Remove chicken from saucepan.    When cool enough to handle, use a fork to shred chicken into bite-sized pieces.  (You should have about 1½ cups.)  Set aside.  If using fresh spinach, place spinach in a In steamer basket over boiling water.  Reduce heat.  Steam, covered, for 3 to 5 minutes or until tender.  (Or, cook in a small amount of boiling water, covered, for 3 to 5 minutes.) Drain well.  In a large bowl, combine chicken, spinach and green onion; set aside.  In a bowl combine sour cream, yogurt, flour, cumin and salt.  Stir in milk and chile peppers.  Divide sauce in half.  Set one portion aside.  For filling, combine one portion of the sauce and the chicken-spinach mixture.  Divide the filling among the tortillas.  Roll up tortillas.  Place, seam-side down, in an ungreased 2-qt  rectangular baking dish.  (At this point, you can cover baking dish and chill for up to 2 hours.  Store the reserved sauce separately and chill.)  When ready to bake, spoon reserved portion of sauce over tortillas.  Bake, uncovered, in a 350º  about 25 minutes, or until heated through (add 10 to 15 minutes to cooking time if prepared ahead and chilled).  Sprinkle with cheese; let stand 5 minutes.  Transfer to a serving platter.  To serve, garnish with chopped tomato or salsa and additional green onion.  Makes 6 enchiladas.

recipes.Blurb: This is the best cake in the world.  I like it with a rum sauce, but whatever you do (or don't) put on it, DON'T FROST IT!
recipes.Author: Unknown
recipes.Ingredients:
1 pkg. Yellow cake mix (about 1 lb. 3 oz.)
1 pkg. Vanilla instant pudding (4 oz.)*
4  eggs, unbeaten
¾ cup salad oil
¾ cup sherry
1 tsp. nutmeg
recipes.Procedure:
Beat all ingredients together for 5 minutes at medium speed.  Pour into greased 10-inch tube pan or mold and bake for 45 min. at 350.  Frost with confectioner's sugar if you wish.

* If using yellow cake mix with pudding already in the mix, omit instant pudding and use 3 eggs instead of 4; 4oz. plus 1 Tbsp. salad oil instead of 3/4 cup.

recipes.Blurb: This one came off the back of a grocery receipt!
recipes.Ingredients:
⅓ cup honey
¼ cup lemon juice
2 tsp. rosemary leaves, crushed
¼ tsp. crushed red pepper (optional)
6  chicken breast halves
recipes.Procedure: Preheat oven to 350.  In a small bowl, combine all ingredients except chicken.  Place chicken in 13x9 in. baking dish.  Brush sauce over chicken.  Bake 1 hour or until tender, brushing occasionally with sauce.  Refrigerator leftover chicken.

recipes.Blurb: Contributer Jim Dwyer says he grandmother always served this topped with heart-shaped biscuits.
recipes.Ingredients:
1 lb. skinless, boneless chicken thighs or breasts, cut into 1-in. pieces.
1  large yellow onion, cut into 1-inch chunks
8 oz. fresh mushrooms, quartered
1 cup low-sodium chicken broth
3  cloves garlic, minced
1 tsp. dried rosemary leaves
¼ tsp. each salt and black pepper
2 tbsp. cornstarch mixed with 1/4 cup cold water
1 cup fresh or frozen peas
1  jar (4 oz) sliced pimentoes
**For Biscuits**
½ cup low fat buttermilk or soured milk
½ tsp. dried minced onion or minced onion
1 cup all-purpose flour
1 tsp. baking powder
¼ tsp. baking soda
⅛ tsp. salt
3 tbsp. butter or margarine
recipes.Procedure:
1. Preheat oven to 375.  In a large saucepan, combine the chicken, onion chunks, mushrooms, broth, garlic, rosemary, the 1/4 tsp salt and the pepper.  Bring to a boil.  Lower the heat and simmer, uncovered, for 3 minutes.  Stir in cornstarch mixture.  Cook for 2 minutes.  Stir in the peas and pimientos; set aside.
2. To prepare biscuits, combine buttermilk and dried onion; set aside.  In a large bowl, stir together the flour, baking powder, baking soda and the 1/8 tsp salt.  Using a pastry blender, cut in butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Stir in buttermilk mixture just until combined.
3.  On a lightly floured surface, pat dough into a 9-inch circle.  Using a 2-inch cutter, cut 9 biscuits.  Bring chicken mixture to a boil; transfer to 2-quart casserole.  Arrange biscuits on top.  Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until chicken in cooked through and biscuits are golden.

recipes.Blurb: Better Homes and Gardens prize winner, October 1996
recipes.Author: Xan Pilgrim
recipes.Ingredients:
¼ cup snipped fresh basil
1 tbsp. snipped Italian parsley
1  10-oz. container refrigerated light alfredo sauce
¼ cup oil-packed dried tomatoes, drained and thinly sliced
⅓ cup milk
½ cup grated Parmesan
¼ tsp. pepper
Fresh basil (optional)
8 oz. pasta (such as linguine, bow ties, penne or rotelle)
2  shallots, chopped
1  clove garlic, minced
1  Tbsp. olive oil
12 oz. skinless, boneless chicken breast halve, cut into bite-sized pieces
¼ cup dry white wine or chicken broth
recipes.Procedure: Cook pasta according to package instructions; drain.  Meanwhile, in a large skillet cook shallots and garlic in hot oil over medium-high heat for 30 seconds.  Add chicken.  Cook and stir for 3 to 4 minutes, or until no pink remains in chicken.  Drain off fat.  Carefully add wine or broth, basil and parsley.  Cook for 1 minute more.  In a large mixing bowl combine cooked pasta, chicken mixture, alfredo sauce, dried tomatoes, milk, 1/4 of the Parmesan cheese and pepper.  Turn into a 2-quart rectangular baking dish.  Sprinkle with remaining Parmesan cheese.  cover and bake in a 350 oven for 15 mintes.  Uncover and bake for 10 to 15 minutes more or until heated through and top is slightly golden.  If desired, garnish with fresh basil

recipes.Author: Campbell Soup Co.
recipes.Ingredients:
1 lb. skinless, boneless chicken breasts, cut up.
1 tbsp. vegetable oil
1 can (10 3/4 oz.) Condensed Cream of Mushroom soup
2¼ cups water
½ tsp. dried basil leaves, crushed
2 cups frozen vegetable combination (broccoli, cauliflower, carrots)
2 cups uncooked corkscrew pasta
Grated parmesan cheese
recipes.Procedure:
1. In a skillet brown chicken in hot oil.  Set aside. Add soup, water, basil and vegetables.  Heat to a boil.
2. Add uncooked pasta.  Cook over medium heat 10 min, stirring often.
3. Add browned chicken.  Cook 5 min. or until pasta is done, stirring often.  Sprinkle with cheese.

recipes.Blurb: Batter may be made up ahead and stored in refrigerator up to 1 month to be used as needed.
recipes.Author: Rosemary Smith
recipes.Ingredients:
1¼ cups unprocessed bran (or, substitute Mueslix cereal for part of the bran)
1 cup toasted wheat germ
1 cup packed brown sugar
2½ cups whole wheat flour
2½ tsp. baking soda
½ tsp. salt
1 tbsp. grated orange peel
2  eggs, beaten slightly
½ cup honey
¼ cup molasses
½ cup vegetable oil
2 cups buttermilk
1 cup boiling water
recipes.Procedure: In a large bowl, combine first seven ingredients; set aside.  Combine eggs, honey, molasses, oil, buttermilk and boiling water; mix well with dry ingredients.  Spoon batter into greased muffin tins, filling 2/3 full.  Bake at 350 for 20-25 minutes.

recipes.Ingredients:
1 cup All-Bran cereal
1 cup milk
3 tbsp. vegetable oil
1  egg
1¼ cups all purpose flour
2 tbsp. sugar
1 tbsp. baking powder
¼ tsp. salt
¾ cup mashed banana
½ cup raisins
Maple syrup
recipes.Procedure: Preheat oven to 400.  Butter 12-cup muffin tin.  Stir cereal into milk in large bowl and let stand 2 minutes.  Beat in oil and egg.  Combine flour, sugar, baking power and salt in another bowl.  Stir into cereal mixture.  Add banana and raisins and mix just to combine.  Spoon batter into prepared tin.  Lightly drizzle tops with maple syrup.  Bake until lightly browned, about 30 minutes.  Serve muffins immediately.

recipes.Author: Marcia Copeland
recipes.Ingredients:
1  egg
¾ cup milk
½ cup vegetable oil
⅓ cup honey
2 cups whole wheat flour
1 tbsp. grated orange peel
3 tsp. baking powder
1 tsp. salt
¼ cup orange marmalade
recipes.Procedure:
Heat oven to 400.  Grease bottoms only of 12 medium muffin cups, 2 1/2 x 1 1/4 inches.
Beat egg; stir in milk, oil and honey.  Mix flour, orange peel, baking powder and salt.  Stir into milk mixture all at once just until flour is moistened (batter will be lumpy).  Fill muffin cups about 3/4 full.  Spoon 1 teaspoon marmalade onto batter in each cup.  Bake about 20 minutes or until golden brown.  Remove from pan immediately.
Not recommended for high altitude (3500-6500').

recipes.Ingredients:
2 cups medium pasta shells, cooked
½ cup chopped celery
½ cup Kalmata olives
¼ cup grated parmesan cheese
½ cup prepared Greek or Italian Dressing
½ cup mayonnaise or salad dressing
1½ tsp. dried oregano leaves
¾ tsp. black pepper
1 cup crumbled feta cheese
1  tomato, chopped
recipes.Procedure: In a large bowl, combine cooked pasta, celery, olives and parmesan cheese.  In a small bowl, combine dressing, mayonnaise, oregano and black pepper; toss with pasta mixture.  Cover and refrigerate for 1 or 2 hours.  Before serving, fold in feta cheese and tomatoes.

recipes.Blurb: This may be made up 1 day to 1 month ahead of time
recipes.Ingredients:
2  6 1/2- to 8 oz. containers candied red cherries
1  12-oz package pitted prunes
1  10-oz container pitted dates
1  3 1/2- to 4-oz container candied green cherries
½ cup cream sherry
2  12-oz cans salted mixed nuts
1  6-oz can pecans
1½ cups all-purpose flour
1 cup sugar
1 tsp. baking powder
6  large eggs, slightly beaten
recipes.Procedure:
1. In a very large bowl or 6-quart saucepot, combine first 5 ingredients; let stand 15 minutes or until almost all liquid is absorbed, stirring occasionally.
2. Meanwhile, line 10-inch tube pan with foil; press out wrinkles as much as possible so cake surface will come out smooth after baking.
3. Stir mixed nuts and pecans into fruit mixture in the bowl.  Remove 1½ cups fruit mixture; set aside.  Stir flour, sugar and baking powder into fruit mixture in large bowl until well coated. Stir in eggs until well mixed.
4. Spoon batter into prepared pan, packing firmly to eliminate air pockets.  Sprinkle reserved fruit mixture on top.
5. Cover pan loosely with foil.  Bake in 300º oven for 2 hours.  Remove foil and bake ½ hour longer or until knife inserted into center of cake comes out clean and top of cake is lightly browned.
6. Cool cake in pan on wire rack 30 minutes; remove from pan and carefully peel back foil.  Cool cake completely on rack.  Wrap fruitcake tightly with foil or plastic wrap.  Refrigerate.  Makes one 4½ lb fruitcake for 24 servings.

recipes.Blurb: When baking both breads at once, switch placement of baking sheets in the oven halfway through baking.  Or, bake one flatbread at a time, keeping the unbaked bread covered in the refrigerator while the other is baking.
recipes.Ingredients:
1  16-oz. pkg. hot-roll mix
1  egg
2 tbsp. olive oil or cooking oil
¼ cup snipped fresh basil or 2 tsp. dried basil, crushed
⅔ cup finely chopped onion
3 tbsp. live oil or cooking oil
¾ cup pitted kalmata olives, drained and chopped.
½ cup feta cheese (2 oz)
recipes.Procedure:
Lightly grease two large baking sheets; set aside.
Prepare hot-roll mix according to package directions for basic dough, using the 1 egg and substituting the 2 tbsp. olive oil or cooking oil for margine.  Stir in 1 tablespoon of the fresh basil or 1/2 tsp of the dried basil.  Kead dough and allow to rest as directed.  Divide dough in half and roll each portion into a 12- or 13-inch round Place on prepared baking sheet.  In a skillet, cook onion and remaining basil in 3 tbsp oil until onion is tender but not brown. With fingertips, press indentations every inch or so in dough round.  Top dough evenly with onion mixture.  Sprinkle with chopped olives and cheese.  Cover; let rise in a warm place until nearly double (30 to 40 minutes).  Bake in a 375 oven for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden.  Remove from oven.  Transfer to a wire rack and cool.

recipes.Blurb: This is an old family favorite.  It never fails to please!
recipes.Author: Unknown
recipes.Ingredients:
1 lb. Round Steak
1 tbsp. Soy Sauce
¼ tsp. mustard powder
1  Clove Garlic
¼ cup Salad Oil
1  Green pepper, cut in 1" squares
1  Large onion, coarsely chopped
½ cup Celery, coarsely chopped
1 tsp. Cornstarch
¼ cup Water
2  Tomatoes, cut in eighths
recipes.Procedure:
1. Slice round steak against the grain into thin strips.
2. In a bowl, mix the oil, garlic, mustard powder and soy sauce. (We like to double all this.) Let stand at least 1 hour. Fry in very hot pan about 3 minutes. 
3. Add green peppers, onion and celery. Cook very fast for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Lower heat. Mix cornstarch with water (we double this, too). Stir into frying pan. Add the tomatoes and cover. Cook 5 minutes. Serve with boiled rice.

recipes.Blurb: Frozen lemonade concentrate and plum sauce are the secrets to the glaze's sweet-sour taste.
recipes.Author: Norma J. Keleber
recipes.Ingredients:
2½  to 3 lbs.meaty chicken pieces, skinned
2 tbsp. olive oil or cooking oil
¼ cup chopped onion
1  clove garlic, minced
1 tsp. grated fresh gingerroot
⅓ cup plum sauce (half an 8 1/2 oz. jar)
¼ cup frozen lemonade concentrate
¼ cup chili sauce
2 tbsp. soy sauce
1 tbsp. lemon juice
1 tsp. dry mustard
recipes.Procedure: In a skillet, brown chicken in hot oil over medium heat about 10 minutes.  Remove chicken and place in a 3-quart baking dish.  Drain off all but 1 tablespoon fat in skillet; add onion, garlic and gingerroot.  Cook until onion is tender.  Stir together remaining ingredients.  Carefully stir into onion mixture; bring just to boiling.  Reduce heat and simmer, covered, for 5 minutes.  Spoon mixture over chicken in dish.  Bake, uncovered, at 350 for 40-45 minutes or until chicken is done, spooning sauce over chicken occasionally.

recipes.Blurb: The breading used here is the best I have tried, and it stays on during cooking.  Try it to bread chicken sometime1
recipes.Author: Gary Willis
recipes.Ingredients:
½ cup Fine white cornmeal
½ cup all-purpose flour
1 tsp. salt
1 tsp. grated lemon peel
1 tsp. garlic powder
½ tsp. cayenne pepper
½ tsp. tsp. black pepper
2 lb. whiting fillets
1  cup. peanut oil
recipes.Procedure:
1. Combine cornmeal, flour, salt, lemon peel, garlic powder, cayenne pepper and black pepper in a large bowl.  Dredge fish fillets in cornmeal mixture to coat all sides.

2) Heat oil in heavy, deep skillet or deep-fat fryer until oil registers 375º.  Add a few fish fillets to hot oil, without crowding pan.  Brown on both sides, 5 or 6 minutes.  Remove fish with slotted spoon to paper towling to drain.  Repeat to cook all fish.

recipes.Author: Cooks.Com
recipes.Ingredients:
1 lb. dried pinto beans
2 tsp. ground cumin seed
2 tsp. ground allspice
2 tsp. ground cloves
1 tsp. cinammon
1  8oz can tomato sauce
1  large onion, coarsely chopped
1 lb. bacon, chopped
½  lb. Portuguese sausage (Lingueça)
salt and pepper
recipes.Procedure:
Soak beans overnight, or boil in 2" of water for 2 min. and let soak for 2 hrs.  Rinse.
In a large pan, cover beans with 2" of water and bring to a boil.  Add spices, tomato sauce and onion and simmer until beans are tender.  Add bacon and sausage and simmer until meat is tender.Serve at once.

recipes.Ingredients:
4 cups celery, sliced diagnally into  1/2-inch pieces.
1 cup water (add water to liquid from mushrooms to make 1 cup)
¼ tsp. salt
1  4-oz can mushroom stems and pices, drained
2 tbsp. butter
¼ cup oil and vinegar dressing
¼ cup sliced or slivered almonds
⅛ tsp. seasoned salt
⅛ tsp. seasoned pepper
recipes.Procedure:
1. Place celery, water and salt in Wok.  turn heat control to 225 degrees, cover and steam 9 to 10 minutes or until crisp-tender.  Stir once after steaming 5 minutes.
2. Drain liquid from celery into Wok.  Add mushrooms, butter, salad dressing, almonds, seasoned salt and seasoned pepper.  Toss gently until evenly blended.  Reduce heat to "warm" for serving.

recipes.Ingredients:
1  egg
1 cup milk
½ cup vegetabe oil
1 cup raisins
2 tbsp. orange peel
1½ cup bran
3 tbsp. molasses
¾ cup whole wheat flour
¾ cup white flour
3 tsp. baking powder
1 tsp. salt
¼ cup brown sugar
recipes.Procedure: Pour milk over bran; let set 1 minute.  Add egg, oil and molasses; beat well.  Add orange peel and raisins.  In a separate bowl, mix together flours, baking powder salt and sugar.  Mix with bran mixture just until flour is moistened.  Bake at 400º for 18-20 minutes.  Makes 12 muffins.

recipes.Blurb: Spread this on toast for a quick Garlic Bread.
recipes.Ingredients:
½ cup butter
1 tsp. parsley flakes
¼ tsp. oregano, crumbled
¼ tsp. dried dill weed
1  clove garlic, minced
recipes.Procedure: Allow butter to soften.  Blend with other ingredients, mixing thoroughly.  Refrigerate.

recipes.Blurb: The author claims this is an excellent cold-weather lunch
recipes.Author: Patricia Wells
recipes.Ingredients:
2½  thinly sliced pancetta or very lean, best-quality bacon
1 tbsp. fresh lemon juice
Sea salt to taste
3 tbsp. extra-virgin olive oil
Freshly ground pepper
2 oz. chunk Parmigiano-Reggiano cheese
2  bunches (about 3 oz.) stemmed arugula leaves, washed and dried
About 24 black olives (such as French Nyons), pitted
recipes.Procedure:
1. Preheat oven broiler.  Cover a broiling pan with aluminum foi.  Place pancetta slices side by side on foild and broil about 3 inches from heat source until golden and sizzling; 2 to 3 minutes.  Transfer to paper towels to drain.  Break into bite-sized pieces; set aside.
2.  In a large bowl, whish together lemon juice and salt.  Whisk in olive oil and pepper until well blended.  Taste for seasong; set aside.
3.  Using a vegetable peelier, shave cheese into long, thick strips (if chunk becomes too small to peel, grate remainder and add to bowl); set aside.
4.  When ready to serve, add arugula  to bowl and toss until each leaf is thoroughly coated.  Taste for seasoning.
5. Arrange salad on large dinner plates.  Garnish with pancetta slices, cheese strips and olives; serve immediately with French bread.

recipes.Blurb: Serve as you would mayonnaise; on poached or roasted fish; leftover roast chicken, turkey, lamb or beef; or as a salad dressing
recipes.Author: Patricia Wells
recipes.Ingredients:
2 tbsp. sherry wine vinegar
Fine sea salt to taste
2 tbsp. imported Dijon mustard
Small handful of mixed fresh herbs and greens, such as sorrel, parsley, arugula, mint and tarragon, carefully de-stemmed
6 tbsp. extra-virgin olive oil
2 tbsp. minced capers
recipes.Procedure:
1. In a small bowl, whisk together vinegar, salt and mustard; set aside.
2. Using scissors or a large chef's knife, finely chop leaves of herbs; set aside.
3. In a food processor, combine all the ingredients and process until well blended.  Taste for seasoning.  Serve immediately.  (The sauce can be refirigerated, tightly covered, for up to 2 days.  To serve, bring the sauce to room temperature and stir to blend.)
Makes 1 cup.

recipes.Author: Sam Baca
recipes.Ingredients:
3  blue or yellow corn tortillas, 6"
1 cup chopped onion
2 tbsp. chili powder
2 tsp. all purpose flour
¾ cup vegetable or chicken broth
Salt
½ cup shredded, reduced-fat cheddar cheese.
Nonfat or low-fat sour cream (optional)
1  8-oz can pinto or black beans, heated
1 cup shredded lettuce
2 tbsp. diced tomato
recipes.Procedure:
1. In a 10- to 12-inch nonstich frying pan over high heat, cook tortillas, in a single layer, until soft an lightly toasted, turning once; about 3 minutes per batch.  Set aside as toasted.
2. Reduce heat to medium.  Add onion and stir until limp; about 5 minutes.  Remove from pan.
3. Mix ground chilis and flour in pan and stir over low heat until chilis smell lightly toasted; about 2 minutes.
4. Whisk in broth until smooth.  Stir over high heat until the sauce boils, about 2 minutes.  Add salt to taste.
5.  Dip 1 tortilla in chili sauce, coating both sides, then set on a microwave-safe plate.  Top tortilla with half the onion and a third of the cheese.  Repeat layers, using all tortillas and onion.  Pour remaining chili sauce (it thickens as it cools) over the stacked enchilada, then sprinkle with remaining cheese.

recipes.Author: Will Bucklin
recipes.Ingredients:
1½ cup long-grain white rice
1 lb. cooked lamb, fat-trimmed
1 tsp. salad oil
1 cup chopped onion
2  cloves garlic, pressed or minced
2 tbsp. curry powder
½ tsp. ground cumin
1¾ cup chicken broth
2 tbsp. cornstarch
Salt and Cayenne pepper
1  firm-ripe banana (6 oz.) diced
1 cup plain nonfat yogurt
⅔ cup chutney
1 cup diced cucumber
½ cup dried currants
recipes.Procedure:
1. In a 2- to 3-quart pan, combine rice and 2 3/4 cup water.  Bring to a boil over high heat and cook until most of the water is absorbed; 7 to 10 minutes. Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer until rice is tender to bite; 10 to 15 minutes longer.
2. Cut the lamb into strips about ¼" thick.
3. In a 5- to 6-quart pan over medium heat, combine oil, onion and garlic; stir often until onion begins to brown lightly; 6 to 7 minutes.
4. Add curry powder and cumin and stir until spices are fragrant, about 30 seconds
5. Stir in meat.  Add 1 ½ cups broth and bring to a boil over high heat.  Mix cornstarch and ¼ cup broth.  Stir into pan and stir until boiling resumes.  Add salt and cayenne to taste.  Spoon curry into a bowl.
6. Place condiments—banana, yogurt, chutney, cucumber and currants—in small bowls.  Serve curry with rice and condiments to add to taste.

recipes.Ingredients:
For duck:
1  5-6 lb. duckling
1 tbsp. kosher salt
½ tsp. ground cumin
1 tsp. ground coriander
1 tsp. black pepper
1  orange, halved
4  sprigs fresh thyme
4  sprigs fresh marjoram
2  sprigs Italian parsley
1  small onion, cut into 8 wedges
1  small carrot, chopped coarsely
1  rib celery, chopped coarsely
For sauce:
1 cup chicken stock
1 tsp. cornstarch
1 tbsp. white wine vinegar
1 tbsp. sugar
1 tbsp. julienned and blanched orange peel
½ cup orange juice
1 tsp. lemon juice
⅛ tsp. orange extract
2 tbsp. curaçao or triple sec
recipes.Procedure:
1. Preheat oven to 475º.  Stir together salt, coriander, cumin and pepper.  Pat duck dry and rub inside and out with spice mixture.  Cut ½ of orange into wedges and stuff duck cavity with thyme, marjormam, parsley , orange and 4 onion wedges.
2. Spread remaining 4 onion wedges with carrot and celery in roasting pan and place duck on top of vegetables.  Roast 30 min.
3. Reduce temperature to 350º and continue to roast duck until internal temperature reaches 170º (about 15 min. per lb.)
4. Remove duck to cutting board and drain pan juices.  Deglaze pan with 1 cup chicken stock. Let duck rest 15 min.  while you prepare the sauce.
5.  Thicken stock with 1 tsp cornstarch, which has been mixed together with a little of the stock.  In a saucepan, cook together vinegar and sugar until light brown.  Add the stock and cook 4-5 min. then add 1 tbsp. orange peel, orange juice, lemon juice, orange extract and curaçao or triple sec.  Pour over duck and serve immediately.

recipes.Blurb: Use a food processor to make this.
recipes.Ingredients:
½ lb. bacon
1 cup milk or consume
1 tsp. grated onion
1  egg yolk
⅛ tsp. white pepper
2  slices white bread
4  parsley sprigs
½ lb. calve's or chicken liver
½ tsp. salt
Thyme, Allspice, Marjoram
recipes.Procedure: Preheat oven to 300º.  Line a 9" loaf pan with bacon strips and chill.  Reserve enough bacon strips to cover top of pate.  Chop remaining bacon with steel blade in food processor.  Put quartered bread slices in food bowl; chop into fine crumbs.  Combine with milk or consume and set aside to soak.  Chop parsley in food bowl until finely minced.  Combine chopped bacon, parsley and onion.  Fry until brown (5 min.).  Add liver cut into 2" chunks and cook until brown.  Cool slightly, then put into food bowl.  Add egg yolk, salt, pepper and pinch each of thyme, allspice and marjoram.  Squeeze bread crumbs and add.  With motor running, pour liquid through the tube.  Add only enough to make aa slightly runny paste.  Pack liver mixture into loaf pan and top with reserved bacon slices and cover with aluminum foil.  Place in large pan with water to come halfway up loaf pan.  Bake 2 hours.  Allow to cool before serving

recipes.Author: "Frugal Gourmet"
recipes.Ingredients:
2 lb. lean lamb cut into 1" cubes (I have used leftover lamb and it works well)
½ cup olive oil
1 cup red wine
1 tsp. salt
fresh-ground black pepper
1 tsp. oregano
1 tsp. whole dried mint, hand-crushed.
3  cloves garlic, crushed.
Juice of 1/2 lemon
8  Pita bread pockets, brushed with olive oil and grilled briefly on both sides.
recipes.Procedure: Marinate cubes of meat (pork works well, too) in a large bowl. Mix two or thre times in a 2-hour period. Place on wooden skewers and broil, turning once until tender but still abit pink on the inside. Serve in grilled pita pockets with paper-thin sliced purple onions, thin-sliced ripe tomatoes and plain yogurt on top.

recipes.Ingredients:
8 oz. cream cheese
8 oz. liver sausage
1 tbsp. chopped onion
1 tsp. lemon juice
1 tsp. worcestershire sauce
dash salt and pepper
recipes.Procedure: Add all ingredients to bowl and mix thoroughly.

recipes.Blurb: Makes a 1½lb loaf.
recipes.Author: Sunset Magazine 3/98
recipes.Ingredients:
1 cup water
1 cup sourdough starter
3 cups bread flour
½ cup rye flour
1 tbsp. sugar
1 tsp. salt
1  package active dry yeast
recipes.Procedure:
1. Process ingredients on dough cycle of machine.
2. Scrape dough onto a board coated generously with bread flour.  Taking care not to puncture or tear dough surface (interior will be sticky), pat dough gently with floured hands to form a round loaf about 8 inches wide; do not knead.  Sprinkle 2 tbsp bread flour over dough.
3. Slide a pastry scaper or wide spatula under loaf to loosen, then lift quickly and carefully onto a buttered 14x17 inch baking sheet.  Pat to reshape loaf, if necessary.
4. Lightly cover loaf with plastic wrap and let stand until puffy; about 30 minutes.  Remove plastic.
5. With a floured razor blade or very sharp knife, cut 2 or 3 slashes about ½ inch deep across top of loaf.
6. Bake in a 425º oven until richly browed; 25 to 30 minutes.
7. Transfer loaf to a rack to cool at least 15 minutes before slicing.

recipes.Blurb: Makes a 1½lb loaf
recipes.Author: Sunset Magazine 3/98
recipes.Ingredients:
⅓ cup water
2  large eggs
2  large egg yolks
½ cup butter or margarine
2½ cups all-purpose flour
3 tbsp. sugar
½ tsp. salt
1  package active dry yeast
recipes.Procedure:
1.  Add ingredients to bread machine; process on dough cycle.
2. At the end of cycle, scrape dough onto a board lightly floured with all-purpose flour.  Divide dough into 3 equal pieces.  Roll each piece to form a rope about 12 inches long.  Lay ropes parallel about 1 inch apart on a buttered, 14x17" baking sheet. Pinch ropes together at one end, braid loosely, then pinch braid end together.
3. Cover loaf lightly with plastic wrap and let stand in a warm place until puffy, about 35 minutes.  Remove plastic wrap.
4. Beat 1 larg egg yolk to blend with 1 tbsp water.  Brush braid with egg mixture.
5. Bake braid in a 350º oven until golden brown, about 30 minutes.  Cool on a rack at least 15 minutes before slicing.

recipes.Ingredients:
⅔ cup olive oil
⅓ cup minus 2 tbsp. white wine vinegar
2 tbsp. lemon juice
1 tsp. basil
1 tsp. dry mustard
½ tsp. onion powder
½ tsp. salt
¼ tsp. pepper
recipes.Procedure: Mix ingredients in bowl.  Store in refrigerator

recipes.Ingredients:
⅓ cup Olive oil
2 tbsp. lemon juice
1 tbsp. red wine vinegar
1 tsp. dry mustard
1 tsp. leaf basil, crumbled
2  cloves garlic, finely chopped
½ tsp. salt
¼ tsp. black pepper
recipes.Procedure: Combine ingredients in a small bowl.  Store in refrigerator

recipes.Blurb: A fresh squeeze of llime over each bowlful softens the impact of the jalapeno "hit".
recipes.Author: Bh&G, 4/98
recipes.Ingredients:
1½ cups dry black beans (about 8 oz.)
1  small onion, halved
2  bay leaves
2 cups chopped onion
1  or 2 jalapeno peppers, seeded and finely chopped
3 tbsp. cooking oil or olive oil
4  cloves garlic, finely chopped
2 tsp. ground cumin
2 tsp. finely shredded lime peel
¾ tsp. salt
¼ tsp. pepper
Hot cooked brown rice
Fresh cilantro springs (optional)
Lime wedges (optional)
Jalapeno pepper slices (optional)
recipes.Procedure: Rinse beans.  In a large pot combine beans and 4 cups water.  Bring to a boil; reduce heat.  Simmer for 2 minutes.  Remove from heat.  Cover and let stand 1 hour.  (Or, place beans in water in pot.  Cover and let soak in a cool place for 6-8 hours or overnight.)  Drain and rinse beans.  Return beans to pan.  Add the halved onion, bay leaves and 4 cups water.  Bring to boiling; reduce heat.  Cover and simmer for 1¼ to 1½ hours or until beans are tender.  Remove and discard the onion and bay leaves.  Remove about ½ cup of the beans; mash them and return to the bean mixture in pot. In a large skillet cook chopped onions and jalapeno about 8 minutes or until the onions are tender.  Add garlic, cumin, lime peel, salt and pepper; cook and stir for 1-2 minutes more.  Stir the onion mixture into the bean mixture.  Bring to boiling; reduce heat.  Simmer, uncovered, for 5-10 minutes or until soup thickens slightly.  Serve beans with cooked rice.  Garnish with cilantro; serve with jalapeno slices and lime wedges if desired.

recipes.Blurb: Especially good with a simple entre: beef, plain chicken or ham
recipes.Ingredients:
1 cup salad oil
3 tbsp. red wine vinegar
1 tsp. salt
¼ tsp. each pepper and paprika
1  clove garlic, minced
½ tsp. celery salt
1 tbsp. lemon juice
1 tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1 tsp. prepared horseradish
4 oz. crumbled bleu cheese
recipes.Procedure: Mix ingredients, except bleu cheese, in a small bowl.  Gradually mix in the bleu cheese.  Keep covered in a refrigerator.

recipes.Ingredients:
1½  lb. spinach
½  lb. bacon, cut in  1/2" pieces
3 tbsp. white wine vinegar
2 tsp. balsamic vinegar
1 tbsp. dry mustard
¼ cup brandy
2  large hard boiled eggs, chopped
1½ tbsp. sugar
salt
pepper
recipes.Procedure: Break spinach into bite-sized pices, put into refrigerator to crisp.  Cook bacon until crisp; about 5-8 minutes.Add the sugar, vinegar and mustard.  Stir until mixture boils.  Heat brandy.  Ignite and pour into vinegar mixture.  Sauté until flames die.  Pour over spinach and mix well. Sprinkle with the chopped egg and add salt and pepper to taste.

recipes.Blurb: This is a "cooked custard" variety of ice cream.  The egg yolk makes for a smoother textture.
recipes.Author: Sunset 8/98
recipes.Ingredients:
¾ cup sugar
3 cups half-and-half
2  large eggs
2 tsp. vanilla
recipes.Procedure:
1. In a 2- to 3- qt pan, combine sugar and half-and-half.  Stir over high heat until bubbles form at pan edge (scalding, about 180º); 5 to 8 minutes.
2. In a small bowl, whisk eggs to blend.  Then whish about ½ cup of the hot cream mixture into eggs.  Return egg mixture to pan and stir over medium-low heat with a flexible spatual-scraper, scraping pan bottom and sides thoroughly for even cooking, until custard thickly coats a metal spoon (about 190º); 8 to 10 minutes.
3. Add vanilla to custard.
4.  At once, nest pan in ice water and stir custard often until mixture is cold; 10 to 15 minutes.
5. Pour cold custard through a fine strainer into a bowl, then pour mixture into an ice cream maker (1-qt or larger), or strain directly into the maker; discard residue.  Freeze as directed by ice cream machine instructions.

recipes.Blurb: To use a vanilla bean, slit pod lengthwise with a sharp knife.  Scrape seed into sugar; mix, then add create; do not heat.
recipes.Author: Sunset 8/98
recipes.Ingredients:
¾ cup sugar
3 cups half-and-half
2 tsp. vanilla
recipes.Procedure:
1. Mix sugar, half-and-half and vanilla in a bowl.
2. Pour into ice cream maker and freeze according to the machine's instructions.

recipes.Ingredients:
1  3- lb. chicken cut up
½ cup chopped onion
1  clove garlic, finely chopped
1  pt. tomatoes
1 cup water
1 cup sherry or dry white wine
2  bouillon cubes
½ tsp. each: basil, thyme and marjoram
Salt and pepper
1 cup navy beans
2  carrots
recipes.Procedure: Soak Navy beans overnight, or boil 2 minutes and let stand 1 hour..  Brown chicken in olive oil.  Add chopped onion and garlic; cook slowly.  Layer beans, carrots anc hicken in a slow cooker or large pot.  Add bouillon cubes, tomatoes, water and wine.  Sprinkle with herbs, salt and pepper and bring to a boil.  Simmer until beans are done.

recipes.Blurb: From Sunset magazine, Sep 1998
recipes.Author: Betty J. Nichols
recipes.Ingredients:
1 tbsp. olive oil
⅓ cup chopped celery
⅓ cup chopped red onion
1¼ cup medium-grain white rice.
4 cups chicken broth
¾ lb. bay scallops, rinsed and drained.
1 cup frozen petite peas
2 tsp. grated fresh ginger
1 tbsp. lemon juice
2 tbsp. finely shredded fresh basil leaves
Lemon wedges
Salt and freshly-ground pepper
recipes.Procedure:
1. In a 3- to 4-quart pan over medium heat, combine oil, celery an onion.  Stir often until onion is limp; 4-5 minutes.  Add rice and mix well.
2.  Add 4 cups broth and bring to a boil over high heat, stirring often.  Reduce heat to simmering and stir often until rice is tender to bite, 12-15 minutes.
3.  Add scallops, peas and ginger.  Stir until scallops are opaque but still moist-looking in center of thickest part (cut to test), 5-7 minutes.  Add lemon juice and a little more broth if a creamier texture is desired.  Mix well.
4.  Spoon risotto into wide bowls.  Sprinkle with basil and garnish with lemon wedges.  Add salt and pepper to taste.

recipes.Author: Williams-Sonoma
recipes.Ingredients:
2 tbsp. Olive oil
4  boneless, skinless chicken breasts
1 tsp. salt
Freshly ground pepper, to taste
1  large carrot, cut crosswise into  1/4" pieces
1  large leek, white part only, chopped
2 tsp. minced garlic
2  roasted red peppers, peeled, seeded and chopped
4  lemon slices
⅓ cup pitted green olives
⅓ cup pitted Kalmata alives
1  sprig fresh rosemary
1 tbsp. chopped fresh thyme
1  bay leaf
¼ cup white wine
3 cups low-sodium chicken broth
12  cherry tomatoes, stemmed and halved
recipes.Procedure: In a pressure cooker over high heat, warm olive oil until nearly smoking.  Season chicken breasts with salt and pepper.  Add chickn to presure cooker and brown, 2-3 minutes per side.  Transfer chicken to plate; reserve.  Reduce heat to medium-high.  Add carrot, leek and garlic and saute, stirring occasionally, about 3 min.  Add red peppers, lemon slices, olives, rosemary, thyme, bay leaf, wine and broth.  Immerse chicken breasts in the mixture and lock lid in place.  Raise heat to high and bring to high pressure.  When pressure-regulator valuve pops open, set timer for 5 min. and finish cooking.  Set cooker in the sink and run cold tap water over outer edge of lid to release pressure; about 15 sec. (valve will drop back into place once pressure is diminished).  Remove lid; set pressure cooker over low heat and stir in tomatoes.  Cook 1-2 minutes; taste and adjust seasonings.  Transfer chicken breasts to individual plates and spoon vegetables and broth over top.

recipes.Author: Williams-Sonoma
recipes.Ingredients:
4 tbsp. olive oil
1 cup diced carrots
2 cups chopped leeks, white part only
1¼ tsp. salt
Freshly ground pepper to taste
1 cup diced yellow squash
1 cup diced red peppers
1½ cup peeled, seeded and diced tomatoes
8 cups chicken or vegetable stock
2 tbsp. champagne vinegar
1  bunch fresh basil, stems removed and leaves chopped
2  cloves garlic, minced
1 tbsp. freshly grated parmesan, plus more for garnish
1  bunch green onions, chopped
recipes.Procedure: In an 8-quart soup pot over medium-high heat, warm 2 tbs of the olive oil.  Add carrots and leeks and saute 3-4 min.  Season with 1 tsp of the salt, and pepper to taste.  Add squash, red peppers and tomatoes, and saute until medium-soft; 4-5 min.  Add stock and vinegar, reduce heat to medium-low and simmer 20 min.  With a mortar and pestal, cursh 1/3 of the basil to form a rough paste.  Add remaining basil in two parts and continue crushing.  Add garlic, remaining ¼ tsp salt and 1 tbs parmesan cheese to the mortar and work with the pestal to form a smooth paste.  Add remaining 2 tbsp. oive oil as you work mixture; cover and reserve.  Add green onions to the soup and cook 2-32 min.  Stir in basil pistou, ladle soup into individual bowls and sprinkle with parmesan.

recipes.Author: Williams-Sonoma
recipes.Ingredients:
3 tbsp. extra-virgin olive oil
2  large carrots, peeled and diced
1  leek, white part only, chopped
3  cloves garlic, minced
2  small fennel bulbs, stems removed, sliced into eighths
1 lb. ripe plum tomatoes, peeled, seeded and chopped
2  bay leaves
1 tbsp. lemon juice
1 cup dry white wine
3 cups bottled clam juice
3 cups chicken stock
2 tsp. salt
freshly ground pepper, to taste
1 lb. mussels (14-16), well scrubbed
1 lb. white fish filets, such as cod, sole, halibut or red snapper, cut into 1" pieces
1 tbsp. chopped fresh thyme
2  green onions, chopped
1 lb. large shrimp, peeled and deveined
recipes.Procedure: In a dutch oven or large saucepan over high heat, warm olive oil and saute carrots, leek and garlic until soft; 4-5 min.  Add fennel, tomatoes and bay leaves; cook, stirring occasionally, until tomatoes start to release their juices, 5-6 min.  Stir in lemon juice, wine, clam juice, stock, salt and pepper.  Cover partially and cook until fennel is almost tender, 12-15 min  Discard any mussles that do not close to the touch.  Add fish, cover and simmer over low heat for 10 min.  Add thyme, green onions, mussels and shrimp; cook until fish is opaque (cut to test), shrimp is pink and mussels open; 5-6 min. more.  Discard any mussles that do not open.  Serve in warm soup bowls..

recipes.Blurb: Try this with "The Cake".
recipes.Ingredients:
¼  lb. butter (1 stick)
¼ cup water
1 cup granulated sugar
½ cup dark rum (80 proof).
recipes.Procedure: Melt butter on saucepan.  Stir in water and sugar.  Boil 5 minutes.  Remove from heat; stir in rum.

recipes.Blurb: This can be prepared and baked to serve at once, or can be put together a few hours ahead of time, refrigerated, and then popped into the oven.  Use just about any fish: scrod, turbot, haddock or other firm fillets or fish steaks, such as salmon.
recipes.Author: Moosewood Restaurant
recipes.Ingredients:
2  firm fish fillets or steaks (5-6 oz. each) or 1 larger fillet (10-12 oz) cut in half.
1 cup cooked rice
2 cups coarsely chopped mustard greens or bok choy
2  scallions, chopped
1 tbsp. vegetable oil
1 tsp. fresh grated ginger root
1  garlic clove, minced or pressed
1 tbsp. soy sauce
1 tsp. dark sesame oil
chili oil (optional)
recipes.Procedure:
Preheat the oven to 450º.
Take two 12 x 24" sheets of aluminum foil, and fold each sheet of foil over to make a double-thick square.  Brush a little oil in the center part of each square.  Rinse the fish and prepare all the ingredients.
Spread half of the rice on the center of each foil square and then layer the greens, fish and scallions on top of the rice.  In a small bowl, combine the vegetable oil grated ginger, garlic, soy sauce, sesame oil and a few drops of the optional chili oil.  Pour half of the sauce over each serviing.  Fold the foil into airtight packets.  Bake for 20 minutes.  Carefully avoiding the steam that will be released, open a packet and check that the fish is cooked.  To serve, carefully open the foil and transfer the contents to plates or bowls.

recipes.Blurb: Serve with roasted or grilled meat and a simple green vegetable.
recipes.Ingredients:
½  lb. spaghetti
2  cloves garlic
¼ cup olive oil
2 tbsp. butter
¼ cup chopped fresh parsley
1 tsp. grated lemon zest
2 tsp. lemon juice (we like to use more than this).
Salt and Pepper
recipes.Procedure: Cook the pasta in boiling, salted water until done, drain and return to the hot pot.  Mince the garlic.  In a small pan, heat the oil and butter.  Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.  Toss the garlic oil, parsley, lemon zest and juice, 1 tsp salt and ¼ tsp pepper with the pasta.  Taste for seasoning and add salt and pepper as needed.  Serve at once.

recipes.Blurb: Healthful ingredients borrowed from Mediterranean cooking, such as lemon, garlic and oregano make this dish delicious
recipes.Ingredients:
4  chicken thighs
¼ tsp. salt
⅛ tsp. ground black pepper
1  clove garlic, minced
1  large lemon, zested and juiced
1  large tomato, peeled and chopped
½ cup pitted ripe olives
¼ cup chopped onion
¼ cup snipped fresh parsley
1 tbsp. snipped fresh oregano or 1 tsp. dried oregano, crushed
⅛ tsp. ground red pepper
¼ cup dry white wine or chicken broth
¼ cup chicken broth
1  medium green sweet pepper, cut into strips
1  medium red sweet pepper, cut into strips
thinly-sliced lemon (optional)
Fresh oregano springs (optional)
recipes.Procedure:
1. Sprinkle chicken with salt and pepper. Spray a cold nonstick skillet with nonstick coating.
2. Cook chicken over medium heat for 15 minutes or until light brown, turning to brown evenly. Reduce heat.
3. Place the garlic, lemon zest, ½ of the tomato, olives onion, parsley and oregano atop chicken pieces. Sprinkle with ground red pepper. Add wine, lemon juice and ¼ cup broth. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes.
4. Add remaining tomato and the sweet peppers. Cook, uncovered, for 5-10 minutes more or untill peppers are crisp-tender and chicken is tender and no longer pink. Transfer chicken and vegetables to a platter. Garnish with lemon slices and fresh oregano, if desired.

recipes.Blurb: Yellow potatoes give an old favorite a new look; basil gives it a summer-fresh flavor.  We prefer far less basil than specified.
recipes.Author: Sheri L. Castle
recipes.Ingredients:
2½  lb. yellow or russet potatoes
2 tbsp. olive oil
¼ cup olive oil
½ cup lightly packed fresh basil leaves
4  cloves garlic, halved
1 tsp. finely shredded lemon peel
3 tbsp. lemon juice
1  Tbsp Dijon mustard
1 tsp. salt
¼ tsp. pepper
½ cup chopped shallots
½ cup roasted red sweet pepper, cut into thin strips
¼ cup slivered fresh basil leaves
¼ cup finely shredded Parmesan cheese
recipes.Procedure:
Spray a shallow 15x10x2 roasting pan with nonstick coating.  Scrup potatoes and peel if desired.  Cut potatoes into 1-inch wedges or cubes.  Toss with 2 tbsp olive oil  Place in pan.  Roast uncovered at 425º for 35-40 minutes or until just tender and lightly browned, stirring after 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, in a blender combine ¼ cup olive oil, ½ cup basil, garlic, lemon peel, lemon juice, mustard, salt and pepper.  Cover and blend until nearly smooth.  In  a large bowl with hot potatoes stir in shallots and pepper strips.  Let stand at room temperature for ½ hour.  Sprinkle with the ¼ cup slivered basil and Parmesan cheese just before serving.

recipes.Blurb: For a change of pace, you can substitute tuna for the cheese
recipes.Ingredients:
⅔ cup olive oil
3 tbsp. red wine vinegar
¼ cup chopped fresh basil
2 tbsp. chopped green onion
2 tbsp. grated Parmesan cheese
1¼ tsp. salt
¼ tsp. ground black pepper
⅛ tsp. mustard powder
12 oz. rotelle pasta, freshly cooked and drained
1  each, small red, green and yellow bell pepper, halved lengthwise and cut in thin crosswise strips
1  medium-sized tomato, cut in thin wedges
¼ cup toasted pignoli (pine nuts)
¼ cup Greek-style or pitted ripe black olives
8 oz. feta or mozzarella cheese, cubed
¼ tsp. crumbled dried oregano
recipes.Procedure: Process oil, vinegar, 2 tbsp basil, the green onion, Parmesan cheese, salt and pepper in blender or food processor until smooth.  Put pasta, bell pepper strips, tomato wedges, nuts and olives in a large bowl.  Pour in dressing; toss to mix.  Roll cheese cubes in remaining 2 tbsp basil to coat.  Add to salad; sprinkle with oregano, toss lightly.  Serve at room temperature.

recipes.Ingredients:
2  Chicken breasts or 4 thighs
2½ tbsp. olive oil
6 cups chicken broth
Chopped onion
Salt and pepper
1½ tsp. marjoram
1½ tsp. Italian parsley
1 cup all-purpose flour
½ tsp. salt
1 tsp. baking powder
2 tbsp. unsalted butter
3 oz. milk
1 tsp. ground sage or to taste
recipes.Procedure:
1. Cut chicken into bite-sized chunks.  Brown in olive oil. Cover with chopped onions and marjoram. Add salt and pepper to taste. 
2. Pour in broth; simmer until nearly done.
3. Meanwhile, mix flour, salt, sage and baking powder in a food processor. Pulse quickly several times to mix. Add butter and run motor briefly, until mixture has the texture of cornmeal. Add milk and pulse until mixture is just moistened and still lumpy.
4. During last 20 minutes, drop dough by tbsp. into chicken; continue to cook uncovered for 10 minutes. Cover, cook remaining 10 minutes.

recipes.Blurb: Try to use at least two colors of tomatoes in this salad
recipes.Author: Sunset Magazine
recipes.Ingredients:
1  quart lightly packed baby spinach leaves
1  quart lightly packed fresh basil leaves
1 lb. coarse-textured Italian bread, such as ciabatta or pugliese
3½  lbs.soft-ripe tomatoes, peeled if desired and cored
4  cloves garlic, minced
½ cup extra-virgin olive oil
⅓ cup red wine vinegar
3 tbsp. minced fresh jalapeño chilies
Salt and pepper
1  jar (12 oz.) peeled roasted red peppers, cut into wide strips
1 cup oil-packed olives, pitted
½ cup drained capers
2 cans (2 oz. ea.) anchovy fillets, drained
recipes.Procedure:
1. Rinse an drain spinach and basil; wrap in towls.  Chill in a plastic bag.
2. Meanwhile, cut bread into 1-inch chunks and put in an 11x17 inch roasting pan.  Bake in a 350º oven until chunks are light golden and soft parts of bread are crisp; about 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Let cool.
3. Cut tomatoes into 1- to 2- inch chunks and place in a large bowl.  Scoop juice from cutting board into bowl and add garlic, oil, vinegar, chilies and salt and pepper to taste.
4. Gently mix tomatoes with bread, red peppers and olives.  Let stand at least 15 min., stirring occasionally, for bread to soften.  Gently mix in spinach and basil.  Scatter salad with capers and crisscross anchovies on top.

recipes.Author: Sunset Magazine
recipes.Ingredients:
Perfectly ripe tomatoes, in many colors
Arugula leaves
Feta cheese
Kalamata olives
Pesto sauce
recipes.Procedure: Arrange the tomatoes, as many colors as you can obtain, and cut into various shapes for visual appeal, on a bed of argula leaves on a flat wooden platter.  Scatter with crumbled feta cheese and olives, then drizzle with the pesto sauce.

recipes.Author: Aaron Scott
recipes.Ingredients:
2  chicken breasts, cut into 1/2" cubes
½ tbsp. peppercorns, roughly crushed
1½ tsp. grated fresh ginger
2 tbsp. dry white wine
2  cloves garlic
4 tbsp. sesame oil
1 cup chicken broth
2 tbsp. flour
⅛ tsp. nutmeg
1 tsp. lemon peel
recipes.Procedure:
1. Cut chicken into cubes.  Marinade in mixture of white wine, sesame oil, peppercorns, garlic, nutmeg, lemon peel and ginger for 2 hours.
2. Brown chicken mixture in frying pan over medium-high heat.  Add chicken broth; reduce heat and simmer 1 hour or until tender.
3. Thicken broth with flour dissolved in a small amount of cold water.  Continue to simmer until sauce is thickened.  Serve over rice.

recipes.RecipeName: Lemon Pepper Fish With Seasoned Pasta
recipes.Blurb: Any firm whitefish will work well in this flavorful summer meal.
recipes.Author: Penzey's
recipes.Ingredients:
1 lb. boneless, skinless fish fillets
2 tsp. lemon pepper seasoning
½ cup fine bread crumbs
½ tbsp. cheese sprinkle
2 tbsp. olive oil
1 tbsp. red wine vinegar
½ cup cherry tomatoes, quartered
½ tsp. Italian seasoning
2 cups cooked pasta
¼ tsp. salt
2 tbsp. Parmesan cheese, finely shredded.
ground black pepper
recipes.Procedure: Wash and remove skin from fish filets.  Sprinkle with lemon pepper.  Mix break crumbs and cheese sprinkle on a rimmed plate.  Press breading onto both sides of fish.  Heat a heavy-duty skillet until hot; add 2 tbsp oilive oil, heat until hot but not smoking.  Carefully place fish filets in pan, do not crowd, and cook over medium-high heat for about 3 minutes (less for very thin fish).  Reach carefully under fish with a spatula and turn.  Breading should be lightly browned.  This fish will need 1 minute on the second side; thicker, firmer fish up to 3 minutes.  Remove to a serving platter in a warm (150º) oven.  Add a bit more olive oil if needed and heat before adding subsequent batches of fish.  While making the fish, cook pasta in boiling water according to package directions; drain and toss with 1 tsp of olive oil and set aside.  When the fish is cooked and out of the pad, add the vinegar to the hot pan, stir, then add cut tomato pieces.  Cook over medium-high heat for 1-2 minutes until the cut side is browned and the tomatoes are giving up their juice.  Add Italian seasoning and stir to blend.  Turn heat to low, add pasta and salt, warm over low heat.  Add Parmesan cheese, stir until barely melting.  Divide fish and pasta between 4 plates; top with fresh-ground black pepper to taste.  Serve the pasta and fish with a plain steamed vegetable.

recipes.Blurb: This recipe has been scaled down from the published recipe, w hich made 32 servings
recipes.Author: Country Living 12-98
recipes.Ingredients:
5 tbsp. butter
2½ tbsp. confectioner's sugar
½ tsp. finely grated lemon peel
⅜ tsp. lemon extract
¾ cup all-purpose flour
¼ tsp. baking powder
2  eggs
⅓ cup sugar
¼ cup lemon juice
3 tbsp. butter
recipes.Procedure:
1. Prepare shells: in a small saucepan, melt butter over low heat.  Remove from heat; cool slightly.  Stir in confectioner's sugar, lemon rind and lemon extract.  Gradually stir in flour and baking powder to form smooth, soft dough.  With hands, work in enough flour until a firm dough forms.  Gather dough into a flattened ball; cut in half and divide each half into 4 pieces.
2. Heat oven to 375º.  Press 1 piece dough into 3-inch fluted tartlet pan.  Place pans on a cookie sheet for easier handling.
3. Bake 12-15 min. or until golden.  Let shells cool completely in pans on wire racks.  To remove from pans, loosen very carefully with the tip of a knife.  Store shells in stacks of three in an airtight container until ready to fill.  They can be refrigerated a week or frozen up to a month ahead.
4. Prepare filling: in a 1-qt saucepan over medium heat or in the top of a double boiler over simmering water, whisk eggs with sugar until yellow.  Beat in lemon juice and butter.  Cook mixture, stirring constantly, with a spatula until thick enough to coat the spatula.  Do not boil, or the mixture will curdle.  Pour into bowl; cover surface directly with plastic and refrigerate until cold.
5. Just before serving, spoon 1½-2 tbsp lemon filling into each shell.

recipes.Author: Beth Kuder
recipes.Ingredients:
1 cup sugar
1 cup light corn syrup
1 cup heavy cream
¼ tsp. salt
2 tbsp. butter
6 tbsp. milk
2 tsp. vanilla
recipes.Procedure:
Take the temperature of boiling water.  Adjust temperatures shown downward by the difference between the temperature of boiling water and 212º. (WY=180º)
Combine sugar, syrup, cream and salt in heavy saucepan.  Cook to 232º (200º).  Add milk and butter alternately to avoid scorching.  Cook to 244º (212º) and remove from heat.  Add vanilla with little stirring.  Pour at once.  Do NOT scrape the pan.

recipes.Blurb: We like to serve this with a scoop of Haagen Daz Lemon Sorbet, for ULTRA lemony apples!
recipes.Ingredients:
4  Large baking apples
1 can (6 oz) frozen lemon concentrate, thawed
2 tbsp. packed brown sugar
¼ cup chopped nuts (optional)
recipes.Procedure: Peel apples 1/3 down from the stem end.  Arrange in a greased 2-qt shallow baking dish.  Spoon concentrate into cavites and over tops of apples; sprinkle with brown sugar.  Bake in preheated 350º oven, basting occasionally, 45 minutes or until apples are tender but retain their shapes.  Serve warm or at room temperature with baking juices; sprinkle with nuts if desired.

recipes.Ingredients:
3  lbs.combined pitted dates, pulled figs, seeded raisins, currants
½  lb. blanched walnuts or almonds
½  lb. unsalted shelled pistachios
½  lb. crystallized ginger
Grated rind of 2 oranges
3 tbsp. brandy or lemon juice, or as needed
Confectioner's sugar
recipes.Procedure: Chop combined fruits, nuts, ginger and rind through the coarsest blade of your meat grinder (we do this twice).  Add just enough brandy or lemon juice to enable mixture to stick together.  Shape into balls 1-1½ inches in diameter.  Roll in sugar before wrapping.  Vary assortment of fruits and nuts to suit your own taste, using any one or all of those suggested.

recipes.Author: Aaron Allen Scott
recipes.Ingredients:
4 tbsp. olive oil
⅔ cup water at 80º
1 cup sourdough starter
1 tbsp. sugar
1¼ tsp. salt
2¼ cups bread flour
1½ tsp. active dry yeast
recipes.Procedure:
Add liquid ingredients to bread machine.  Add dry ingredients, except yeast, to top.  Prepare a "well" in the center of the dry ingredients and add the yeast.  Process on "dough" cycle.
When dough is finished, let rise 30 minutes.  Divide into about 24 pieces and roll each piece into a long rope over a bed of onion or garlic salt.  Brush with beaten egg yolk and bake at 375º for 35-40 minutes or until golden brown.

recipes.Ingredients:
5 cups water
5  cubes Chicken bouillon
1  Potato, diced
1 cup Celery, diced
1 cup Onion ,diced
1 pkg. California-style vegetables
2 cans cream of chicken soup
1 lb. Velveeta cheese
recipes.Procedure: Mix water,  bouillon and potato in saucepan and cook for 5 min..  Add  celery, onion, vegetables, cream of chicken soup and Velveeta cheese, cut into 1" cubes and simmer until cheese is melted.  Serve immediately.

recipes.Ingredients:
6  Slices bacon
½ cup Onion, chopped
2 tbsp. All-purpose flour
2 tbsp. Sugar
1½ tsp. Salt
1 tsp. Celery seed
Pepper
½ cup Vinegar
6 cups Potatoes, cooked and sliced
recipes.Procedure: In skillet, cook bacon until crisp; drain and crumble, reserving ¼ cup drippings.  Cook onion in the reserved drippings until tender but not brown.  Blend in flour, sugar, salt, celery seed and pepper to taste.  Add vinegar and 1 cup water.  Cook and stir until thickened.  Stir in bacon and potatoes.  Heat through, tossing lightly.  Garnish with parsley if desired.

recipes.Blurb: Depending on my mood, I add more to LOTS more garlic than is called for!
recipes.Ingredients:
¼ cup Soy sauce
¼ cup Brown sugar
2 tbsp. Lemon juice
1 tbsp. Vegetable oil
⅛ tsp. Ginger root, grated
1  clove Garlic, minced
recipes.Procedure: Dissolve sugar in soy sauce and lemon juice.  Stir in oil, ginger and garlic.  Let sit in refrigerator for at least 1 hour for garlic and ginger flavors to blend in. Use as a baste or marinade.

recipes.Ingredients:
6  lbs.green tomatoes, chopped
2  large red bell peppers (about 1 lb), chopped
2  large green bell peppers (about 1 lb) chopped
2  medium onions, chopped
2 tbsp. mustard seed
2 tbsp. celery seed
1 tbsp. mixed pickling spice
¼ cup pickling salt
4 cups apple cider vinegar
2 cups firmly packed brown sugar
recipes.Procedure: In a large bowl, combine tomatoes, peppers and onions.  Sprinkle with pickling salt and mix well.  Cover and chill overnight.  Drain well.  Tie mustard seed, celery seed and pickling spice in a spice bag or cheesecloth.  In a 6- to 8 qt saucpan, combine vegetables, vinegar, sugar and spice bag.  Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring occasionally.  Reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes, stirring often to prevent sticking.  Remove spice bag.  Immediately fill hot pint or half-pint jars with mixture, leaving ½ in. headspace.  Carefully run a nonmetallic utensil down the inside of jars to remove trapped air bubbles.  Wipe jar tops and threads clean.  Place hot lids on jars and screw bands on firmly.  Process pints or half pints in boiling water canner for 15 minutes.  Makes 6-7 pints or 12-14 half pints.

recipes.Author: Aaron Scott
recipes.Ingredients:
1  8-oz can tomato sauce
¼ cup brown sugar
1  clove garlic, minced
1 tsp. worcestershire sauce
2  whole allspice, ground
1 tsp. orange peel
1 tsp. dry mustard
Salt
2 tsp. dry hot mustard (optional)
¼ tsp. cayenne pepper (optional)
Hot pepper sauce
recipes.Procedure:
Mix ingredients in small saucepan and heat until boiling.  Simmer for several minutes.  Remove from heat and cool before serving.
For a hot-and-spicy version, substitute 2 tsp dry hot mustard for the 1 tsp dry mustard, and add ¼ tsp cayenne and hot pepper sauce to taste.  (I use 1 large drop Dave's Gourmet Total Insanity Hot Sauce)

recipes.Ingredients:
1  rib celery, chopped
1  medium onion, chopped
4  medium-sized mushrooms, chopped
4 tbsp. butter or margarine
1 can (6 1/2 oz) minced or chopped clams, lightly drained, liquid reserved
1 tsp. Oregano
2 tbsp. chopped parsley
2  slices white bread, broken into crumbs
½ tsp. salt
Pepper to taste
2  packages (10 oz. ea.) frozen pan-dressed trout, thawed or 4 fresh (5-6 oz) fresh trout.
Lemon wedges and parsley garnish
recipes.Procedure: Cook celery, onion and mushrooms in 2 tbsp butter until onion is tender.  Stir in clams, bread, parsely, salt and pepper.  Moisten with a little reserved clam juice.  Stuff each trout cavity with ¼ of the clam mixture.  Arrange trout in greased baking pan.  Dot with remaining butter.  Bake in preheated 400º oven 12-15 minutes until fish flakes easily with fork.  Garnish with lemon and/or parsley.

recipes.Author: Rosemary Robbins
recipes.Ingredients:
½ cup salad oil or olive oil
3 tbsp. red wine vinegar
1 tsp. oregano leaves
½ tsp. salt
⅛ tsp. pepper
Anchovies
recipes.Procedure: Add ingredients to blender, blend until smooth.

recipes.Blurb: This is really yummy, but I don't know if I regard it as the same as ketcup!
recipes.Author: Williams-Sonoma
recipes.Ingredients:
1 can (28 oz.) peeled whole tomatoes
1  yellow onion, chopped
½ cup cider vinegar
⅓ cup corn syrup
t/4 tsp. cayenne pepper
¼ tsp. dry mustard
Pinch of ground allspice
Pinch of ground ginger
Pinch of ground celery seed
Pinch of ground cinnamon
Pinch of ground cloves
Salt and freshly ground pepper to taste.
recipes.Procedure: Pass tomatoes through a press to remove seeds.  In a blender, process tomato puree and onion until smooth, 25-30 sec.  In a saucepan over medium heat, combine tomato-onion mixture, vinegar, corn syrup, cayenne pepper, mustard, allspice, ginger, celery seed, cinammon and cloves and stir to mix.  Bring mixture to a simmer, stirring occasionally, and reduce heat to medium-low.  Continue cooking, stirring occasionally, until ketchup thickens and is reduced to about 1-1/3 cups, about 1 hr.  Season with salt and pepper, remove from heat and cool to room temperature.  Refrigerate until ready to use.

recipes.Blurb: Fit for the gods
recipes.Author: Sharran Haije
recipes.Ingredients:
8 oz. linguini, dry weight
1 tbsp. olive oil
2  cloves garlic, minced (I use 6 BIG ones)
2 cups seeded plum tomatoes, cut into  1/4 inch dice
Salt and pepper to taste
¼ cup fresh basil, chopped coarsely
recipes.Procedure: Cook pasta, and using large skillet, heat oil, then add garlic and saute lightly.  Add tomatoes, saute until soft, add salt, pepper and basil, mix quickly.  Add pasta, toss to coat.  Serve with grated parmesan or romano.

recipes.Blurb: This is a recipe from a very old GH cookbook.  It tastes like German potato salad, but is served cold, not hot.  Lovely!
recipes.Author: Good Housekeeping
recipes.Ingredients:
8  medium potatoes
5  slices bacon, diced
1  medium onion, minced
2 tbsp. flour
½ cup vinegar
½ cup water
2 tsp. salt
Speck pepper
½ cup diced celery
¼ cup chopped sweet pickle, with juice
4  hard-boiled eggs, shelled
French dressing, mayonnaise or salad dressing to moisten.
recipes.Procedure: Cook potatoes until tender.  Drain, cool or not as desired then peel and dice—there should be about 5 cups.  Saute the bacon and onion together in a skillet over low heat until bacon is browned and onion is tender.  Stir in the flour.  Then add the vinegar, water (you may also add a Tbsp. of juice from the sweet pickles, if used), salt and pepper and cook until mixture thickens, stirring constantly.  Remove from heat and pour over combined potatoes, celery, sweet pickle (if used) and eggs which have been diced.  Mix lightly with a fork and chill.  Just before serving, stir in enough salad dressing to moisten.  If preferred hot, omit chilling of potatoes and salad mixture.

recipes.Blurb: Use to coat fish for fish and chips
recipes.Author: Joy Of Cooking
recipes.Ingredients:
1½ cups all-purpose flour
1 tsp. salt
¼ tsp. pepper
1 tbsp. melted butter or cooking oil
1 tbsp. baking powder
2  beaten egg yolks
¾ cup water or flat beer
2  stiffly beaten egg whites
recipes.Procedure: Put into a bowl and mix well the flour, salt, pepper, oil, baking powder and egg yolks.  Add gradually, stirring constantly, the water or beer.  Allow the batter to rest covered in the refrigerator 3-12 hours.  Just before using add the 2 stiffly beaten egg whites.

recipes.Blurb: This was invented for Christmas 2000
recipes.Author: Aaron Scott
recipes.Ingredients:
2¼ cups all-purpose flour
1 cup sugar
1 cup bread crumbs
1 tsp. baking powder
1 tsp. salt
1 tsp. ground cinammon
½ tsp. ground cloves
1 cup butter
1 cup buttermilk
1  tart apple, peeled, cored and diced
1 cup fresh cranberries
½ cup candied fruit
½ cup dark molasses
½ cup chopped nuts (almonds, walnuts, pecans or any combination you like)
2  eggs
recipes.Procedure:
1) Heavily grease a 2½ qt bowl; cut foil with 1 inch overhang to cover bowl.  Grease well one side of the foil circle.  Set aside.
2) In a large bowl, combine flour, sugar, bread crumbs, baking powder, salt, cinammon and cloves.
3) With pastry blender, cut in 1 cup butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs; add cranberries, apple and candied fruit.
4) Stir in buttermilk, molasses and eggs.  Pour into prepared bowl.
5) Cover bowl with foil, greased side down and tie foil to bowl tightly with string.
6) Place metal trivet in a 12-qt pan.  Set bowl on trivet.  Pour water into pot until it rises to within 1 inch of top of bowl  Cover pot.
7) Over high heat, heat water to boiling.  Reduce heat to low and simmer 3½-5 hours or until a toothpick, inserted into pudding through foil, comes out clean.  During cooking, add water if needed to maintain water level.  Cooking time will be shorter near sea level; longer at high altitudes.
8) Cool the pudding in the bowl on a rack; invert onto plate.  Refrigerate or serve immediately, as desired.  Just before serving, pour brandy over pudding and ignite.  Serve with hard sauce.

recipes.Author: Denver Post
recipes.Ingredients:
2½  lb. roasting chicken
Salt and freshly ground pepper
3  small handfuls of fresh herbs (basil, parsley, marjoram), finely chopped
¼ cup olive oil
1  lemon,halved
4  bay leaves, torn
2  sprigs fresh rosemary
recipes.Procedure: Prheat oven and a roasting tray to 425º degrees.  Wash chicken inside and out and pat it as dry as possible with paper towels.  Rub the cavity with salt then, being very careful, grab the skin at the tip of the chicken breast and pull up gently.  With your other hand, gently separate the skin from the breast meat..  Sprinkle a little salt in the gaps and push in the chopped herbs.  Drizzle in a little olive oil.  Then stuff the chicken with  lemon, bay leaf and rosemary.  Pull the skin of the chicken breast forward so that none of the meat is exposed, tuck the winglets under and tie up as firmly as possible with kitchen twine. Rub a little olive oil into the skin of the chicken and season generously with salt and pepper.  Remove the hot tray from the oven and add a little oil.  Put the chicken on one side, breast side down, on the tray and put back in the oven.  Allow to cook for 5 minutes then turn it over on the other side for another 5 minutes then place the chicken on its back and cook 1 hour.

recipes.Author: Moosewood Restaurant
recipes.Ingredients:
½ lb. shrimp
2  cloves garlic, minced
2 tbsp. olive oil
1 cup diced tomatoes
½ cup feta cheese, crumbled
Juice of  1/2 lemon (about 1 oz)
2 tsp. fresh dill, chopped (3/4 tsp. dried)
dash salt
ground pepper
recipes.Procedure:
Shell and devein the shrimp, if necessary; rinse, set aside.  Have all ingredients ready before beginning to sauté.
Sauté the garlic in the oil briefly, then add the shrimp.  Cook on medium heat for a minute.  Add the tomatoes, feta, lemon juice and dill.  Stir so that the shrimp cooks on both sides.  When the shrimp are pink and the tomato and feta have made a nice sauce, it's ready.  Sprinkle with salt and pepper to taste and serve at once.

recipes.Author: The Vegetarian Epicu
recipes.Ingredients:
2  eggs
3 tbsp. flour
½ cup cream
1 cup milk
½ tsp. salt
¼ tsp. white pepper
1 tbsp. sugar
1½ cup fresh scraped corn (about 3 ears, frozen works fine)
3 tbsp. butter, melted
3 oz. sharp Cheddar cheese, grated
½ cup finely chopped chilis
recipes.Procedure: Beat the eggs and flour together to make a smooth paste, then beat in the cream, milk, salt, pepper and sugar.  Add the corn, melted butter, grated cheese and chopped chilis and stir the mixture together thoroughly. Pour the mixture into a buttered medium-sized cassarole and place the cassarole into a pan or larger cassarole which is about half full of water.  Bake the pudding for 50-55 minutes in an oven preheated to 350º.  It should be slightly puffed and golden on top.  Serve hot.

recipes.Ingredients:
Soup bones (you can use either lamb stew or the bones from any kind of roast)
¼ cup pearl barley
2  carrots, chopped
1  large onion, chopped
3  stalks celery, chopped
1 can tomatoes, chopped
Chopped parsley
recipes.Procedure: Cover bones with about 2 qts of cold water and bring to a boil; cover and simmer about 1½ hours.  Strain and cool.  When completely chilled, lift off fat, remove meat from bones and return to stock.  Bring to a boil, add barley and simmer 1½ hours or until barley is tender.  Add vegetables and cook another 30-40 minutes, or until vegetables are tender.  Add salt and pepper to taste.  You can add any other leftover vegetables you have on hand.  If desired, sprinkle a little parmesan cheese on top before serving.  If necessary, thin soup to desired consistency with added water.

recipes.RecipeName: Linguine With Sun-Dried Tomatoes And Olives
recipes.Blurb: Also good with bits of roasted chicken or pork.
recipes.Author: Williams-Sonoma
recipes.Ingredients:
¼ cup extra-virgin olive oil
2  cloves garlic, thinly sliced
1 cup thinly sliced sun-dried tomatoes
1 cup pitted and slivered olives (Gaeta or Kalmata—plain black also works)
½ cup white wine
1½ cup chicken broth
1½ cup heavy cream (we use dry nonfat milk mixed extra-thick)
Salt and freshly ground pepper to taste
1 lb. fresh or dried linguine
1  bunch green onions, chopped
1 cup fresh basil leaves cut into thin strips plus extra for garnish
Freshly grated Parmigiano-Reggiano cheese, to taste
recipes.Procedure: In a large saucepan over medium-high heat, warm olive oil.  Add garlic and sauté, stirring often, just until it begins to turn golden, about 1 min.  Add tomatoes and olives and sauté, stirring,a bout 1 min. more.  Add wine,broth and cream, bring to a simmer and cook until sauce is thick enough to coat a spoon, 12-15 min.  Adjust seasonings with salt and pepper.  Reduce heat to low and keep warm.  Meanwhile, bring a large pot two-thirds full of salted water to a boil.  Add pasta and cook, stirring occasionally until al dente.  Drain pasta and return to pot.  Stir green onions and 1 cup basil into sauce and cook 1 min.  Adjust seasonings with salt and pepper and pour sauce over pasta, tossing to combine.  Divide into 4 servings and garnish with remaining basil cnd cheese.  Serve immediately.

recipes.Blurb: We used habanero jack for this and it was terrific!
recipes.Author: Country Living
recipes.Ingredients:
1½ cups yellow cornmeal
1 tsp. salt
¼ tsp. baking soda
2  large eggs
¾ cup sour cream
¼ cup vegetable oil
1 can creamed corn (17-oz)
¾ cup grated pepper jack cheese
recipes.Procedure:
1. Preheat oven to 400º F.  Generously coat a 12-cup muffin tin with cooking spray and set aside.
2. In a large bowl, combine cornmeal, salt and baking soda and set aside.  In a small bowl, combine eggs, sour cream, oil, creamed corn and ½ cup of the cheese.  With a fork, stir the egg mixture into the flour mixture.
3. Evenly divide batter among the cups of the muffin tin.  Top muffins with remaining cheese.  Place on middle rack of oven and bake about 25 min. or until golde brown.  Remove muffins from tin and cool on wire rack Serve warm.

recipes.Author: Rosemary Robbins
recipes.Ingredients:
1  Pie Crust (store-bought)
⅓ cup extra-virgin olive oil
2  cloves garlic, thinly sliced (we use LOTS more)
Freshly ground pepper, to taste
8  plum tomatoes, sliced in 1/4ths
8 oz. Chevre (goat) cheese, crumbled
½ cup slivered fresh basil leaves
Sliced red onion, to taste
Yolk of 1 egg
recipes.Procedure:
Press pie crust into tart pan, trim to ½" around rim and fold in overhang.  Press to make sides thicker than bottom.  Coat crust with egg yolk and bake in 400º oven for 5 min.
In a nonstick pan over medium heat, warm 1/3 cup olive oil.  Add onion and sauté 1 min.  Add garlic and continue to sauté for 1 min. more.  Add salt, pepper and tomatoes and sauté until golden, 4-5 min.  Layer tomatoes, cheese and basil into crust and drizzle with pan juices.  Season with salt and pepper to taste.  Bake at 400º until crust is golden, about 40 min.

recipes.Author: Penzey's
recipes.Ingredients:
2 tbsp. Penzey's Greek Seasoning
2 tbsp. water
¼ cup olive oil
¼ cup salad oil
⅓ cup red wine vinegar or  1/4 cup balsamic vinegar plus 2 tbsp. water
1 tsp. sugar
recipes.Procedure: Mix greek salad dressing and 2 tbsp water and let stand 5 minutes.  Add oils, vinegar and sugar and mix.

recipes.Author: Penzery's
recipes.Ingredients:
2 cups heavy cream
1 cup whole milk
¾ cup sugar
2 tbsp. cocoa powder
⅛ tsp. salt
recipes.Procedure: Scald milk and cream.  In a separage bowl combine sugar, cocoa and salt,  Stir dry ingredients to combine and break up any lumps in the cocoa.  Add dry ingredients to scalded liquid and stir with a whisk until dissolved. Refrigerate for 2 hours.  Freeze accoring to ice cream freezer instructions.

recipes.Author: Penzey's
recipes.Ingredients:
1 lb. canned green beans
1  small red onion, peeled and minced
1 cup cherry tomatoes, quartered
½ cup crumbled feta cheese
Greek salad dressing
recipes.Procedure: Rinse green beans and mix in a bowl with Greek salad dressing and refrigerate until ready to serve.  Just before serving, add quartered tomatoes and half the feta cheese and toss to combine.  Sprinkle the rest of the cheese on top of the salad and serve.

recipes.Author: Penzey's
recipes.Ingredients:
1½ cup granulated sugar
½ cup butter, softened
1 tbsp. lemon extract
1 tbsp. vanilla extract
4  eggs
1 tsp. minced lemon peel, rehydrated in 1 tbsp. water
½ cup sour cream
¼ cup blue poppy seeds
2 cups all-purpose flour
2 tsp. baking powder
½ tsp. salt
¾ cup milk
recipes.Procedure: Preheat oven to 350º.  Put 24 cupcake papers into muffin pan and set aside.  With a hand mixer, beat together the butter and sugar until well blended.  Add the lemon and vanilla extract and eggs and beat until fluffy.  Mix in the lemon peel, sour cream and poppy seeds.  In a separate bowl, sift together the flour, baking powder and salt.  Gradually add the flour mixture to the poppy seed batter, alternating with the milk  Beat after each addition and scrape the sides of the bowl.  The batter will be thick and fluffy.  Using a spoon, fill the cupcake papers 2/3 full. Bake at 350º for 24 minutes, switching the pans on the rack after 12 minutes.  Check after 20 minutes to see if they are done (they should spring back when you touch them).  Cool on a wire rack.

recipes.Ingredients:
1  box (16 oz.) rotelle or other spiral-shaped pasta
1 can (14 oz.) artichoke hearts, drained and halved
1  large sweet red pepper, chopped (1 cup)
2  packages (10 oz. each) frozen brocolli florets, thawed and drained.
½ cup olive oil
¼ cup lemon juice
2  large cloves garlic, crushed
½ tsp. salt
¼ tsp. black pepper
recipes.Procedure:
1. Combine olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, salt and pepper in a small bowl.
2. Cook rotelle in boiling salted water following package directions.  Drain.
3. Combine pasta, artichokes, red pepper and dressing in a large bowl.  Refrigerate for at least one hour or until serving time.  To prevent brocolli from turning yellow, add brocolli just before serving.

recipes.Ingredients:
2 tbsp. vegetable oil
2 tbsp. cider vinegar
2 tbsp. sugar
½ tsp. salt
few grains pepper
4 cups sliced celery
1  large red pimento, from can or jar, diced
4  small ripe tomatoes, diced
recipes.Procedure: Mix dressing, add to vegetables, toss.

recipes.RecipeName: Warm Potatoes Vinigarette Wth Garlic And Rosemary
recipes.Ingredients:
2  lbs.small red potatoes, scrubbed
4  large cloves garlic, unpeeled
1½ tsp. drived rosemary
1 tbsp. rice vinegar
2 tsp. country-style Dijon mustard
4 tbsp. lemon juice
4 tbsp. olive oil
2  medium ribs celery, minced
1  large shallot, peeled and minced
freshly ground pepper to taste
recipes.Procedure:
1. If the potatoes are large, cut in half.  Place the potatoes and garlic in a steamer basket set over boiling water, cover and steam about 20-25 min. or until tender.  Remove the garlic; set the potatoes aside.
2. In a small saucepan, combine the rosemary and vinegar and place over medium-low heat for about 5 minutes to soften the rosemary.
3. Sqeeze the garlic out of the skins into a food processor or blender.  Add the mustard and purée.  Add the rosemary with the vinegar and lemon juice to the garlic.  Process to blend.  Slowly add the olive oil.
4. Slice the potatoes.  Combine in a bowl with the dressing, celery, shallot and lots of black pepper.  Serve warm.

recipes.Ingredients:
1  head chicory, washed, dried and torn into bite-size pieces (1 qt.)
2  medium-sized cucumbers, peeled and sliced thin
2  large tomatoes, each cut into 12 wedges
16  Greek olives, or black ripe olives
5  green onions or scallions, sliced ( 1/2 cup)
6  flat anchovy fillets, drained
4 oz. feta cheese, crumbled (1 cup)
½ cup olive oil
3 tbsp. red wine vinegar
½ tsp. dried oregano or mint leaves
¼ tsp. salt
¼ tsp. pepper
recipes.Procedure: In a large salad bowl, arrange chicory, cucumbers, tomatoes, olives, green onions and anchovies.  Sprinkle with cheese.  Put the olive oil, vinegar, oregano, salt and pepper in a screw-top jar.  Cover jar and shake dressing.  Pour over salad mixture and toss.  Serve immediately.

recipes.Ingredients:
1 tbsp. vegetable oil
1  large onion, finely chopped
1  clove garlic, finely chopped
2 cups cauliflower florets, chopped
2  medium-sized carrots, pared and chopped
1 cup fresh or thawed frozen peas
2 oz. shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese
1 cup part-skim ricotta cheese
¼ cup grated Parmesan cheese
2  egg whites
¼ tsp. salt
¼ tsp. pepper
⅛ tsp. ground nutmeg
packaged pastry for two 9-inch pie shells
recipes.Procedure:
1. Preheat oven to 400º.  Lighly grease cookie sheet.
2. Heat oil in large skillet over medium heat.  Add onion; sauté 3 minutes.  Add garlic; sauté 1 minute.  Add cauliflower and carrots; sauté 5 minutes.  Stir in peas; cook 1 minute. Set aside to cool slightly.
3. Combine mozzarella, ricotta, Parmesan, egg, salt, pepper and nutmeg in large bowl.  Stir in vegetable mixture.
4. Roll pastry into two 11-inch rounds.  Spoon half of vegetable mixture over half of one round; fold other side over.  Pinch edges together to seal; crimp edge.  Prick turnover with fork.  Transfer to greased baking sheet.  Repeat with remaining pastry and vegetable mixture.
5. Bank in 400º oven for 30 minutes or until golden.  Serve warm.

recipes.Ingredients:
1  Whole chicken, cut up
½ cup chardonnay or other dry white wine
¼ cup olive oil
1 tsp. worcestershire sauce
1 tsp. dried basil
2  cloves garlic, minced
dash cayenne
recipes.Procedure: In a small bowl, blend all ingredients except the chicken.  Place chicken in large plastic bag; pour in marinade and toss to coat chicken.  Refrigerate several hours or overnight, turning occasionally. Heat grill or oven broiler.  Remove chicken from marinade.  Place chicken on lightly oiled grilling rack 6-8 inches from medium-hot coals. Grill 12-20 minutes per side or until chicken is done (meat thermometer inserted into thickest part of thigh should register 180º).

recipes.Ingredients:
1  pre-made pie crust (15 oz.)
1½ cups cubed cooked ham
6 oz. (1 1/2 cups) shredded swiss cheese.
1 cup frozen brocolli florets, thawed and drained.
4  eggs
1 cup milk
½ tsp. salt
½ tsp. dry mustard
½ tsp. pepper
recipes.Procedure:
1. Heat oven to 375º.  Prepare pie crust as indicated on package for one 9-in pie using glass pie pan.
2.  Layer ham, cheese and brocolli in crust-lined pan.  In medium bowl, combine all remaining ingredients; beat well.  pour over brocolli.
3.  Bake at 375º for 35-45 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.  Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.Ingredients:
1  14 1/2 oz. can Italian-style stewed tomatoes.
2 tbsp. brown sugar
1 tbsp. minced dried onion
1 tbsp. white vinegar
1 tbsp. molasses
1 tsp. garlic powder
½ tsp. ground cumin
½ tsp. paprika
½ tsp. pepper
dash salt
1  16-oz can whole berry cranberry sauce
recipes.Procedure:
In a blender container combine tomatoes, grown sugar, onion, vinegar, molasses, garlic powder, cumin, paprika, pepper and salt.  Cover and blend until slightly chunky.
Transfer to a medium saucepan.  Stir in cranberry sauce.  Bring to boiling; reduce heat, simmer, uncovered about 10 minutes or until sauce reaches desired consistencey, stirring occassionally..  Brush over ribs, chicken or chopes during the last 10-15 minutes of grilling.

recipes.Ingredients:
Cooking oil
1 lb. asparagus spears
12  plum tomatoes, cored and halved lengthwise
2 tbsp. olive oil
salt and pepper
¾ cup milk
1 tbsp. butter or margarine
2  egg yolks, beaten
2 tsp. Dijon mustard
dash cayenne
10 oz. extra-sharp cheddar cheese, finely shredded (2 1/2 cups)
6  thick slices sourdough bread
2  cloves garlic, peeled and halved
fresh parsley sprigs
recipes.Procedure:
1.  Preheat oven to 450º.  Line a 15x10x1-inch baking pan with foil and oil the foil well.  Set aside.
2.  Wash asparagus and break off woody bases where spears snap easily.  Scrape off scales.  Place tomato halves, cut side up, and asparagus spears on prepared pan.  Drizzle with the olive oil; sprinkle lightly with salt and pepper.  Roast uncovered for 15 min. or until aspargus is crisp-tender and tomatoes are heated through.
3.  Meanwhile, for Rarebit Sauce, in a medium saucepan heat milk and butter over medium heat.  Gradually add hot milk mixture into beaten egg yolks, stirring constantly; stir in mustard and cayenne.  Return mixture to saucepan.  Contiune to heat, stirring constantly until mixture coats a metal spoon.  Stir in cheese, a handful at a time, stirring until melted after each addition.  When all the cheese has been added, continue to heat for 1-2 min more or until smooth, stirring constantly.  Do not boil.
4.  Toast the bread; rub one surface of each slice with the cut side of a garlic clove.  Transfer toast to serving plates, garlic side up.  Top each toast slice with 4 tomato halves and several of the asparagus spears.  Spoon hot rarebit sauce over tomatoes and top with a sprig of parsley.  Serve immediately.

recipes.Ingredients:
¾  lb. fresh spinach
¼  lb. mushrooms
3 tbsp. butter
1 cup chopped onions
2 tsp. chopped garlic
2 tsp. salt
