freshly ground pepper
3  whole skinless boned chicken breasts
½ cup finely chopped carrots
½ cup finely chopped celery
½ cup dry white wine
½ cup chicken stock
½ cup whole, peeled and cored tomatoes (fresh or canned)
1  bay leaf
1½ tsp. dried thyme
recipes.Procedure:
1.  Pick over the spinach and discard any tough stems.  Wash and rinse.
2.  Slice and coarsely chop the mushroons and set aside.  There should be about 1 3/4 cups.
3.  Melt 1 tbsp of the butter in a skillet.  Add ½ cup of the onions, 1 tsp of the garlic and ½ cup of the chopped mushrooms.  Cook for 2 min. and add the spinach, ½ tsp of the salt and pepper.  Cook over high heat while stirring for about 5 min., by which time all the moisture should have evaporated.  Set aside and cool.
4.  Split each chicken breast into halves.  Trim away and discard any fat or membrane.  Pound lightly with a meat pounder or cleaver on a flat surface.  Spoon an equal amount of the filling down the center of each breast half.
5.  Bring up the edges of the breast, folding over the edges to enclose the filling and make a package.  Tie each bundle in two places with string.
6.  Melt the remaining butter in a skillet large enough to hold all the chicken and brown them all  over, about 8 min.
7.  Remove the chicken and add the remaining onions, mushrooms and garlic.  Cook briefly and add the carrots and celery.  Stirring, cook for 3-4 min.  Return the chicken rolls to the pan.  Add the wine, stock, tomatoes, bay leave, thyme and remaining salt and pepper.  Bring to a boil, cover and cook for 15 min. or until the chicken is tender.
8.  Remove the chicken rolls and reduce the sauce by half.  Discard the strings.  Spoon sauce over chicken and serve hot, perhaps with rice.

recipes.Ingredients:
4 oz. cream cheese, softened
1 tsp. dried sage
8  slices pumpernickel bread, toasted
1 lb. smoked or roast turkey breast, sliced thinly
½ cup Fresh Cranberry Compote (recipe follows)
8  lettuce leaves
12 oz. whole fresh cranberries
1  orange, quartered
½ cup chopped pecans
½ cup sugar
recipes.Procedure:
In a small bowl, combine cream cheese and sage until well blended.  Spread each slice of bread with 1 tbsp cream cheese mixture.  On 4 of the slices place ¼ lb. turkey, 2 tbsp Fresh Cranberry Compote and 2 lettuce leaves.  Top each sandwich with the remaining slices of bread.

Fresh Cranberry Compote: In the bowl of a food processor with the metal blade combine the cranberries, orange, pecans and sugar and chop until coarse.  Cover and refrigerate for up to 4 days.

recipes.Ingredients:
½ cup mayonnaise
1  hard-boiled egg, grated
1 tbsp. tomato paste
1 tbsp. sweet relish
1 tbsp. lemon or lime juice
2 tsp. chopped capers, drained
½ tsp. Tabasco sauce
⅛ tsp. cayenne pepper
recipes.Procedure: In a small bowl, use a wooden spoon to combine all ingredients until well blended.  Store refrigerated in an airtight container for up to 4 days.

recipes.Ingredients:
1 tbsp. olive oil
4  skinless chicken thighs
salt and pepper
1  large onion, chopped (1 cup)
2 cups thinly sliced fresh mushrooms
2  cloves garlic, minced
2  bay leaves
¾ cup chicken broth
¾ cup dry white wine or chicken broth
2 tsp. fresh thyme or  1/2 tsp. dried thyme, crushed
¼ tsp. salt
⅔ cup half and half or light cream
2 tbsp. all-purpose flour
8 oz. dried lemon pepper or plain linguine or penne pasta
recipes.Procedure:
1.  In a large saucepan heat the oil.  Add chicken and brown 3-4 min. on each side.  Sprinkle with salt and pepper.  Transfer to a plate.
2.  Add onion, mushrooms and garlic to pan.  Cook 5 min. stirring occasionally.  Return chicken to pan.  Add bay leaves, broth, wine, thyme and ¼ tsp salt.  Bring to a boild and reduce heat.  Cover and simmer gently for 30 min.  Remove chicken; cover and keep warm.  Remove and discard bay leaves.
3.  In a small bowl whisk cream and flour together until smooth.  Add to liquid in pan.  Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly; cook and stir 1 min. more.  Add additional pepper to taste.  Meanwhile cook pasta according to package directions.
4.  Drain pasta; place in a serving dish and top with chicken.  Spoon sauce over chicken and pasta.  Top with fresh thyme if desired.

recipes.Ingredients:
4 tbsp. olive oil
4  garlic cloves, finely minced
1 tsp. red pepper flakes
1 tsp. paprika
1 lb. medium shrimp peeled and deveined
1 tbsp. fresh lemon juice
1 tbsp. dry sherry
salt and pepper to taste
fresh baguette for serving
recipes.Procedure: Position rack 3-4" under broiler and preheat.  Place 2 tapas pans under broiler; preheat up to 5 min.  In a bowl, toss together oil, garlic, pepper flakes, paprika, shrimp, lemon juice, sherry, salt and pepper.  Immediately and carfully divide shrimp mixture among preheated pans.  Broil until shrimp are lightly golden, pink and opaque throughout, 4-5 min.  Serve immediately with fresh baguette.

recipes.Ingredients:
3  heads garlic (about 40 cloves)
2 tbsp. olive or cooking oil
1 tbsp. plus 1 tsp. fresh lemon thyme or thyme or 1 tsp. dried thyme, crushed
1 tsp. cracked black pepper
¼ tsp. salt
1  3-3 1/2 lb. whole broiler-fryer chicken
1  medium onion, cut into wedges
2 cups fat-free or regular half and half
2 tbsp. all-purpose flour
¼ tsp. salt
⅛ tsp. pepper
recipes.Procedure:
1.  Preheat oven to 375º.  Peel away papery leaves from heads of garlic, leaving skins of cloves intact.  Separate cloves.  Peel and mince 4 cloves.  Set aside remaining cloves.
2.  In a small bowl combine minced garlic with 1 tbsp of the olive oil, 1 tbsp thyme, cracked black pepper and ¼ tsp salt.  Rub minced garlic mixture over chicken.
3.  Place 6 cloves garlic into the cavity of the chicken.  Tie legs to tail.  Twist wing tips under back.  Place onion wedges and remaining garlic cloves in the bottom of a shallow roasting pan.  Drizzle onion and garlic with remaining olive oil
4.  Place chicken, breast side up, on top of the onion wedges and garlic cloves in roasting pan.  Insert meat thermometer into center of an inside thigh, avoiding the bone.  Roast uncovered for 1¼-1½ hours or until drumsticks move easily in their sockets and meat thermometer registers 180º.
5.  Remove chicken from oven.  Using a slotted spoon remove onion wedges and garlic cloves from pan.  Reserve 2-3 onion wedges for garnish.  Cover chicken loosely with foil; let stand before carving.
6.  Carefully squeeze 10 cloves of the roasted garlic from skins into a blender container or food processor bowl.  Add remaining roasted onion wedges and ¼ cup of the half-and-half.  Cover and blend until smooth.  Transfer to a small saucepan.  Stir in flour.  Add remaining half-and-half, 1 tsp fresh thyme, ¼ tsp salt and 1/8 tsp pepper to mixture in saucepan.  Cook and stir over medium heat until slightly thickened and bubbly.  Cook and stir 1 min more.
7.  Serve chicken with gravy, remaining roasted garlic cloves, reserved onion wedges and the fresh thyme sprigs if desired.

recipes.Blurb: Single batch
recipes.Author: Dennis Obrien
recipes.Ingredients:
2  Tbsp olive oil
3  cloves garlic
2 tsp. dry basil
2 tsp. dry parsley
1  large yellow onion, diced
1 lb. ground meat (prion-free)
1 can tomato paste (6 oz)
1 can tomato sauce (8 oz)
1-3/4 cup water
1 tsp. butter
1 tsp. salt
recipes.Procedure:
Grill garlic in oil to golden brown (do NOT burn)
Add onion and lightly brown
Sprinkle in herbs
Add ground meat and brown
Add tomato paste and 6 oz water
Add tomato sauce and 8 oz water
Mix in butter
Salt to taste

recipes.Ingredients:
3 cups dry white wine
1 cup (about 1 medium) chopped onion
½ cup (about 1 small) sliced carrot
½ cup (about 1 stalk) sliced celery
3  cloves garlic, chopped
2 tbsp. olive oil
1 tbsp. fresh whole parsley leaves
8  whole black peppercorns
½ tsp. salt
6  lbs.assorted chicken pieces
4  slices bacon, chopped
1 tbsp. olive oil
12  small white onions, peeled
2 cups carrots, peeled and cut into 1-in. chunks
1 cup sliced celery
3  cloves garlic, chopped
1  shallot, chopped
¼ cup all-purpose flour
3 cups chicken broth
1 tbsp. balsamic vinegar
1  bay leaf
1 tsp. fresh thyme
½ tsp. salt
¼ tsp. ground black peppr
1 lb. small red potatoes
recipes.Procedure:
1. Prepare marinade: combine first 9 ingredients (white wine, onion, carrot, celery, garlic, oil, parsley, peppercorns and salt) in a 3-qt saucepan.  Bring to a boil over medium-high heat.  Reduce heat to low and simmer 5 minutes. Remove from heat and let marinade cool to room temperature.
2. Arrange chicken pieces in a large bowl and pour cooled marinade over them.  Cover and refrigerate at least 4 hours or overnight.
3.  Prepare Coq au Vin: Remove chicken from marinade and pat dry.  Strain maridade and reserve liquid.  Discard the vegetables.
4.  In a 6-qt Dutch oven, cook bacon over medium heat until crisp.  Using a slotted spoon, transfer to paper towels.  Brown chicken in bacon drippings.  Remove chicken from Dutch oven and discard all but 1 tbsp fat.  Add olive oil and onions; sauté onions until lightly browned.  Add carrots, celery, garlic and shallot.  Sauté 5 min. longer.
5.  In a medium bowl, combine the reserved marinade liquid and the flour.  Add mixutre to the Dutch oven with the chicken broth, vinegar, bay leaf, thyme, salt and pepper.  Return chicken to the Dutch oven and cook, covered, for 45 min.  Add potatoes and cook until potatoes are fork-tender—about 20 minutes more.  Divide the mixture evenly among six serving bowls.  Garnish each serving with the reserved chopped bacon.

recipes.Author: Joy Of Cooking
recipes.Ingredients:
8  qts green tomatoes
12  large onions
1 cup coarse salt
12  green peppers
6  sweet red peppers
3  qts cider vinegar
12  cloves garlic, minced
2  lbs.brown sugar
2 tbsp. dry mustard
2 tbsp. whole cloves
2  sticks cinnamon
2 tbsp. powdered ginger
1 tbsp. salt
1 tbsp. celery seed
recipes.Procedure: Wash and cut tomatoes into thin slices.  Peel and cut onions into thin slices. Place in a large bowl and sprinkle with the 1 cup of coarse salt.  Cover and let stand for 12 hours.  Wash in clear water and drain.  Heat cider vinegar to boiling and add the green and red peppers, sliced thinly, garlic and brown sugar.  Add the tomatoes and onions.  Tie mustard, cloves, cinnamon, ginger, salt and celery seed into a cloth bag and add to mixture.  Simmer until tomatoes are transparent, about 1 hour.  Briefly process in blender, pour into sterile jars and seal.  Makes about 6 qts.

recipes.Author: Denise Rowtham
recipes.Ingredients:
2 cups all-purpose flour
1 tbsp. baking powder
½ tsp. salt
½ cup milk
⅓ cup cooking oil
6  eggs, slightly beaten
1 cup cream-style cottage cheese
½ cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese (2 oz.)
½ cup shredded mozzarella cheese (2 oz.)
2 oz. cooked ham, chopped
2 oz. salami, chopped
2 tbsp. sliced green onion
2 tbsp. fresh Italian parsley
recipes.Procedure: Preheat oven to 350º.  In a medium mixing bowl stir together flour, baking powder and salt.  Make a well in the center of the dry ingredients.  In a small bowl combine milk and oil.  Add liquid ingredients all at once; stir until moistened.  Turn out onto a lightly floured surface.  Quickly knead dough by gently folding and pressing dough 10-12 strokes or until nearly smooth.  On a lightly floured surface roll dough to a 12-inch circle.  Line a 9-inch pie plate with dough.  Fold under extra pastry; crimp edge as desired.  For filling, in a medium mixing bowl stir together eggs, cottage cheese, shredded cheeses, ham, salami, green onion and parsley.  Pour into unbaked crust.  Bake for 50-55 minutes or until a knife inserted near the center comes out clean.  If necessary, cover edge of crust with foil during baking to prevent overbrowning.  Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.Ingredients:
2½  to 3 lbs.frying chicken pieces
¾ cup all-purpose flour
1½ tsp. salt
1 tsp. pepper
1 tsp. paprika
½ tsp. onion powder
½ tsp. rubbed sage
¼ tsp. garlic powder
1  egg
2 tbsp. water
1 cup olive oil
recipes.Procedure: Rinse chicken and pat dry.  In bag, combine flour and seasonings.  In shallow bowl, beat egg with water.  Shake chicken, one piece at a time in flour mixture until coated.  Dip in egg then shake again in flour mixture until completely coated.  In heavy bottom skillet heat olive oil to 375º.  Fry chicken, skin side down for 12 min.  Turn and fry 10 min., covered, then 3-5 min. uncovered or until chicken is tender and juices run clear.

recipes.RecipeName: Veal Scallopini In Lemon Caper Sauce
recipes.Ingredients:
½  lb. thinly sliced veal cutlets
salt and pepper to taste.
All-purpose flour
3 tbsp. olive oil
¼ cup chicken broth
2 tbsp. lemon juice
2 tbsp. dry white wine
2 tsp. sugar
1½ tbsp. capers, drained
recipes.Procedure: Sprinkle veal with salt and pepper; coat lightly with flour.  In large skillet, sauté veal quickly in hot oil until cooked through.  Remove veal to platter; set aside in warm place.  Add 1 tsp. flour to drippings to skillet and cook, stirring constantly, 1 min.  Stir remaining ingredients into skillet and cook, stirring constantly, until sauce is smooth and slighly thickened.  Pour sauce over veal and serve.

recipes.Blurb: This soup is featured daily in the U.S. Senate cafeteria.  If it's good enough for them...
recipes.Ingredients:
1 lb. dry beans
1  Ham bone
1 cup cooked mashed potatoes (optional)
3  onions, finely chopped.
1  small bunch celery, including tops, finely chopped
2  cloves garlic, minced
¼ cup chopped parsley
recipes.Procedure: Soak beans overnight in cold water and cover.  Drain and put in kettle with ham bone.  Bring water to a boil and simmer 2 hrs.  Sitr in mashed potatoes if desired (we omit these in preference of a thinner soup) and add onions, celery, garlic and parsley.  Simmer for 1 hour longer until beans are thoroughly cooked.  Remove ham bone from kettle, dice meat on it and return meat to soup.  Note:  we like this but found it necessary to add ground black pepper, marjoram and beef bouillon to "soup" up the flavor.  Then we loved it!  Try your own variations as suit the palate.

recipes.Ingredients:
½ cup olive oil
½ cup red wine vinegar
1½ tsp. garlic powder
1½ tsp. basil
1½ tsp. oregano
¾ tsp. pepper
¾ tsp. sugar
8 oz. spiral pasta cooked and drained
3 cups thickly slied mushrooms
15  cherry tomatoes, halved
1  8 3/4 oz. can garbanzo beans, drained
1 cup julienned red bell pepper strips
¾ cup crumbled feta cheese
½ cup chopped green onions
1  3 1/2 oz. can whole black olives, drained
¾ cup sliced pepperoni, cut into thin strips
recipes.Procedure: In a large bowl, whisk together oil, vinegar, garlic powder, basil, oregano, pepper and sugar.  Add remaining ingredients and toss until well-coated.  Cover and chill 2 hours or overnight.

recipes.Ingredients:
½ cup olive oil
¼ cup cider vinegar
1  large clove garlic, minced
1 tbsp. minced green onion
1 tbsp. minced red pepper or pimento
1½ tsp. sugar
¾ tsp. salt
⅛ tsp. basil
⅛ tsp. pepper
⅛ tsp. oregano
⅛ tsp. thyme
recipes.Procedure: In a jar with a tightly fitting lid, place all ingredients and shake until well mixed.  Let stand 1 hour before serving.

recipes.Ingredients:
8 cups all-purpose flour
1⅓ cups non-fat dry milk
1 tbsp. salt
5 tbsp. double-acting baking powder
1 cup margarine, butter or solid shortening
recipes.Procedure:
Cobmine all ingredients except shortening in a large bowl and mix well.  Work in shortening with fingertips until very fine.  Store in air-tight container in cool dry place.  Makes 11 cups.
To make biscuits, mix 2 3/4 cup mix with 3/4 cup cold water and mix into a soft dough.  Roll to desired thickness and cut with biscuit cutter.  Bake at 450º for 10 minutes or until golden.

recipes.Ingredients:
½ cup milk
2 tbsp. margarine or butter, cut into small pieces
½ cup flour
2  eggs
½ cup (2 oz) shredded sharp cheddar cheese
4  bacon slices, cooked and crumbled
¼ cup chopped green onion
¼ tsp. garlic salt
¼ tsp. coarse ground pepper
recipes.Procedure:
1.  Heat oven to 350º.  Bring milk and butter to a boil over medium heat.  Add flour all at once, stirring constantly until mixture forms a ball and leaves the sides of the pan.  Remove from heat.
2. Add eggs, one at a time stirring constantly until mixture is smooth.  Add remaining ingredients.
3. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto a greased foil-lined cookie sheet.
4. Bake 25 minutes or until puffed and golden brown.  Wrap securely to freeze.  To reheat, heat oven to 350º; bake 5-8 minutes or until thorougly heated.

recipes.Author: Nestle
recipes.Ingredients:
2 tbsp. butter or margarine
¼ cup chopped onion
¼ cup all-purpose flour
1 can (14  1/2 oz.) chicken broth
1 can (12 oz.) evaporated milk
2  large or 3 medium potatoes, baked
Salt and ground pepper to taste
2  strips bacon, cooked and crumbled
½ cup (2 oz) cheddar cheese, grated
3 tbsp. green onion
recipes.Procedure:
1. Melt butter in large saucepan over medium heat.  Add onion; cook, stirring occasionally, for 1-2 minutes or until tender.  Stir in flour.  Gradually stir in borth and evaporated milk.
2. Scoop pulp from one potato; mash.  Add pulp to broth mixture.  Cook over medium heat until mixture just comes to a boil.  Dice remaining potato (with skins) and add to soup.  Heat through.
3.  Season with slat and pepper.  Top each serving with bacon, cheese and green onion.

recipes.Author: Penzeys
recipes.Ingredients:
2  lbs.beef stew meat
3  medium yellow onions
7  average-size white potatoes
6  baby carrots
3 tbsp. vegetable oil
2 tbsp. Hungarian sweet paprika (use less if using half-sharp paprika)
¼ tsp. cayenne pepper (use less if you prefer less "bite")
2  bay leaves
1 tsp. salt
8 cups water
freshly ground black pepper to taste
recipes.Procedure: Cube beef in 1-in pieces.  Peel and slice onions into thin rounds.  Chop carrots coarsely.  Heat a large pan over high heat, add 1 tbsp of the vegetable oil and swirl to coat.  Add onions and carrots, cook until lightly browned, about 5 min. stirring often.  Remove to a soup pot.  Add another tbsp of the oil.  Add half of the beef.  It is important not to crowd the pieces, so  browning is best down in two batches.  Brown beef for about 5 min (it doesn't have to be brown on all sides).  Add 1-1½ tbsp paprika, stir to coat beef and somewhat fry the paprika for 1 min.  Remove beef to soup pot, scraping up paprika.  Heat final tbsp of oil, add second batch of beef, brown, add rest of paprika and the cayenne, fry an extra minute and remove to soup pot.  Add 8-10 cups water to soup pot.  Pour ½ cup into the fry pan and scrape up the browned bits and pur into pot.  Add the bay leaves, bring soup to a simmer and simmer 1 hour.  Peel and cut potatoes, add to soup along  with salt (this soup needs a fair amount).  Start with 1 tsp but taste before serving and adjust if necessary.  Raise heat to medium.  The soup should not quite boil.  Cook another 45 min.  Serve with a simple salad and (this is very important) fresh crusty bread or rolls.  Make sure there is a pepper grinder on the table so each person can grind a generous amount of pepper on top of their bowl.

recipes.Author: Penzeys
recipes.Ingredients:
4  large baking potatoes
2 tbsp. herbs, ground and mixed: shallots, chives, green peppercorns, dill weed, basil, tarragon, chervil and bay leaf
2 tsp. water
1 cup plain yogurt
½ tsp. salt (optional)
recipes.Procedure: Preheat oven to 350º.  Scrub potatoes, begin careful not to rub the skin off.  Bake for 1 hour.  Mix herbs with water, let stand 10 minutes.  Blend spice and water mixture with yogurt, add salt if desired and set aside.  remove potatoes from oven when hour is up; they should yield to gentle pressure.  If not, cook an extra 10 minutes.  Cup an oval hole in the top of the potato and carefull scoop out the contents into a bowl, taking care not to break the skin.  Mash the potatoes with the seasoned yogurt and put back into potatoes, replacing the top.  Bake the potatoes 20-30 minutes more.  Turn the oven up to broil the last 5 minutes to cause the tops to puff up and the potato to turn brown and crispy.

recipes.Author: Penzeys
recipes.Ingredients:
2  lbs.chicken meat (bone your own and use the scraps for stock)
1  8-oz package bow-tie noodles
1 tbsp. vegetable oil
1  medium onion, peeled and diced (about 1 cup)
2  carrots, peeled and diced (about 1 cup)
2  stalks celery, diced (about 1 cup)
1 tbsp. sweet basil
1 tbsp. marjoram
2  quarts chicken stock
1 tsp. salt if the chicken stock is unsalted
1 tsp. black pepper
recipes.Procedure: Cook the noodles according to the package instructions, drain and set aside. Remove skin and bones from chicken (save for stock) and cut meat into bite-sized pieces. In a large pan, heat oil over medium high heat and brown the chicken for 2-3 minutes. Remove chicken to soup pot. Add onion, carrot and celery to the pan the chicken was cooked in and sauté for2-3 min. Add the basil and marjoram i the last minute, stirring regularly. Put the vegetables into the soup pot, check stock salt (if needed) and pepper. Simmer over low heat for about an hour, adding the noodles in the final 15 min. Do not boil or the chicken will be tough and the noodles will fall apart.

recipes.Author: Penzeys
recipes.Ingredients:
2  lbs.THINLY sliced round steak
1  large onion
8 oz. plain bread crumbs (about 2 cups)
⅔ cup grated parmensan or romano cheese
3 tbsp. sweet basil
1 tbsp. salt
1 tsp. ground black pepper
½ tsp. granulated garlic
½ cup olive oil
4  large skewers
recipes.Procedure: Cut the meat into pieces of roughly the same size.  Cut and peel the onions, cut in half and remove the core.  Peel of the outer layer or two and chop into large pieces to be threaded onto the skewers between the spiedini.  Slice the remaining halves into wedges to be rolled up inside the spiedini.  Prehat oven to broil (low, if possible).  Place rack closest to broiler.  On a large rimmed plattter, place bread crumbs, cheese, basil, salt, pepper and garlic.  Mix lightly by hand until combined.  Pour about ½ cup olive oil into a second plate with a rim.  Dip the meat in olive oil to coat, using as little as possible.  Dip into breading mixture, covering meat thoroughly.  Once meat is all breaded, roll them up by placing a thin wedge of onion on top of one end of the meat and roll away.  Ideally the ends of the onion should "peek" out from each end of the roll.  Once rolled, thread each spiedini onto the skewers.  Place one of the chopped onion pieces between each spiedini.  Should fill about 4 skewers.  Place skewers on a broiler pan, not touching, and broil close to flame for 5 minutes, or until they are nice and brown on top.  Carefully flip skewers and broil other side 3-4 minutes.  Remove from oven and grab end of skewer, place over a serving platter and push spiedini off onto the platter.  Serve with pasta or mashed potatoes.

recipes.Author: Alison Kane
recipes.Ingredients:
3 cups cooked basmati rice
1  large tomato, seeded and chopped (2/3 cup)
¾ cup chopped sweet onion
3 tbsp. fresh cilantro
3 tbsp. lemon juice
2 tbsp. seeded and finely chopped fresh jalapeno pepper
2 tbsp. olive oil
½ tsp. salt
¼ tsp. ground black pepper
1  avacado, chopped
2 tbsp. lime juice
shredded romaine lettuce
lime wedges
recipes.Procedure: In a large bowl combine rice, tomato, onion, cilantro, lemon juice, jalapeno pepper, olive oil, salt and pepper.  Toss avacado with lime juice and stir into the rice mixture.  Cover and chill for 2-8 hours.  Spoon mixture on top of shredded romaine lettuce.  Serve with lime wedges.

recipes.Ingredients:
1  chicken, 3 ½ to 4 lbs, rinsed
1  large onion, thinly sliced
3  stalks celery, sliced
3  medium carrots, sliced
3  cloves garlic, minced
4  sprigs parsley
2  dried bay leaves
2 tsp. dried thyme leaves
1 tsp. coriander
½ tsp. black peppercorns
½ tsp. whole allspice
¼  lb. wide egg noodles
1  package (10 oz) frozen petit peas
Salt
recipes.Procedure: Remove and discard chicken skin. Place chicken in a 6-8 qt pan. Add onion, celery, carrots, garlic, parsley, bay, thyme, coriander, pepper, allspice and 2 qts water. Cover and bring to a boil over high heat; reduce heat and simmer gently until chicken is no longer pink at bone in thigh (about 1 hour). Remove pan from heat, lift out chicken and set on a plate. Discard parsley. If making ahead, let broth cool uncovered, then cover and chill until cold or up to 1 day. Skim or lift chilled fat from broth and discard. When chicken is cool, pull meat from bones. Discard bones and any skin. Tear meat into bite-size pieces. If making ahead, cover and chill meat up to 1 day. Cover soup and bring to a boil on high heat. Add noodles, cook until tender, 6-8 min. Stir in peas and chicken and heat through, 3-4 minutes. Add salt to taste and serve.

recipes.Ingredients:
1  chicken, 3 1/2-4lbs, rinsed
6 cups cooked basmati rice
1  large onion, thinly sliced
3  stalks celery, sliced
3  medium carrots, sliced
3  cloves garlic, minced
4  sprigs parsley
2  dried bay leaves
2 tsp. dried thyme leaves
1 tsp. coriander
½ tsp. black peppercorns
½ tsp. whole allspice
1 tsp. minced fresh ginger
1 tsp. ground tumeric
2  large (about 1 lb) russet potatoes, peeled and cut into 3/4 in. chunks.
1 can (28 oz) roma tomatoes, cut up
Salt
recipes.Procedure: Remove and discard chicken skin.  Place chicken in a 6-8 qt pan.  Add onion, celery, carrots, garlic, parsley, bay, thyme, coriander, pepper, allspice, tomatoes, tumeric, ginger and 2 qts water.  Cover and bring to a boil over high heat; reduce heat and simmer gently until chicken is no longer pink at bone in thigh (about 1 hour).  Remove pan from heat, lift out chicken and set on a plate.  Discard parsley.  If making ahead, let broth cool uncovered, then cover and chill until cold or up to 1 day.  Skim or lift chilled fat from broth and discard.  When chicken is cool, pull meat from bones.  Discard bones and any skin.  Tear meat into bite-size pieces.  If making ahead, cover and chill meat up to 1 day.  Cover soup and bring to a boil on high heat.  Add potatoes, cook until tender when pierced, 20-25 min.  Stir in  chicken and heat through, 3-4 minutes.  Add salt to taste.  Divide rice equally into bowls and ladle in soup to each bowl.  Garnish with fresh cilantro leaves and serve.

recipes.Blurb: Better Homes and Gardens Jan 2002
recipes.Author: Margie T. Stalzer
recipes.Ingredients:
1  large onion, coarsely chopped
1  8-oz. package fresh mushrooms, halved
1  medium red sweet pepper, cut into 3/4-inch pieces
2  cloves garlic, minced
2 tbsp. olive oil
1  14 1/2-oz. can diced tomatoes
1  9-oz. package refrigerated cheese-filled tortellini
½ cup water
¼ cup dry red wine
2 tsp. Italian seasoning
¼ tsp. black pepper
4  small zucchini, halved lengthwise and cut into 1/2-inch thick slices
½ cup shredded Asiago or Parmesan cheese
recipes.Procedure: In a very large skillet cook onion, mushrooms, red pepper and garlic in hot oil over medium heat about 5 min. or until onion is tender.  Stir in undrained tomatoes, tortellini, water, wine, Italian seasoning and black pepper.  Bring to boiling, reduce heat and simmer covered for 10 min.  Stir in zuchini.  Cook, uncovered, for 5 min. more or until zuchini is crisp-tender.  Remove from heat.  Sprining with Asiago or Parmesan cheese.

recipes.Ingredients:
1  chicken, 3 1/2 lbs, cut up
1½ cups thickly sliced carrots
1½ cups thickly sliced onions
¾ cup thickly sliced celery
3¼ cups water
1 can chicken broth
1½ tbsp. parsley,  1/2 bay leaf,  1/4 tsp. thyme, 1/4 tsp. rosemary, 1/2 tsp. crushed peppercorns tied in cheesecloth
3 tbsp. butter or margarine
1½ cups all-purpose flour
1 tsp. salt
1½ tsp. baking powder
1  egg, lightly beaten
5 tbsp. milk
2 tbsp. chopped parsley
¼ tsp. freshly ground pepper
recipes.Procedure: In a large Dutch oven combine chicken, carrots, onions, celery, water and chicken broth; bring to a boil.  Reduce heat to low; skim off fat.  Add spices in cheesecloth and simmer partially covered 1 hour, skimming occasionally.  Remove and discard cheesecloth with spices.  Strain chicken broth.  In same Dutch oven melt butter over medium heat.  Stir in  in ¼ cup of the flour and cook 1 minute.  Whisk in reserved broth, ¼ tsp of the salt pepper, simmer 10 minutes, whisking occasionally.  Return chicken and vegetables to Dutch oven, cover and keep warm.  Meanwhile, in bowl combine 1 cup of the flour, baking powder and ½ tsp of the salt.  Stir in egg and milk; mix until just blended (dough should be slightly sticky).  Stir in parsley.  Bring stew to a simmer.  Drop 8 large spoonfuls dough onto hot stew.  Simmer covered 10 minutes.

recipes.Ingredients:
2 tbsp. all-purpose flour
¼ tsp. salt
⅛ tsp. black pepper
12 oz. lean boneless beek stew meat, cut into 1-inch cubes
1 tbsp. olive oil
¼  large onion, coarsley chopped
1  clove garlic, pressed
¼  lb. mushrooms, quartered
1 can beef broth
¾ cup red Burgundy wine
¼  lb. pearl onions
¼ cup peeled mini-carrots
½ tsp. thyme
¼ tsp. rosemary
1  bay leaf
recipes.Procedure:
1. Combine 1 tbsp flour, ¼ tsp salt and pepper in brown paper bag.  Add beef cubes and shake until beef is lightly coated.
2. Heat 1 tbsp oil in a Dutch oven over medium-high heat.  Brown beef about 5 minutes, adding up to ½ tbsp more oil as needed.  Transfer to paper towel-lined platter.
3. Reduce heat to medium.  Add chopped onion; sauté about 5 min. or just until tender.  Add garlic; sauté 2 min.  Add mushrooms; sauté 5 min. or just until mushrooms release their liquid.  Using slotted spoon, transfer mushroom mixture to bowl; cover and set aside.
4. Whisk together remaining flour, beef broth and wine in Dutch oven until smooth.  Return beef to pan along with the pearl onions, carrots, thyme, rosemary and bay leaf.  Bring to boiling, scraping up any browned bits from bottom of pan with wooden spoon.  Reduce heat to low; cover.  Simmer 45 min.
5. Uncover pot.  Simmer, stirring occasionally for 55 min. or until beef in tender.  Stir in chopped onion-mushroom mixture 10 min. before end of simmering.  Remove stew from heat.  Discard bay leaf.  Stir in remaining 1/8 tsp salt.

recipes.Author: Edna Hoffman
recipes.Ingredients:
1  fryer chicken (about 3 lbs)
¾ cup buttermilk
1½ cups all-purpose flour
1½ tsp. salt
½ tsp. pepper
½ tsp. garlic powder
½ tsp. onion powder
1 tbsp. paprika
¼ tsp. ground sage
¼ tsp. ground thyme
⅛ tsp. baking powder
Cooking oil for frying
recipes.Procedure: Wash and pat dry chicken pieces; place in large flat dish.  Pour buttermilk over chicken; cover and allow to soak at least 1 hour, or overnight in the refrigerator. Combine coating ingredients in bag and shake chicken pieces, one at at time, to coat well.  Lay coated pieces on waxed paper for 15 minutes to allow coating to dry (will cling better in frying).  Meanwhile pour oil to a depth of ½ in. in skillet and heat to 350º-360º.  Fry chicken, several pieces at a time, for about 3 minutes on each side.  Be careful not to overcrowd.  Reduce heat to 325º, cook chicken, turning occasionally, for 25-35 minutes or until juices run clear and chicken is tender.  Remove to paper-towel-lined platter.

recipes.Ingredients:
2 cups buttermilk
1 tbsp. Dijon-style mustard
1 tsp. salt
1 tsp. dry mustard
1 tsp. cayenne pepper
1 tsp. cracked black pepper
1  3 1/2 lb. chicken, cut into 8 pieces
2 cups all-purpose flour
1 tbsp. baking powder
1 tbsp. garlic powder
½ tsp. salt
cooking oil for frying
recipes.Procedure:
1. In a gallow-sized plastic bag or large bowl with tight-fitting lid, combine buttermilk, mustard, salt, dry mustard, cayenne and black pepper.  Add the chicken pieces and turn to coat.  Seal and refrigerate at least 2 hours or overnight.
2.  Preheat oven to 150º.  In a 13x9 in. pan, whisk together flour, baking powder, dry garlic and salt.  Add chicken pieces and turn to coat thickly.  Let the chicken stand 10 minutes, turning occasionally, to recoat with flour.  Shake off excess before frying.
3.  In a 10x12 in. skillet with a deep fryer thermometer attached, heat oil to 375º.  In batches of four, fry the chicken pieces, turning once when the coating is sealed and begins to brown; about 3-4 min.  Reduce the heat to medium and continue to fry, turning the pieces halfway through cooking until chicken is golden brown and cooked through—about 20 more minutes.  Transfer to wire rack and place in oven to keep warm.  Repeat for remaining pieces.

recipes.Ingredients:
12  slices bacon, cooked and crumbled
1 cup shredded Swiss cheese (about 4 oz.)
½ cup chopped onion
2 cups milk
1 cup Bisquick
4  eggs
¼ tsp. salt
⅛ tsp. pepper
recipes.Procedure:
1. Preheat oven to 400º.  Lightly grease a 10-in. pie plate.  Sprinkle bacon, cheese and onion in pie plate.
2. Beat milk, Bisquick, eggs, salt and pepper in a medium-sized bowl with mixer until smooth, about 1 minute.  Pour into pie plate.
3. Bake in oven for 35 min. or until top is golden brown and knife inserted halfway between center and edge comes out clean.  Let stand 5 min. before cutting.  Garnish wiht tomato slices and bacon strips, if desired.

recipes.Ingredients:
Pastry for 1-crust 9-in. pie
1 tbsp. chopped green onion
1 tbsp. butter or margarine
1 cup coarsley chopped, peeled and seeded tomatoes (2 medium)
1 cup shredded Swiss cheese
2 tbsp. grated Parmesan cheese
4  eggs, beaten
1 cup light cream (do not substitute milk)
¼ tsp. salt
recipes.Procedure: On floured surface rool out pastry until dough is 1/8 inch thick.  Line a 9-in quich dish or pie plate with pastry.  Trim pastry and flute edge.  Do no prick.  Line pastry with double thickness of heavy-duty foil.  Bake in 450º oven for 5 min.  Carefully remove foil.  Bake 5-7 min. more or until golden.  Remove from oven; reduce oven temperature to 325º.  (Pastry shell should still be hot when filling is added; do not partially bake ahead of time.)  Meanwhile, in skillet cook onion in butter or margarine until tender.  Stir tomato and cheese into onion.  Spoon tomato mixture into pastry shell.  Beat together eggs, cream and salt; pur over tomato mixture in dish.  Bake in 325º oven 30-35 min. or until almost set in center.  Let stand 5 min. before serving.

recipes.Ingredients:
2 cups long grain rice
½ cup orzo
1  cube butter
4 cups broth
Salt and Pepper
recipes.Procedure: Melt butter in pot.  Add dry rice and orzo.  Braise until butter begins to bubble and orzo and rice are lightly browned.  Make broth with 2 chicken or beef bouillon cubes and 4 cups water (use more bouillon for stronger flavor).  Heat broth until boiling.  Mix with rice and add seasoning.  Stir well and put into covered casserole and place in 350º-400º oven for 30 minutes.  Remove and stir well, re-cover and return to oven for another 10 minutes.

recipes.Author: MEFR
recipes.Ingredients:
4 tbsp. salted butter
½ tsp. celery salt (or to taste)
Dash worcestershire sauce
1  pint shelled oysters, with liquor
¼ cup cold water
1  pint milk (approximately)
¼ cup cream or half-and-half
Pepper and salt to taste
recipes.Procedure:
1. Place all but 1 tsp butter, celery salt and Worcestershire sauce in pan.  Heat gently until butter melts.
2. While butter is melting, pour oysters and their liquor into a sieve placed over a bowl.  Slowly pour water over oysters.  Take oysters out of sieve, one by one and place in container, feeling each one carefully for bits of shell.  Carefull scrape sieve to save every bit of liquor and pour all of liquid over oysters.  If oysters are unusually large, they can be cut into several pieces.
3. Pour oysters and the liquor-water combination into the pan.  Heat very gently, just until the edges of the oysters get curly.  Watch them carefully as it doesn't take long—the edges will look slightly wavy when they're done.  Be sure not to overcook as the oysters will get tough.
4. Add cream and milk and heat until warm.  Add pepper.  Taste and add more milk or salt, if needed.
5.  When ready to serve, float remaining pat of butter on top and garnish with chopped parsley or green onions.

recipes.Blurb: No quantities are given; adjust to suit your impulse
recipes.Author: Rosemary F. Robbins
recipes.Ingredients:
Horseradish
Finely chopped onion
Garlic powder
Worchestershire sauce
Catsup
Eggs
Croutons, crumbled
Salt and Pepper
Hamburger (15% fat works well; don't use leaner)
recipes.Procedure: Mix all ingredients in bowl to suit preferences.  Use a melon ball tool to shape meatballs; drop onto cookie sheet and freeze until ready to use.  Later, meatballs may be cooked in broth or gravy depending upon usage.

recipes.Ingredients:
2 tbsp. olive oil
½ cup onion, chopped
1 tbsp. garlic, minced
10 oz. fresh spinach, stems removed and washed and torn in pieces
2 cups (1 pkg) 6-cheese Italian mix shredded cheese
2 cups marinara sauce
2 cups béchamel sauce
½ cup Parmesan cheese, grated
recipes.Procedure: Sauté onions and garlic in olive oil until softened.  Add spinach and cook over low heat until spinach is cooked.  Remove from heat and cool thoroughly.  Add cheese mix and combine thoroughly.  Using 5-in square pasta wraps, place 1½ tbsp of filling in a wrap and spread thinly but thoroughly across entire surface of wrap.  Roll up wrap and place, seam down, in a baking dish in which a  layer of marinara sauce has been spread.  Repeat with remaining filling and wraps.  Cover prepared cannelloni with a layer of béchamel sauce and sprinkle top with grated Parmesan cheese.  At this point, the cannellone may be frozen; or bake until Parmesan is lightly browned and sauce bubbles.  Makes 20 cannelloni.

recipes.Author: nytimes.com
recipes.Ingredients:
1  28-ounce can whole San Marzano tomatoes, certified D.O.P. if possible
¼ cup extra-virgin olive oil
7  garlic cloves, peeled and slivered
Small dried whole chile, or pinch crushed red pepper flakes
1 tsp. kosher salt
1  large fresh basil sprig, or ¼ tsp. dried oregano, more to taste
recipes.Procedure:
1, Pour tomatoes into a large bowl and crush with your hands. Pour 1 cup water into can and slosh it around to get tomato juices. Reserve.
2. In a large skillet (do not use a deep pot) over medium heat, heat the oil. When it is hot, add garlic.
3. As soon as garlic is sizzling (do not let it brown), add the tomatoes, then the reserved tomato water. Add whole chile or red pepper flakes, oregano (if using) and salt. Stir.
4. Place basil sprig, including stem, on the surface (like a flower). Let it wilt, then submerge in sauce. Simmer sauce until thickened and oil on surface is a deep orange, about 15 minutes. (If using oregano, taste sauce after 10 minutes of simmering, adding more salt and oregano as needed.) Discard basil and chile (if using).

recipes.Author: CuisineAtHome
recipes.Ingredients:
5 tbsp. unsalted butter
⅓ cup all-purpose flour
3½ cups milk
½ tsp. salt
¼ tsp. white pepper
⅛ tsp. freshly grated nutmeg
recipes.Procedure: Melt butter over low heat.  Whisk in flour to make a roux.  Cook and stir 2 minutes.  Gradually add milk into roux.  Cook until thickened, about 10 min., stirring constantly.  When thick, stir in salt, pepper and nutmeg.  Makes about 3½ cups.

recipes.Author: Cuisine At Home
recipes.Ingredients:
2 tbsp. unsalted butter
1 tbsp. vegetable oil
1 lb. ground veal, chicken, turkey or beef
½ cup yellow onion, chopped
1 tbsp. garlic, minced
¼ cup dry sherry
2  eggs
1 cup Parmesan cheese
¼ cup prosciutto, diced
¼  lb. mortadella, diced
¼ cup fresh parsley, diced or 3 tbsp. dried parsley
32  5-in pasta wraps
recipes.Procedure: Sauté ground meat in butter and oil in saucepan over medium-high heat until browned. Add onions and cook until softened. Add minced garlic, sautéing only until you smell the garlic. Deglaze pan with sherry, cook until liquid evaporates. Process meat mixture and remaining ingredients in food processor until mixture resembles coarse sawdust. Spread 1½ tbsp. of filling in the center of a pasta wrap and spread thoroughly over entire wrap. Roll up wrap and place seam down in a baking dish which has been spread with a layer of marinara sauce. Repeat for remaining filling. Cover cannelloni with a layer of béchamel sauce, then sprinkle with Parmesan and bake at 450º for 20 minutes, or until Parmesan is lightly browned and sauce bubbles. Makes 32 cannelloni.

recipes.Ingredients:
4½ tsp. coriander seed
2 tsp. ground turmeric
1¼ tsp. cumin seed
½ tsp. whole black peppercorns
½ tsp. crushed red pepper
½ tsp. cardamon seed (without pod)
½  inch stick cinnamon
¼ tsp. whole cloves
¼ tsp. ground ginger
recipes.Procedure: In a blender place coriander, turmeric, cumin sxeed, peppercornds, red pepper, cardamon seed, cinnamon stick, cloves and ginger.  Cover and blend for 1-2 min. or until mixture is a fine powder.  Store in an airtight container.  Makes about ¼ cup curry powder.

recipes.Blurb: This is the official Italian recipe for pizza dough.
recipes.Author: Cuisineathome
recipes.Ingredients:
1½ cups warm water
1 tsp. active dry yeast
3 cups all-purpose flour
1 cup cake flour (or, 1 cup minus 2 tbsp. all-purpose flour, sifted with 2 tbsp. cornstarch)
1 tbsp. sea salt
recipes.Procedure:
1. Combine yeast and water.  Proof until foamy, 5-8 min.
2. Mix flour and salt in bowl of mixer fitted with dough hook.
3.  Add yeast and water to flour and knead at low speed 30 min.  Shape dough into a ball, place in lightly oiled bowl and turn to coat.  Cover bowl with plastic wrap and let rise 4 hours in warm place.
4. Punch down dough; divide in half and shape into balls.  Brush lightly with oil, cover with plastic wrap and let rise another 2-4 hours.
5. Shape dough into 2 pizza pans; freeze or make into pizza at once.

recipes.Ingredients:
¼ cup fresh minced onion
1 tbsp. crushed fresh garlic
1 tsp. crushed red pepper flakes
2 tbsp. extra virgin olive oil
1 lb. shrimp, shelled and deveined
⅔ cup white wine
1 tbsp. lemon juice
2 tbsp. butter
2 tbsp. parsley
1 tsp. fresh lemon zest
recipes.Procedure: Sauté onion, garlic and red pepper in oil until tender.  Add shrimp and sauté until orange-red and firm; remove shrimp.  Add wine and lemon juice and reduce by ½.  Return shrimp to pan; swirl in butter until melted.  Add parsley and lemon zest.

recipes.Author: Bh&G
recipes.Ingredients:
2½ cups cubed or sliced cooked potatoes
1 tsp. sugar
1 tsp. vinegar
½ cup chopped onion
½ cup sliced celery
¼ cup sliced sweet pickle
1½ tsp. salt
1½ tsp. celery seed
¾ cup mayonnaise
2  hard-cooked eggs, sliced
recipes.Procedure: Sprinkle potatoes with sugar and vinegar.  Add onion, celery, pickle, seasonings and mayonnaise; toss to blend.  Carefully fold in egg slices.  Chill.  Serve in lettuce-lined bowl.

recipes.Author: Aaron Scott
recipes.Ingredients:
2 tbsp. soy sauce
1½ tbsp. rice vinegar
1 tbsp. sesame oil
1 tbsp. minced green onion (both green and white portions)
1 tsp. sesame seeds, toasted
1 tbsp. ground fresh ginger root.
2 tbsp. sugar
2 tbsp. water
⅛ tsp. orange extract or 4 drops orange oil
recipes.Procedure:
Place sesame seeds in sauté pan and cook over medium heat until golden, about 2 min.
Place shredded ginger root in sugar and water and microwave about 2 min. until sugar and water form a syrup.
Mix soy sauce, vinegar, oil, onion, sesame seeds and ginger/syrup mixture in saucepan and simmer until bubbles appear at edge of pan.  Serve immediately.

recipes.Ingredients:
3  whole peppercorns
1  piece ginger
2  bay leaves
1  hot pepper
1 tbsp. sherry
pinch lemon peel
pinch marjoram
carrot
celery
onion
recipes.Procedure: Place all stock ingredients in a large kettle and cover with cold water.  Add small amount of onion, carrots and celery to taste.  Add remaining ingredients and simmer on low heat for 2-3 hours.  Strain stock through colander and discard ingredients.  Chill stock; remove any hardened fat.

recipes.Ingredients:
5  lbs.potatoes
½ cup dry white wine
Salt
Freshly-ground pepper
1¼ cups mayonnaise
1¼ cups sour cream
2½ tbsp. Dijon mustard
2½ tbsp. cider vinegar
½ lb. bleu cheese, crumbled
5  green onions, minced
1½ cups chopped celery
recipes.Procedure:
Place potatles in large pot.  Cover with water; boil until tender.  Drain and cool slightly.  Peel and cut potatoes into 1-inch cubes.  Transfer to large bowl.  Add wine, season with salt and pepper and toss to coat.  Cool
Combine remaining ingredients.  Mix with potatoes.  Adjust seasoning.  Let stand 30 minutes at room temperature before serving.

recipes.Author: Aaron Scott
recipes.Ingredients:
Ginger root
Sugar
recipes.Procedure:
1)  Peel the ginger root and cut into small pieces, about ¼" in size.  Place a layer of sugar in a bowl and ginger pieces on top.  Cover with additional sugar.  Refrigerate 1-2 days, or until sugar has become syrupy.
2)  Place ginger and sugar mixture in a small saucepan and heat to boiling over medium heat.  Reduce heat and boil until sugar becomes quite thick, but do not allow it to carmelize.
3) Remove mixture and strain ginger from syrup, saving the syrup if desired.  Wash and dry ginger pieces.
4)  Add about ½" of sugar to a jar and place ginger pieces on top.  Cover with sugar.  Store for 2 weeks, turning and shaking the mixture frequently until the ginger acquires a translucent appearance and sugar crystals coat the surface.

recipes.Author: Aaron Scott
recipes.Ingredients:
3 cups chicken stock
4  large stalks celery
1  large potato
1 tsp. celery seed
1 tbsp. celery leaf
1 cup half-and half
1 tbsp. all-purpose flour
Pinch marjoram
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.Procedure:
1) Peel the celery, removing the strings from the stalk.  Slice each stalk lengthwise, then chop to about 1/8" cubes.  Peel and dice the potato to about ¼" cubes.
2) Add celery to stock with celery seed and celery leaf and bring to a boil.  Reduce heat and simmer for about 1 hour or until just slightly al dente
3) Add potato, marjoram and salt and pepper to taste and simmer about 1 hour longer, or until both potato and celery are quite tender. Thicken with about 1 tbsp all-purpose flour mixed in the half-and-half.  Return to boiling.  Serve immediately.

recipes.Author: Aaron Scott
recipes.Ingredients:
4 cups stock (chicken, turkey, beef, vegetable)
1  large tomato, diced
2 cups homemade tomato sauce
1 can (8 oz) tomato sauce
½ cup brocolli florets
½ cup cauliflower florets
1½ tsp. onion flakes
1 tsp. parsley
1 tsp. celery leaf
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.Procedure: Mix stock with tomato sauce and herbs.  Bring to a boil.  Add brocolli and cauliflower.  Return to boiling.  Reduce heat and simmer until tomato is cooked and vegetables are tender.

recipes.Author: Joy Of Cooking
recipes.Ingredients:
2  chicken breasts, cut into 1 1/2" cubes
¼ cup olive oil
¼  diced onion
¼ cup diced green pepper
1  clove garlic, minced
2 tsp. curry powder
½ tsp. thyme
1 can stewed tomatoes
All-purpose flour
Salt
Pepper
recipes.Procedure:
1) Coat chicken in flour seasoned with salt and pepper.  Lightly brown in olive oil in frying pan; remove and drain.  Arrange in the bottom of a casserole dish.
2) Add onion, green pepper, garlic, curry and thyme to pan drippings and simmer gently until golden.
3) Add tomatoes and simmer until frying pan is deglazed.
4) Pour sauce over chicken and bake in a 350º oven for 30 minutes.  Serve over steamed rice garnished with toasted slivered almonds.

recipes.Author: Penzey's
recipes.Ingredients:
4 cups bread flour
1 cup water, 80º
1 tsp. yeast
2 tbsp. sugar
2 tsp. salt
2 tbsp. vegetable oil
1  egg, beaten slightly
sesame seeds
recipes.Procedure:
Add yeast to water; let stand 5 min.  In mixer with bread hook, add water, sugar, salt and oil to pan.  Blend in beaten egg and 3 cups flour.  Beat well.  Add enough extra flour to make the dough quite stiff.  Knead with dough hook for 30 min.  Place in greased pan, turning over to coat top.  Cover with plastic wrap and a towel and let rise until doubled in size; about 2 hours.
Turn dough out onto board; divide into thirds.  Roll each third into a rope about 12" long.  Braid the 3 pieces together and place in a greased bread pan.  Cover with plastic wrap and a towel and let rise about 45 min.  Coat with egg white and sesame seeds.  Bake in a 375º oven for 30-40 min. or until browned.

recipes.Blurb: Another version of this food
recipes.Ingredients:
2  lbs.boned lamb
1 cup olive oil
Juice of 2 lemons, strained
½ cup dry red wine
3  cloves garlic, slivered
3 tbsp. oregano
2  bay leaves, crumbled
1 tbsp. dried basil
pinch thyme
pinch rosemary, crushed
1 lb. white mushrooms
2  large yellow onions, quartered
3  green bell pepepers, cut into 1 1/2" squares
12  cherry tomatoes
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.Procedure: Cut lamb into 2-inch chunks.  Combine olive oil, lemon juice, wine, garlic, salt, pepper, oregano, bay leaves, basil, thyme and rosemary in saucepan and bring to a boil.  Drop mushrooms into marinade and cook, stirring, about 1 minute.  Drop in onions and green pepper, stir and cook about 1 minute.  Remove pan from heat, let stand uncovered until cool.  Add meat chunks and stir to coat.  Add tomatoes, cover tightly and refrigerate 6-24 hours.  Thread ingredients alternately on skewers, salt and pepper lightly.  Grill on barbeque, turning frequently and basting with marinade until meat is brown on outside and slightly pink in center.  Serve immediately.

recipes.Ingredients:
1 can (15 oz) garbanzo beans
⅓ cup pulverized sesame seeds
¼ cup lemon juice
¾ cup olive oil
3  cloves garlic
¼ cup fresh cilantro, chopped
½ tsp. turmeric
¼ tsp. salt
¼  black pepper
recipes.Procedure: Blend ingredients in food processor until thoroughly mixed.  Scallions or roasted red peppers may be added for additional seasoning.

recipes.Author: Heritage Cookbook
recipes.Ingredients:
1 lb. beef sirloin steak, cut into thin strips
1 tbsp. all-purpose flour
½ tsp. salt
2 tbsp. butter
1  3-oz can sliced mushrooms
½ cup chopped onion
1  clove garlic, minced
2 tbsp. butter
3 tbsp. all-purpose flour
1 tbsp. tomato paste
1  10 1/2 oz. can beef broth
1 cup dairy sour cream
2 tbsp. dry white wine
hot buttered noodles
recipes.Procedure: Coat beef strips with mixture of tbsp flour and salt.  In a skillet brown beef strips quickley in 2 tbsp butter.  Add mushrooms, onion and garlic; cook until onion is crisp-tender, 3-4 minutes.  Remove meat and mushrooms from pan.  Add 2 tbsp butter to pan drippings; blend in 3 tbsp flour.  Add tomato paste.  Stir in broth.  Cook and stir over medium heat until thickened and bubbly.  Return meat and mushrooms to skillet.  Stir in sour cream and wine; cook slowly until heated through.  Do not boil  Serve over noodles.

recipes.Blurb: This is a variation of tamale pie using beans instead of corn
recipes.Author: Aaron Scott
recipes.Ingredients:
1 lb. ground beef
1 cup chopped onion
1 cup chopped green pepper
2  8-oz. cans tomato sauce
1  12-oz can red beans
½ cup chopped pitted ripe olives
1  clove garlic, minced
1 tbsp. sugar
2 tsp. chili powder
1½ cups (6 oz.) shredded sharp cheese (chedder, or Mexican blend)
¾ cup cornmeal
2 cups cold water
1 tbsp. butter
recipes.Procedure: In large skillet cook beef, onion and green pepper until meat is lightly browned and vegetables are tender.  Drain off fat.  Stir in tomato sauce, beans, olives, garlic, sugar, chile powder, 1 tsp salt and a dash of pepper.  Simmer until thick, 2-25 minutes.  Add cheese; stir until melted.  Turn into a well-greased 9x9x2-inch baking dish.  For topping, stir cornmeal and ½ tsp salt into cold water.  Cook and stir until consistency is that of well-cooked mush.  Stir in butter.  Spoon over hot meat mixture.  Bake at 375º about 40 min.

recipes.Author: Donna German
recipes.Ingredients:
2 cups sourdough culture
1½ cups bread flour
1 tsp. salt
1½ cups bread flour
recipes.Procedure: Knead together the sourdough culture and 1½ cups bread flour for 5 min.  Allow to sit for 8 hours.  Add to bread machine along with 1 tsp salt and remaining flour.  Run the dough cycle of the bread machine.  Remove dough and shape to long tubular shape.  Place on baking sheet,s eam down.  Sprinkle surface with sesame or poppy seeds and make 3 or 4 slashes ¼" deep through the surface.  Let rise in a warm place until double in size (1-3 hours).  Bake at 350º for 35-45 min and cool on a wire rack.

recipes.Author: Lee Bailey
recipes.Ingredients:
2 tbsp. unsalted butter
3 tbsp. minced shallots
1 tbsp. minced garlic
1 tbsp. chopped fresh rosemary
2 tbsp. all-purpose flour
1½ cups milk
¾ tsp. salt
¼ tsp. white pepper
pinch cayenne pepper
3 tbsp. chopped fresh chives
3 tbsp. chopped fresh parsley
recipes.Procedure: Melt butter in a small saucepan and sauté shallots, garlic and rosemary over medium heat until well wilted; about 5 min.  Sprinkle flour over all, mix and continue to cook for a few minutes.  Whisk milk in slowly.  Cook over medium-to-low heat, stirring constantly, for about 5 min.  Blend in salt, white pepper, cayenne, chives and parsley.  Serve warm.

recipes.Blurb: Serve this as any pate.
recipes.Author: Lee Bailey
recipes.Ingredients:
12 oz. boneless chicken, cubed
2 tsp. coarsely chopped shallots
1 tbsp. finely minced garlic
½ tsp. paprika
½ tsp. white pepper
1 tsp. salt
¼ tsp. grated nutmeg
½ tsp. black peppercorns, crushed
1 lb. very coarsely ground veal
3  slices bacon, cubed
recipes.Procedure: Preheat oven to 350º.  Place chicken, shallots, garlic and spices in a food processor and process until well mixed.  Combine with peppercorns, ground veal and bacon in a bowl.  Mix well with your hands.  Pat into a 4-cup ceramic baking crock.  Smooth top and bake in a warm bath until firm; about 45 min.  Allow to cool before referigerating, covered.

recipes.Author: Lee Bailey
recipes.Ingredients:
1 cup dried black beans
8 cups chicken stock
2  small bay leaves
¼ cup olive oil
1  large onion, coarsely chopped
1  small garlic clove, finely chopped
1 cup drained and chopped canned tomatoes (not in paste)
2 tbsp. red wine
1 tsp. sugar
¼ tsp. black pepper
1½ cups elbow macaroni
2  very large red bell peppers, roasted, peeled and cut into medium dice
Finely chopped Italian parsley and green onion for garnish
recipes.Procedure:
Wash and pick over beans.  Cover with an inch of water and bring to a rapid boil.  Boil for 2 min and turn off heat.  Allow to sit uncovered for 1 hour.
Drain beans and cover with 3 cups chicken stock.  Bring to a boil and turn heat down to a simmer.  Add bay leaves.  Simmer until the beans start to get tender; about 1½ hour.  Meanwhile, heat the olive oil and sauté the onion until wilted and starting to brown; about 5 min.  Stir in the garlic and continue to cook for another minute or so.  Scrape the onion-garlic mixture into the beans and add the tomatoes.  Continue cooking, adding more stock if necessary, until beans are done.  This can take up to another hour.  Add wine, sugar, pepper, and the balance of the stock.  To serve, boil macaroni in very well salted water for 6 min.  Darin and add to the bean mixutre along with the diced red pepper.  Simmer just long enough to completely cook the macaroni.  Allow to sit for about 5 min. before serving.  Correct seasoning, if necessary.  This should be a very thick soup; add more stock if necessary to thin.  Sprinkle with parsley and chopped green onion, if desired, before serving.

recipes.Blurb: Use any sausage that appeals to you.
recipes.Author: Lee Bailey
recipes.Ingredients:
2 cups dried white beans
8 cups chicken stock
1  large bay leaf
¼ tsp. dried thyme
¼ cup olive oil
1½ cups coarsely chopped onions
½ cup coarsely chopped celery
2  large carrots, peeled and cut into rings
¼  large green bell pepper, coarsely chopped
1¼  lbs.sausage of your choice
2  large cloves garlic, minced
¼ cup dry red wine
recipes.Procedure:
Wash and pick over beans.  Cover with an inch of water and bring to a rapid boil.  Boil for 2 min and turn off heat.  Allow to sit uncovered for 1 hour.
Drain beans and place in a large pot with chicken stock, bay leaf and thyme.  Bring to a simmer and continue to cook, skimming as necessary, until beans begin to get tender and fall apart, 1½-2 hours.  Add another 2 cups stock, or to taste if soup has reduced too much at end of the cooking time.  Meanwhile, place olive oil in a large skillet and sauté all the vegetables except the garlic until they start to brown.  Scrape into a food processor and purée.  Reserve this purée and add to the beans for the last 30 min. of their cooking time.
Place sausage in a large skillet and cook over high heat for 6 min, turning often.  Pour off the fat.  Add the garlic and red wine.  Simmer, covered, for another 15 min.  Cut the sausages into rings and add to the soup.  Degrease the pan with a few tablesppons of water or chicken stock, then add to the soup.

recipes.Blurb: No quantities are given: use your own judgement.
recipes.Author: Rosemary Robbins
recipes.Ingredients:
diced chicken
frozen mixed veggies
grated Swiss cheese
onion powder
rosemary
marjoram
oregano
sliced green olives
sliced mushrooms

Sauce:
White sauce (milk, white wine, lemon juice, chicken broth).
recipes.Procedure:
Prepare white sauce in large saucepan.  Add other ingredients except the swiss cheese, and simmer on medium-low until chicken and vegetables are tender.
Toward end of cooking, add swiss cheese and cook until melted and well mixed.  Serve immediately.

recipes.Ingredients:
½ cup water
⅓ cup red wine vinegar
1 tbsp. olive oil
2  cloves garlic, finely chopped
½ tsp. basil, crumbled
¼ tsp. thyme, crumbled
⅛ tsp. crushed red pepper flakes
3 cups whole small mushrooms or halved medium-sized mushrooms (about 10 oz)
recipes.Procedure:
1. Combine water, vinegar, oil, garlic, basil, thyme and red pepper flakes in a medium saucepan.  Bring to a boil  Cover; lower heat and simmer 10 min.
2. Add mushrooms.  Cook, covered over low heat, stirring occasionally for 5-7 min., or until mushrooms are fork-tender.
3. Transfer to serving bowl.  Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate 2 hours, stirring occasionally.
4. To serve, drain mushrooms from marinade.  Reserve marinade for salad dressing, if desired.

recipes.Author: Liza Fosburgh
recipes.Ingredients:
¼  lb. lean ground beef
½ tsp. salt
¼ tsp. ground cinnamon
¼ tsp. sage
½ tbsp. minced parsley
½ tbsp. vegetable oil
½ tbsp. flour
¼  medium onion, chopped
½ cups chicken stock
⅛ tsp. thyme
1  clove garlic crushed and minced
¼ cup shredded carrots
1 cup beef consomme
1 cup cabbage, finely chopped
½ cup dry white wine
recipes.Procedure: Mix ground beef with salt, cinnamon, sage and parsley.  Shape into tiny balls, about the size of a large marble and sauté in oil in a deep pot.  When meatballs are done, remove them and set aside.  In the drippings in the pot, sauté the onion over low heat until golden.  Sprinkle on the flour and mix well.  In a separate pan or the microwave, pre-heat the chicken broth.  Stir in the hot broth, stirring and cook gently until it slightly thickens.  Add thyme, garlic, carrots, potatoes (if used) and consomme.  Scrape up any bits sticking at the bottom of the pan and stir well.  Simmer until carrots are just tender, about 10 min.  Add the cabbage and cook another 5 min. or until cabbage is tender but still a little crisp.  Return meatballs to pot and mix well.  Add the white wine and season to taste.  Serve hot.

recipes.Author: Liza Fosburgh
recipes.Ingredients:
2 tbsp. olive oil
1  onion, minced
1  stalk celery with leaves, minced
1  green pepper, minced
6  ripe tomatoes, peeled and chopped
2 cups chicken stock
¼ tsp. paprika
½ tsp. basil
1 tsp. parsley
1 cup hot cooked rice
recipes.Procedure: Sauté onion, celery and pepper in oil until soft.  Add remaining ingredients except rice.  Bring to a boil, stirring.  Reduce heat and cover; simmer 30-40 min.  Add rice just before serving.  Season to taste.  Serve hot.

recipes.Author: Joy Of Cooking
recipes.Ingredients:
2  lbs.lean beef, cut into 1" dice
1½ tbsp. flour
3 tbsp. butter
1 tsp. salt
4  shallots
½ tsp. thyme or marjoram
4  peppercorns
½  bay leaf
Dry red wine
1 cup mushrooms
Chopped parsley
recipes.Procedure: Marinate diced beef overnight in wine.  Drain and save.  Peel and sauté shallots in butter.  Remove from pan.  Sauté beef until light brown.  Sprinkle with flour, salt, peppercorns, bay leaf and marjoram or thyme.  Cover with reserved wine and water, mixed 3/4 part wine to ¼ part water.  Simmer covered for 1 hour.  Place shallots and mushrooms on top and continue to simmer for another 30 minutes or until beef is tender.  Serve sprinkled with chopped parsley.

recipes.Blurb: Use your imagination on the fish; nearly any kind will work.
recipes.Author: Liza Fosburgh
recipes.Ingredients:
4  large onions, sliced
2  potatoes, peeled and sliced
3  ripe tomatoes, peeled and chopped
2  leeks, chopped
1  carrot, diced
1  clove garlic, minced
2 tbsp. parsley, chopped
1 tsp. bay leaf, crumbled
½ tsp. rosemary
½ tsp. thyme
1 tsp. salt
½ tsp. fennel seed
½ can (6 oz) tomato paste
½ cup olive oil
1 tbsp. lemon juice
2 cups water
2  lbs.or more boned fish, cut into chunks
2  small lobsters in shell or 3-4 frozen lobster tails or 1 lbs.shrimp.
Scallops (optional)
recipes.Procedure: In a large pot combine vegetables and herbs.  Mix tomato paste, oil, water and lemon juice in a separate bowl and add to the vegetables.   Cover tightly and simmer over low heat 30 min. or until vegetables are tender.  Add more water if needed, but don't let get too watery.  Add fish, lobster and other seafood on top of the vegetables.  Return pot to simmer.  Cover tightly and steam the fish and shellfish fir 15-20 min. or until lobster has turned red.  If scallops are used, add a little later than the fish and lobster.  Remove lobsters and cut into pieces. Remove shrimp if used.  You may also choose to remove the fish, if desired.  Put removed items on a separate plate.  Serve soup hot with shellfish on the side.

recipes.Author: Liza Fosburgh
recipes.Ingredients:
½ lb. split peas
1  qt water
ham bone or chunk of salt pork
4  ripe tomatoes, peeled and chopped
1  onion, chopped
1  stalk celery with leaves, chopped
1  carrot peeled and diced
1  clove garlic, crushed and minced
1  bay leaf, crumbled
½ tsp. sugar
pinch cloves
pinch cayenne
1 tbsp. flour
½ cup milk
recipes.Procedure: Wash and drain peas.  Combine with water, ham bone, tomatoes, onion, celery, carrot, garlic, bay leave, sugar, cloves and cayenne.  Bring to a boil; reduce heat and cover.  Simmer 1½-2 hours.  Remove bone or salt pork; skim off fat.  Blend together flour, milk and a little of the hot soup until creamy.  Add to soup pot and stir well.  Return to simmering and cook another 10-15 min., stirring occasionally.  Put in blender or food processor and pulverize.  Reheat and serve hot.

recipes.Author: Liza Fosburh
recipes.Ingredients:
1  onion, finely chopped
1  stalk celery with leaves, finely chopped
2  ripe tomatoes, peeled and chopped
1 tbsp. tomato purée
1 tbsp. brown sugar
1 tsp. dry mustard
1 tsp. chili powder
1  qt water
1  1lb can white beans
½ cup sherry
fresh cilantro or parsley
recipes.Procedure: In a large pot combine onion, celery, tomatoes, tomato purée, brown sugar, dry mustard, chili powder and water.  Bring to a boil, reduce heat and cover.  Simmer 45-60 min.  Drain canned beans and add to soup; simmer 15-20 more.  Add sherry; garnish with cilantro or parsely.  Serve hot.

recipes.Author: Liza Fosburgh
recipes.Ingredients:
2 cans white beans or 2 cups dried beans soaked and drained.
1 lb. ground sausage meat
2  onions, chopped
1  clove garlic, minced
½  green bell pepper, chopped
1  bay leaf, crumbled
1 tsp. red pepper flakes
2  qts beef stock
4  ripe tomatoes, peeled and chopped
recipes.Procedure: In a large pot, brown sausage until crumbly.  Set aside.  In 2 tbsp drippings, sauté onion, pepper and garlic until soft.  Return sausage to pot.  Add beans and remaining ingredients.  Bring to a boil; reduce heat and cover.  Simmer 45 min or so (longer if using dried beans).  Skim off fat; season to taste.  Serve hot.

recipes.Author: Liza Fosburgh
recipes.Ingredients:
3 tbsp. vegetable oil
2  onions, chopped
3  stalks celery, chopped
½ lb. ground beef
1  clove garlic, minced
1 cup canned drained whole-kernal corn
1  large can (1 lb. 12 oz) peeled tomatoes, chopped
1½  qts beef stock
2 cans kidney beans
2 tsp. ground cumin
1 tsp. dill seed
1 tsp. crushed red pepper
½ cup sherry
recipes.Procedure: Heat oil in large pot and sauté onions, celery, beef and garlic.  When beef is lightly browned and vegetables soft, add corn, tomatoes, beef stock, beans, chili powder, cumin and dill seed.  Mix well, cover pot and simmer for 45-60 min.  Add red pepper and sherry and simmer for another 10 min.  Serve hot.

recipes.Author: Liza Fosburgh
recipes.Ingredients:
2 tbsp. vegetable oil
2  onions, chopped
1  clove garlic, minced
1 lb. lean beef, cubed
2 tbsp. flour
2 cups beef stock, heated
2 cups finely shredded red cabbage
1 tbsp. sugar
1 tsp. vinegar
1 cup sherry
½ tsp. thyme
½ tsp. crumbled bay leaf
recipes.Procedure: Heat oil in large pot.  Brown onions, garlic and beef.  Sprinkle on the flour and mix well.  Gradually add hot beef stock, stirring, and cook until slightly thickened.  Stir in the sugar and vinegar.  Add sherry, thyme and bay leaf.  Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer 1 hour or until beef is tender and flavors blended.  Serve hot.

recipes.Author: Donna German
recipes.Ingredients:
2 cups sourdough culture
1½ cups bread flour
½ tsp. salt
1 tsp. sugar
1 tsp. baking soda
1½ cups bread flour
recipes.Procedure: Mix culture and 1½ cups bread flour the night before baking bread.  Knead for 5 minutes and allow to sit 8 hours or overnight.  Place in bread machine with remaining ingedients and run the dough cycle.  Remove dough and knead into an oval or round ball.  Shape ball into an oblong somewhat shorter in length than bread pan and flatten it into a oval ½ in. thick.  Fold oval in half lengthwise and pinch sides together to form a seam.  Shape until it looks like a small football.  When done, dough should be slightly longer than pan.  Insert into pan by arching middle and wedging dough into place.  Place in warm location at 85º and allow to rise 1-3 hours.  Bake at 350º for 50-55 min.

recipes.Author: Donna German
recipes.Ingredients:
2 cups sourdough culture
1½ cups bread flour
½ cup milk
1 tbsp. vegetable oil
1 tsp. salt
1 tbsp. sugar
1¼  bread flour
recipes.Procedure: Mix culture and 1½ cups bread flour the night before baking bread.  Knead for 5 minutes and allow to sit 8 hours or overnight.  Place in bread machine with remaining ingedients and run the dough cycle.  Remove dough and form 3 balls of roughly equal size.  For a long narrow rope fro each ball.  Ropes should be as long as your baking sheet and about 1½ in. in diameter.  Allow to rise on a greased baking sheet for 1-2 hours.  If you arange ropes within 1 in. of each other and separate with strips of waxed paper, they will support each other as they rise.  Just before baking, brush with egg glaze and make short diagonal slashes the entire length.  Leave waxed paper strips in place and bake in a preheated oven at 375º for 35 min.  Cool on a wire rack.  Waxed paper strips can be removed when cool.

recipes.Author: Donna German
recipes.Ingredients:
2 cups sourdough culture
5½ cups bread flour
1 tsp. salt
5½ tbsp. sugar
5½ tbsp. olive oil
5½ cups bread flour
recipes.Procedure: Knead sourdough starter and 1½ cups flour and knead for 5 minutes. Allow to sit for 8 hours. Add remaining ingredients. Run dough cycle. Remove dough and form as many large-egg sized round balls as the dough will produce (about 6-7). On a well-floured board, use a roller to make flat rounds slightly less than ¼" thick and 5-6 inches in diamter. As the rounds are rolled, flour each side lightly and form 2 stacks with the rounds separated by wax paper. Do not put more than 3-4 rounds in each stack. Let rise 30-60 min. Put an ungreased nonstick baking sheet or pizza stone in the oven and preheat oven to 500º. Transfer the rounds to a well-floured baking sheet and slide onto heated baking sheet 1 or 2 at a time, taking care not to damage the surface of the rounds. Pitas should begin to puff in about 2 minutes. Bake until pitas have browned slightly, about 7 min. Remove from oven and cool on wire rack. Be sure oven regains high temperature between batches.

recipes.Author: Pillsbury
recipes.Ingredients:
1 oz. refrigerated pie crust, softened as directed
1 tbsp. olive oil
1  medium onion, sliced
½  medium red bell pepper, cut into  1/4" strips
½  medium green bell pepper, cut into  1/4" strips
½  medium yellow bell pepper, cut into  1/4" strips
1 can (10 oz) chunk white chicken brest (or equivalent leftover chicken)
4 tsp. dry fajita seasoning
1  egg, beaten
½ cup salsa
sour cream
salsa
recipes.Procedure:
1. Heat oven to 425º.  Unfold crusts; press out fold lines.  Place 1 crust on ungreased pizza pan or cookie sheet
2. Heat oil in large skillet over medium-high heat until hot.  Add onion and bell peppers; cook 5 min or until tender, stirring occasionally.  Add chicken and fajita seasoning; mix well.
3.  Spook chicken mixture onto crust to within 1 in. of edge.  Spread ½ cup salsa over chicken mixture.  Brush edge of crust with water.  Place remaining crust over filling, pressing edges firmly together to seal.  Brush top with beaten egg.
4. Bake at 425º for 20-25 min.  or until deep golden brown.  cover edge of cust with strips of foil after 10-15 min. of baking to prevent excessive browning.  Cut into wedges.  Garnish with sour cream and additional salsa.

recipes.Author: Pillsbury
recipes.Ingredients:
1 oz. refrigerated pie crust, softened as directed
¼ cup grated Parmesan cheese
¾ lb. very thinly sliced cooked ham
¼ lb. thinly sliced pepperoni
4 oz. (1 cup) shredded Cheddar cheese
recipes.Procedure:
1.  Heat oven to 450º.  Unfold crusts; press out fold lines.  Sprinkle each crust with Parmesan cheese
2.  Top each crust with ham, pepperoni and Cheddar cheese to within 1 in. of edges.  Loosely roll up each crust.  Place rolls, seam side down, on ungreased cookie sheet.  Fold ends under.
3.  Bake at 450º for 12-17 min. or until golden brown.  Cool 5 min.  Cut each roll into 16 slices.  Serve warm.

recipes.Author: Kellogs
recipes.Ingredients:
1¼ cups all-purpose flour
¾ tsp. ground cinnamon
1 tbsp. orange peel
½ cup sugar
1 tbsp. baking powder
¼ tsp. salt
2 cups All-Bran cereal
1¼ cups milk
1  egg
¼ cup vegetable oil
recipes.Procedure:
1. Stir together flour, sugar, baking powder, cinnamon, orange peel and salt.  Set aside.
2.  In large bowl, combine All-Bran and milk.  Let stand about 5 min.  or until cereal softens.  Add egg and oil.  Beat well.  Add flour mixture, stirring only until combined.  Portion batter evenly into 12 muffin pan cups coated with cooking spray.
3.  Bake at 400º about 20 min. or until lightly browned.  Serve warm.

recipes.Ingredients:
12  corn tortillas
6 cups enchilada sauce
2  medium onions, chopped
1 lb. Cheddar cheese, shredded
1 lb. Monterey jack cheese, shredded
1 oz. can ripe olives, sliced
1 cup oil
Shredded lettuce
recipes.Procedure: Heat oil in frying pan.  Fry tortillas one at a time until soft and pliable; only a few seconds.  Drain on paper towel.  Dip tortilla into sauce in shallow dish.  Add cheese and onion and roll tortilla.  Repeat with remaining tortillas.  When all are rolled, arrange in baking dish and cover with remaining sauce and cheese.  Cover and heat at 280º until the cheese melts and is bubbly.  Top with shredded lettuce and sliced olives.  Serve at once.

recipes.Author: Moyra Fraser
recipes.Ingredients:
1 tbsp. olive oil
½ lb. green lasagna
½  stick butter
3 tbsp. all-purpose flour
3¼ cups milk
6 tbsp. grated Parmesan cheese
¼ cup grated gruyere cheese
¼ cup mozzarela, diced
¼ cup pecorino cheese, diced
salt, pepper and nutmeg
recipes.Procedure: Fill a large pan with salted water.  Add the olive oil.  Cook the lasagna 4-5 leaves at at time for 7-10 min.  Lift out each batch carefully, plunge into cold water.  When all the pasta has been cooked, drain well on paper towels.  Make a bechamel sauce with the butter, flour and milk.  Add the cheeses to the sauce, reserving 2 tbsp Parmesan.  Season with salt, pepper and nutmeg.  Stir until the cheeses have melted.  Butter generously a deep baking pan.  Put in alternate layers of lasagna and sauce; there should be at least 4 layers.  Finish with a layer of sauce; sprinkle with reserved Parmesan.  Cook at 350º for 45 min. until bubblling and golden brown.

recipes.Author: Moyra Fraser
recipes.Ingredients:
2½  lbs.pork joint
2  cloves garlic, slivered
2  sprigs fresh rosemary
salt, peppercorns
4 tbsp. olive oil
recipes.Procedure: Cut small slits in the pork and stuff with slivers of garlic and tufts of rosemary.  Season with salt and freshly ground pepper.  Heat 2 tbsp of the oil in a roasting pan.  Add pork and pour a thin stream of the remaining oil over it and roast in a preheated 425º oven for about 20 min.  When pork is nicely browned, lower heat to 350º and roast for another 1¼ hours, turning occasionally.  Remove from oven and carve.

recipes.Author: Moyra Fraser
recipes.Ingredients:
1½ lb. boneless beef round, slicked  1/4" thick
salt
all-purpose flour
1  egg, beaten
1½ tsp. butter
2 tbsp. olive oil
⅓ cup Marsala
1 tbsp. tomato paste
4  anchovy fillets, chopped
1 tbsp. capers, chopped
recipes.Procedure: Pound beef very thin, sprinkle with salt and flour on both sides.  Dip in beaten egg.  Heat butter and oil in a large frying pan.  Brown beef slices on both sides.  Add Marsala, raise heat slightly, and simmer until wine evaporates.  Place beef slices on a plater and keep warm.  Into same pan, add tomato paste mixed with ½ cup water and simmer 5 min.  Add anchovies and capers and simmer 2 min. more.  Put beef back in pan with sauce and simer 2-3 min. over low heat.  Garnish with rolled-up anchovies with capers in the center

recipes.Author: Moyra Fraser
recipes.Ingredients:
3½  lbs.(12 small or 6 large) zucchini
½ cup cooked ham, diced
2 tbsp. parsley, chopped
¼ cup fresh basil, chopped
2 tbsp. bread crumbs
⅔ cup grated Parmesan cheese
2  eggs
nutmeg
salt, pepper
5 tbsp. butter
1 tbsp. flour
1 cup milk
recipes.Procedure: Cut ends of the zucchin and trim them to the same length.  Wash and drain.  Boil in lightly salted water for 10 min or until half-cooked.  Drain.  Slice in half lengthwise and remove pulp, reserving it in a bowl.  Reserve shells (½" thick).  Mix ham, parsley and basil with chopped pulp.  Add bread crumbs, all but 2 tbsp of the Parmesan cheese, eggs, freshly grated nutmeg and salt and pepper to taste.  Mix thoroughly and set aside.  Melt ¼ cup of the butter and stir in flour.  Gradually stir in milk.  Stir over low heat until the sauce bubbles and thickens.  Stir sauce into zucchini mixture.  Add more bread crumbs if the mixture is not thick enough to spoon.  Using a spoon fill zucchini shells with mixture.  Arrange side by side in a baking dish buttered with remaining butter.  Sprinkle with remaining Parmesan cheese adn bake in preheated 350º oven for 30 min.  Serve hot in baking dish.

recipes.Author: Moyra Fraser
recipes.Ingredients:
4  filet mignon steaks, about 6oz each
½ cup black olives
3  anchovy fillets, chopped
¾ cup chopped tomato pulp (skin and seeds removed)
3 tbsp. olive oil
2 tbsp. capers
½ cup dry white wine
salt and pepper
recipes.Procedure: Pit olives and chop coarsely.  Mix olives, anchovy fillets and tomato pulp.  Brown steaks quick on both sides in oil and remove to a platter.  Add tomato pulp mixture and capers to pan juices.  Heat until bubbly.  Stir in wine and a pinch of pepper and simmer until sauce is thick.  Season to taste with salt.  Return steaks to pan and cook to desire degree, turning several times in sauce and making sure they do not overcook.  Salt lightly and serve immediately with pan juices spooned over them.

recipes.Author: Moyra Fraser
recipes.Ingredients:
2  balls mozzarella cheese
8  slices white bread, crusts trimmed
1½ cups milk
2  eggs
2 tbsp. butter
⅓ cup olive oil
flour
salt
recipes.Procedure: Slick mozzarella into ½ in. thick slices.  Dip slices of bread into milk, removing them quickly so they are barely softened.  Place a slice of mozzarella between each pair of bread slices and press gently between your hands.  Cut each sandwich into 2 rectangles.  Flour sandwiches slightly and dip into eggs beaten with a pinch of salt.  Fry sandwiches in butter and oil in a large frying pan (wait until butter and oil are very hot before frying).  Fry until brown, turn and brown on other side.  Remove and drain on paper towels.  Serve on a preheated platter covered with a napkin.

recipes.Author: Moyra Fraser
recipes.Ingredients:
¾ lb. mushrooms
3  artichoke hearts, sliced thin
Juice of 1 lemon
1  white celery heart, cut into strips
½ lb. shrimps, cooked, shelled and deveined
16  asparagus tips, cooked and drained
¾ cup mayonnaise
2 tbsp. olive oil
2  ripe tomatoes, peeled and pressed through a sieve
salt
recipes.Procedure: Peel mushroom caps, simmer for 15 min. in water to cover.  Drain.  Sprinkle artichoke hearts with half of the lemon juice to keep them from darkening.  Put mushrooms, artichokes, celery, shrimp and asparagus into little piles in a large glass bowl.  Chill.  Mix mayonnaise with oil, remaining lemon juice and tomato pulp.  Add salt to taste.  Serve this sauce with vegetables.

recipes.Author: Martha Stewart
recipes.Ingredients:
Grated zest of 1 orange
3 tbsp. orange juice
3 tbsp. lemon juice
1  large clove garlic, minced
3 tbsp. freshly grated ginger
½ tsp. red pepper flakes
1  scallion, finely sliced
¼ cup olive oil
Salt and Pepper to taste
recipes.Procedure: Combine ingredients in a bowl and emulsify with a whisk, or blend in food processor or blender.

recipes.Author: Heritage Cookbook
recipes.Ingredients:
¼ cup chopped onion
½ tsp. curry powder
2 tbsp. vegetable oil
1 cup diced cooked chicken
1  tart apple, peeled, cored and chopped
¼ cup chopped carrot
¼ cup chopped celery
2 tbsp. chopped green pepper
3 tbsp. all-purpose flour
4 cups chicken broth
1  16-oz. can diced tomatoes
1 tbsp. chopped fresh parsley
2 tsp. lemon juice
1 tsp. sugar
2  whole cloves
Salt and pepper
recipes.Procedure: In a large saucepan cook onion and curry powder in oil until onion is tender.  Stir in chicken, apple, carrot, celery and green pepper.  Cook, stirring occasionally, until vegetables are crsip-tender; about 5 min.  Sprinkle flour over mixture; stir to mix well.  Stir in broth, undrained tomatoes, parsley, lemon juice, sugar, cloves, ¼ tsp salt and a dash of pepper.  Bring mixture to boiling, stirring occasionally.  Reduce heat and simmer 30 min.

recipes.Ingredients:
2 cans (15.5 oz) white beans, drained and rinsed
4 cups chicken brown, divided
½ cup chopped onion
2  cloves garlic, minced
1 can (16 oz) whole tomatoes or 4-6 fresh plum tomatoes
2 tsp. dried basil
½ tsp. dried thyme
⅛ tsp. white pepper
recipes.Procedure: Combine one can of beans with two cups of broth in a blender or food processor and blend until a smooth purée.  Transfer to a large saucepan.  Stir in remaining ingredients.  Bring to a boil over h igh heat, then reduce heat and simmer, covered, about 10-15 minutes or until beans and tomatoes are tender.

recipes.Ingredients:
5  eggs
2½ cups sugar
½ cup grated blanched almonds
⅛ tsp. lemon extract
⅛ tsp. orange oil
1 tsp. lemon peel
1 tsp. orange peel
3 cups all-purpose flour
¼ tsp. each powdered cardamon, nutmeg, cinnamon and cloves
1 tsp. baking powder
recipes.Procedure: Beat eggs with sugar until thick and pale yellow.  Add almonds, lemon and orange peel and lemon extract and orange oil.  Sift flour with spices and add gradually to egg mixture, stirring well between additions.  Add enough flour to make a fairly stiff dough that is not sticky.  Knead on a floured board until smooth.  Shape into finger-thick rolls and slice into 1-inch lengths, or roll out and cut to desired shape (rectangles and circles are also traditional).  Arrange on a buttered cookie sheet and allow to dry uncovered at room temperature overnight.  Bake in 300º oven for about 20 min. or until a pale golden brown.

recipes.Author: Red Lobster
recipes.Ingredients:
3  anchovies
1 tsp. chopped garlic
2 tsp. red wine vinegar
2 tsp. Dijon mustard
3 tbsp. olive oil
1  coddled egg yolk
5  dashes Worcestershire sauce
