½  squeezed lemon
¼ tsp. freshly ground black pepper
¼ cup parmesan cheese
recipes.Procedure: Using a medium size bowl, mash and spread the anchovies and garlic with a fork.  Add vinegar and mustard and blend thoroughly.  Using the fork, add olive oil and coddled (meaning to cook in simmering water 1 min.) egg yolk.  Mix together and add Worcestershire, lemon, pepper and parmesan cheese.

recipes.Blurb: Do not cook this indoors—cook on a grill outdoors ONLY!  The burning spices produce large amounts of smoke and fumes
recipes.Author: Double Musky Inn
recipes.Ingredients:
4  8-oz salmon fillets, carefully boned
8 tbsp. clarified butter
4 tbsp. blackened salmon spice (ingredients follow)
¼ oz. whole bay leaves
½ cup paprika
1½ tsp. dried basil leaves
1½ tsp. dried oregano
1½ tsp. thyme
1 tbsp. dried onion flakes
1 tbsp. dried minced garlic
5 tsp. salt
1½ tsp. black pepper
1 tbsp. white pepper
1 tbsp. cayenne
recipes.Procedure:
Spices for blackened salmon:  blend in processor until well mixed.  Will keep for 2 months.

Clarify butter by melting over medium heat until foam subsides.  Carefully pour off clear butter, discarding solids.  If butter begins to turn brown, discard and start again.

Using a cast-iron skillet (it's best to use a brand-new one, unseasoned, and use it only for this dish), place on a barbecue as near to the coals as possible and heat until it's white-hot.  Dip fillet in slightly cooled clarified butter.  Shake a good coating of spice mixture onto one side of the fillet.  Place immediately on hot skillet, spiced side down and shake about 1 tsp of spice mixture on top of fillet.  It will begin billowing smoke immediately as spices burn.  When the salmon is cooking (about 90 seconds on the first side and about a minute on the second side), don't move or touch the fillet which would break the flesh and crust.  On the first side, watch carefully as a pink-white line of cooked fish climbs up the side of the fillet.  When it's almost to the top, turn over with a METAL spatula, holding spatula level and tight to bottom of skillet, so crust  isn't disturbed.  Cook the second side for about a minute or until the crust is blackened, too.  When it's properly cooked, it will be crust but not hard, first to the touch with a little give to the fish.  The salmon itself will be slightly rare, with just a hint of translucency at the center.  Because it's been so hot, it will continue cooking a little after you take it off the skillet, so serve immediately.  Mix leftover salmon spice into leftover clarified butter and serve on the side as a dipping sauce.  Remember that the skillet cannot be too hot, and always use a metal spatula!!!

recipes.Author: Aaron Scott
recipes.Ingredients:
1 tbsp. crushed red pepper
1 tsp. paprika
¼ tsp. garlic powder
¼ tsp. cumin seed
1  clove
recipes.Procedure: Mix ingredients in processor until finely ground.  Store in airtight container.

recipes.Author: Aaron Scott
recipes.Ingredients:
1  part cloves
4  parts allspice
5  parts orange peel
5  parts crushed whole cinnamon
recipes.Procedure: Add ingredients together in a storage container and shake well to mix.

recipes.Author: Cuisine At Home
recipes.Ingredients:
4 oz. bittersweet chocolate
4 oz. milk chocolate
6 tbsp. unsalted butter, cubed
2 tsp. instant coffee, disolved in 3 tbsp. warm water
1  egg yolk (optional)
1 tbsp. liqueur (optional)
Coatings:
Unsweetened cocoa powder
Finely chopped nuts
Powdered sugar
Shredded coconut
recipes.Procedure: Chop chocolate into small pieces.  Melt in double boiler with butter and coffee mixture.  Stir with rubber spatula until melted and smooth, about 5 min.  Remove from heat.  Stir in optional egg yolk and liqueur (I like Creme de Cocoa).  Pour onto parchment, or buttered dish and chill until firm, at least 1 hour.  Scoop cold chocolate mixture into truffles using a melon baller or teaspoon.  Don't roll them to make them smooth—they're supposed to be rough-looking.  Place truffles directly into any of the coatings and roll them around until completely covered.  Store truffles in airtight container between leaves of parchment or waxed paper.

recipes.Ingredients:
½ cup butter
¼ cup sugar
1 tsp. vanilla
1¼ cups all-purpose flour
¼ cup raspberry jam
2 oz. white chocolate chips
recipes.Procedure:
1.  In a large bowl, beat with mixer at medium speed butter, sugar and vanilla until smooth.  Stir in flour and beat until dough comes together.
2.  Divide dough in thirds.  Roll each third into a rope 9 in. long by about 1 in. thick.  Place ropes 3 in. apart on buttered cookie sheet.  With your finger, press ½ in. indentations into each rope at 1 in. intervals.  Spoon ¼ tsp raspberry jam into each indentation.
3.  Bake ropes in 350º oven for 12-15 min. or until edges are lightly browned.  Cool on cookie sheet.
4.  Place white chocolate chips in plastic bag, pushing to one corner, and secure just above chips with twist tie.  Melt chocolate in hot water or a microwave (for about 1 min.), then snip off the corner of the bag with scissors.  Squeeze bag so chocolate drizzles white chocolate decoratively across ropes.  Chill ropes until chocolate is firm to the touch, about 1 hr., then slice each rope into 12 pieces diagnonally.

recipes.Ingredients:
4  pieces bone-in chicken breast-halves and legs in any combination
2 tbsp. light vegetable or olive oil for basting

Marinade:
¾ cup plain yogurt
2 tbsp. lemon juice
4  cloves garlic, peeled
1  piece of peeled, fresh ginger
1 tbsp. ground cumin
½ tsp. ground cardamom
¼ tsp. ground cloves
½ tsp. cayenne pepper
½ tsp. freshly ground black pepper
1 tbsp. red food coloring (optional)
2  tablespoons. yellow food coloring (optional)
Coarse salt to taste
recipes.Procedure: Pull the skin off chicken pieces and trim fat. Prick the flesh and make diagonal slashed, 1-inch apart using a paring knife. Set aside in a bowl. Mix all the ingredients of the marinade in an electric blender or a food processor and process until thoroughly pureed. Pour the marinade over chicken, toss and rub, to coat thoroughly. Cover and refrigerate for 8 hours or overnight. Preheat oven to 500 degrees F. Place chicken in a single layer over a rack positioned in sheet pan. Bake in the middle of the oven for 25 minutes, basting once with marinade juices and oil, or until cooked. Serve immediately, accompanied with Pan-Roasted Potatoes and Onions with Cumin and Indian Salsa

recipes.Author: Rosemary Robbins
recipes.Ingredients:
6  strips oven-ready lasagne
1 can peeled chopped tomatoes
1 can tomato sauce (8 oz)
¾ cup each, mozeralla, sharp chedder, parmesan and pepper jack cheese, shredded
sliced stuffed green olives
sliced button mushrooms
¼ tsp. basil
¼ tsp. thyme
¼ tsp. Greek oregano
recipes.Procedure:
In a blender, purée the tomatoes and tomato sauce.  Add basil, thyme and Greek oregano.  Purée again.
In 8 in. oven dish, pour in enough purée to cover the bottom.  Mix cheeses together.  Put two strips of lasagne into dish, pour over some more sauce and sprinkle with cheese, mushrooms and olives.  Repeat for two more layers, ending with remaining sauce on top.  Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.  Cover baking dish with foil and bake at 375º for 10-15 min. until hot and bubbling.  Let stand 5 min. before cutting.

recipes.Ingredients:
2 tbsp. butter
1  8-oz can oysters with liquid
2 cups milk
¼ tsp. salt
¼ tsp. paprika
¼ tsp. pepper
¼ tsp. seasoned salt
¼ tsp. Worchestershire sauce
Dash cayenne
recipes.Procedure: Combine ingredients in saucepan and heat thoroughly.  Do not boil

recipes.Blurb: Better—they say—than sour cream for cooking
recipes.Author: Cuisine At Home
recipes.Ingredients:
1 cup heavy cream
¼ cup buttermilk
1 tbsp. lemon juice
recipes.Procedure: Mix ingredients and let sit at room temperature for 6-8 hours, then refrigerate.  Use when thick.

recipes.Author: Williams-Sonoma
recipes.Ingredients:
1 tsp. coriander seeds
1 tsp. cumin seeds
¼  fennel seeds (or celery seeds)
1 tsp. firmly packed brown sugar
1 tsp. kosher salt (or sea salt)
2  salmon fillets, each 6-8 oz. with skin intact, deboned
2 tbsp. extra-virgin olive oil
recipes.Procedure: Heat a small fry pay over medium-high heat.  Put coriander, cumin and fennel seeds in pan; toast, stirring constantly, until golden brown and fragrant, about 2-3 min.  Grind spices in a spice grinder or with mortar and pestle.  Transfer to a small bowl; stir in brown sugar and salt.  Place salmon, skin side down, on a plate; rub top of each fillet with spice mixture.  Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate 1 hour.  Preheat oven to 400º.  In a large fry pan over medium-high heat, warm olive oil until nearly smoking.  Place salmon, skin side up, in pan and sear 2 min.  Carefully turn salmon over and transfer pan to oven.  Cook until fish is golden brown underneath and flesh is opaque throughout; about 5-6 min.  Transfer to warmed plates and serve immediately.

recipes.Author: Nancy Wit
recipes.Ingredients:
1  broiler-fryer chicken, 3lbs, cut up and skin removed
3 cups orange juice
1 cup chopped celery
1 cup chopped green pepper
1  4-oz can mushroom stems and pieces, drained
4 tsp. dried minced onion
1 tbsp. minced fresh or 1 tsp. dried parsley flakes
½ tsp. salt, optional
¼ tsp. pepper
3 tbsp. cornstarch
3 tbsp. cold water
recipes.Procedure: Combine all ingredients except cornstarch and water in a slow cooker.  Cover and cook on low 4 hours or until juices run clear.  Combine cornstarch and water until smooth; stir into cooking juices.  Cover and cook on high for 30-45 min. or until thickened.  Serve over rice.

recipes.Author: Dolores Wynne
recipes.Ingredients:
½ lb. boneless round steak
2 tbsp. all-purpose flour, divided
½ tsp. salt
2 tbsp. vegetable oil
1 can (14 1/2 oz) stewed tomatoes
½ cup chopped carrot
¼ cup chopped celery
1 tbsp. chopped onion
¼ tsp. Worcestershire sauce
2 tbsp. sharp cheddar cheese, shredded
recipes.Procedure: Cut meat into two portions; lb. to ¼ in. thickness. Combine 1 tbsp. flour and salt; coat meat on both sides. In a skillet, brown meat in oil. Transfer meat to a greased shallow 2-qt baking dish; set aside. To pan drippings, add tomatoes, carrot, celery, onion, Worcestershire sauce and remaining flour. Bring to a boil over med. heat; cook and stir for 2 min. Pour over meat. Cover and bake at 350º for 1½ hours or until the meat is tender. Sprinkle with cheese; return to the oven until cheese is melted.

recipes.RecipeName: Olive Garden Spinach And Artichoke Dip
recipes.Blurb: This is a copycat recipe, and whether or not it is as good as the original, it is GOOD
recipes.Ingredients:
1  8 oz. package cream cheese
1 can 14 oz. artichoke hearts, drained, coarsely chopped
½ cup frozen chopped spinach
¼ cup mayonnaise (NOT Miracle Whip)
¼ cup Parmesan cheese
¼ cup Romano cheese (or use all Parmesan)
1  clove garlic, finely minced
½ tsp. dried basil
¼ cup Mozzarella cheese, grated
¼ tsp. garlic salt
Salt and Pepper to taste
recipes.Procedure: Allow cream cheese to come to room temperature.  Cream together mayonnaise, Parmesan, Romano cheese, garlic, basil and garlic salt.  Mix well.  Add the artichoke hearts and spinach (careful to drain well), and mix until blended.  Store in a container until you are ready to use.  Spray pie plate with Pam, pour in dip, top with cheese.  Bake at 350º for 25 min or until top is browned.  Serve with toasted bread.

recipes.Author: Williams-Sonoma
recipes.Ingredients:
¼ cup all-purpose flour
1¼  lb. round steak, cut into 1" pieces
1 tbsp. extra-virgin olive oil
1  slice bacon, cut into 1" pieces
1  large carrot, cut into  ½" pieces
½  yellow onion, sliced  ¼" thick
1  clove garlic, chopped
1  bay leaf
2  fresh thyme sprigs
2  fresh parsley sprigs
¼  lb. white button mushrooms, halved
1 cup dry white wine
1 tsp. beef demi-glace
steamed red potatoes, tossed with butter and chopped parsley
recipes.Procedure: In a large pan over medium heat warm oil.  Brown beef on all sides, 5-7 min.  Transfer to a slow cooker.  Add bacon, carrots, onions and garlic to pan; cook, stirring occasionally, until tender; about 10 min.  Transfer to slow cooker along with bay leaf, thyme, parsley and mushrooms.  Off the heat, pour wine into pan set over med-high heat.  Whisk in demi-glace to deglaze.  Add to slow cooker, cover and cook until meat is fork-tender, about 6 hours on high or 8 on low.  Discard bay leaf, serve alongside steamed potatoes.

recipes.Author: Kathryn Burris
recipes.Ingredients:
½ cup chopped cooked chicken
¼ tsp. dried minced onion
¼ tsp. dried parsley flakes
1 can chicken broth
1 can creamy chicken mushroom soup
¼ tsp. dried minced onion
⅛ tsp. dried pepper flakes, optional
1 cup all-purpose flour
1 tbsp. baking powder
1 tsp. sugar
½ tsp. salt
1 tbsp. shortening
6 tbsp. water
recipes.Procedure: Combine the first four ingredients; set aside.  In a large saucepan, combine gravy ingredients; mix well.  Warm over low heat.  In a bowl, combine the first four dough ingredients; mix well.  Cut in shortening until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.  Stir in water; knead gently.  Roll dough to 1/8 in. thickness; cut into six squares.  Place a heaping tablespoonful of chicken mixture in center of each square.  Fold dough over and press edges together firmly to seal.  Drop bundles into simmering gravy.  Cover and cook over medium heat for 15-20 min. or until pastry flakes.

recipes.Blurb: This recipe takes only minutes to prepare
recipes.Author: Aaron Scott
recipes.Ingredients:
1  Boned, skinless chicken breast
½ tsp. Italian seasoning
¼ cup tbsp. grated Romano or Parmesan cheese
¼ cup lemon juice
recipes.Procedure: Pound chicken until thin.  Sprinkle with Italian seasoning, then with grated cheese.  Roll up breast into a cylinder and pin with toothpicks.  Poach in white wine to which the lemon juice has been added until tender.  Slice and serve immediately.

recipes.Author: La Trattoria Key Wes
recipes.Ingredients:
1 lb. veal top round, sliced to 1 oz. medallions and pounded to 1/16
2 cups white wine
lemon juice to taste
salt and pepper to taste
2 tbsp. capers
2 tbsp. butter
2 tbsp. flour
2 tbsp. chopped parsley
½ cup whole butter
recipes.Procedure: Pound veal to 1/16th of an inch. Dredge in flour. Heat pan and add butter. Saute veal 30 seconds to a side. Drain butter and add salt, pepper, lemon juice, capers, parsley and white wine. Remove veal from pan and allow sauce to reduce. Finally, add 1/2 cup of whole butter. Emulsify sauce; return veal to pan and cover with sauce; simmer until tender, about 30 min.

recipes.RecipeName: Baby Back Ribs With Spicy Apple Glaze
recipes.Author: Emeril Lagasse
recipes.Ingredients:
For the glaze:
3 cups apple cider
1 cup apple cider vinegar
1 cup apple sauce
1 cup sugar
½ cup light brown sugar
¼ cup thinly sliced ginger
½  stick cinnamon
½  vanilla bean, split in half lengthwise and seeds scraped
6  cardamom pods
2 tsp. allspice berries
1½ tsp. crushed red pepper flakes
½ tsp. dry mustard
2 tsp. minced garlic
¼ tsp. salt

For the ribs:
4  to 5 lbs. baby back ribs (2 full slabs, each cut in half)
2 tbsp. kosher salt
1 tbsp. paprika
¾ tsp. granulated garlic powder
1½ tsp. granulated onion powder
1 tsp. ground black pepper
½ tsp. cayenne pepper
½  apple cider
recipes.Procedure:
To make the glaze, place all of the ingredients for the glaze in a 6-quart pot and cook over medium-high heat. Bring the contents of the pot to a boil, stirring often to dissolve the sugar. Once the mixture has come to a boil, reduce the heat to medium, and allow the mixture to reduce to a glaze consistency, about 30 to 35 minutes longer. Remove the glaze from the stove and strain through a fine-mesh strainer. Reserve until ready to use. 
 Preheat the oven to 275 degrees F.
 Place the ribs on a large baking sheet. In a small mixing bowl, combine the kosher salt, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, black pepper, and cayenne. Stir well to incorporate, and use 1 tablespoon of the spice rub to cover each of the racks of ribs. Rub the mixture into the meat, and allow it to sit undisturbed for at least 20 minutes. 
 Pour the cider into the sheet pan, and wrap the ribs with aluminum foil to make a tight seal. Place the sheet pan in the oven and bake for 1 1/2 to 2 hours, or until the ribs are very tender. 
 Remove the ribs from the oven, discard the foil and the fat and oil from the sheet pan, and allow the ribs to cool for 15 to 20 minutes. Preheat a grill to medium. 
Brush the ribs with a generous coating of the glaze, about 3 tablespoons of the glaze per set of ribs. Place the ribs directly on the preheated grill, and cook until the ribs are browned and caramelized, 5 to 10 minutes, depending on your grill. Be careful not to let the glaze burn from flare-ups. Remove the ribs from the grill and lay on a cutting board meaty-side down. Use a sharp knife to cut the ribs apart. Serve the ribs with some of the leftover glaze on the side, if desired

recipes.RecipeName: Bourbon Glazed Salmon Filets Over Wilted Spinach
recipes.Ingredients:
4  Salmon filets, 4-6 oz. portions
1 cup dark brown sugar
¼ cup bourbon
¼ cup soy sauce
2 tbsp. chopped ginger
1 tbsp. chopped garlic
2 tbsp. lime juice
¼ cup olive oil
8 oz. baby spinach
2 tbsp. bacon crumbles
1 tsp. brown sugar
1 tsp. olive oil
½ tsp. red wine vinegar
½ tsp. lemon juice
¼ tsp. salt
¼ tsp. pepper
recipes.Procedure:
Salmon:
Combine first 8 ingredients.  Grill salmon for 2-3 minutes each side, until firm to the touch and internal temperature reaches 140º. Serve over wilted spinach.

Wilted spinach:
Combine bacon,brown sugar, olive oil, red wine vinegar, lemon juice salt an pepper.  When ready, place spinach in large pot over medium heat with other ingredients.  Toss together while cooking.  Spinach will wilt in 1-2 minutes.

recipes.Author: Aaron Scott
recipes.Ingredients:
3 tbsp. butter
8 oz. veal, sliced into scallops and pounded thin
5 oz. sliced mushrooms
1  small onion, thinly sliced
1  clove garlic, chopped
½  Marsala wine
½ cup water
1 pkg. Aug Jus mix
¼ tsp. thyme
recipes.Procedure: Melt 1 tbsp butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook veal to desired doneness.  Remove and keep warm.  Melt 1 tbsp butter and cook mushrooms and onion until lightly browned.  Add garlic and cook 30 seconds.  Stir in wine and cook 1 min.  Stir in remaining ingredients and bring to a boil  Reduce heat and simmer 1 min.  Stir in remaining tbsp of butter.  Pour over veal and serve.

recipes.Author: Madame Wong
recipes.Ingredients:
¼ cup sugar
¼ cup white vinegar
¼ cup catsup
½  green pepper, chopped
16  pieces drained canned pineapple
cornstarch to thicken
1 cup water
recipes.Procedure: Mix all ingredients in a small saucepan.  Use approximately 1 tbsp cornstarch, more or less to attain desired thickness.  Heat on medium until sauce reaches desired consistency. Serve at once.

recipes.Ingredients:
1  pie crust
¾ cup sugar
2 tbsp. all-purpose flour
1 tsp. cinnamon
¼ tsp. nutmeg
½ tsp. lemon peel
¼ tsp. salt
5  to 6 cups thinly sliced peeled apples (4 medium)
5½ cups fresh or frozen cranberries
½ cup rolled oats
⅓ cup brown sugar
⅓ cup all-purpose flour
¼ cup margarine or butter, softened
recipes.Procedure:
1.  Preheat oven to 425º.  Prepare pie crust for a one-crust filled pie in a 9-in pan.
2.  In a large bowl, combine sugar, 2 tbsp flour, cinnamon, nutmeg, lemon peel and salt; mix well.  Add apples and cranberries; mix well.  Spoon into crust-lined pan.
3.  In a small bowl, combine oats, sugar, flour and butter or margarine.  Mix with fork or pastry blender until crumbly.  Sprinkle over filling.
4.  Bake at 425º for 35-45 min. or until apples are tender and topping is golden brown.  Cover edges of crust with foil during last 15 min. to avoid excess browning.

recipes.Author: Aaron Scott
recipes.Ingredients:
4  lbs.chicken wings, disjointed and the tips discarded
2 cups all-purpose flour
1 tsp. cayenne
1 tsp. hot mustard powder
1 tsp. lemon pepper
1 tsp. garlic powder
1 tsp. onion salt
1  8-oz can tomato sauce
½ tsp. worcestershire sauce
1 tsp. tabasco or to taste
1 tsp. habanero sauce or to taste
¼ cup red pepper sauce
½ tsp. cayenne pepper
1 tsp. hot mustard powder
2 tbsp. brown sugar

Lemon juice to taste
recipes.Procedure:
Mix together flour, cayenne, mustard, lemon pepper, garlic and onion salt.  Coat wing pieces in mixture and arrange in a baking dish.  Bake at 450º until browned.  Meanwhile, in a small saucepan combine tomato sauce, worcestershire sauce, pepper sauces, mustard powder and brown sugar.  Bring just to a boil; remove from heat.
When chicken is just browned, remove from oven can cover with sauce.  Cover pan with foil and return to oven for 15 min, reducing heat to 350º.  Serve at once or freeze.

recipes.Author: Adapted From Bh&G
recipes.Ingredients:
1 cup shredded cooked chicken
2 tbsp. butter
½ cup celery, chopped coarsely
½ cup onion, chopped
2  14-oz cans chicken broth (low sodium is best)
1½ cups milk
1 tsp. hot pepper sauce (Tabasco)
1½ cups mozzerella cheese (6 oz.)
1¼ cup crumbled bleu cheese (5 oz)
½ cup shredded Parmesan cheese (2 oz)
1 cup potato, diced (optional)
½ cup all-purpose flour
Bottled hot pepper sauce (optional)
recipes.Procedure:
1. In a 4-qt dutch oven, melt butter over medium heat.  Add celery and onion; cook and stir until onion is tender.  Stir in broth, milk and 1 tsp of the hot pepper sauce.  Add potato if using.
2. In a bowl toss together mozzerella, 1 cup of the bleu cheese, Parmesan and flour.  Add gradually to soup, sitrring after each addition until melted.  Stir in shredded chicken; heat through.  Top with remaining bleu cheese and optional  hot pepper sauce.

recipes.Ingredients:
1 can Cream of Mushroom soup
½ cup milk
¼ tsp. ground black pepper
¼ cup Parmesan cheese
1 cup frozen mixed vegetables
2 cups cubed cooked chicken
2 cup medium egg noodles, cooked and drained (or use rotelle)
½ cup shredded Cheddar cheese
recipes.Procedure:
1. Stir soup, milk, pepper, Parmesan, vegetables, chicken and pasta in a 1½-qt casserole.
2.  Bake at 400º for 25 min or until hot.  Stir.
3. Top with Cheddar cheese.  Serve at once.

recipes.Author: Woman's Day
recipes.Ingredients:
1 lb. dried kidney beans
½ lb. pork sausage links
1 lb. lean lamb, cubed
2  onions, chopped
2  cloves garlic, minced
½ tsp. dried rosemary
2 tsp. salt
dash pepper
¾ cup red wine
recipes.Procedure: Cover beans with 6 cups water, bring to a boil and boil 2 min.  Let stand 1 hour, t hen cook until almost tender.  Drain, reserving 1½ cups liquid.  Cut sausages in half and fry until browned.  Remove sausage.  Brown lamb, onion and garlic in fat remaining.  Put in 3-qt casserole.  Add seasonings and wine.  Cover and bake in 350º oven 1 hour.  Add beans, sausage and bean liquid.  Cover, bake 1½ hours.

recipes.Author: Williams-Sonoma
recipes.Ingredients:
2 cups creamed spinach
4  cooked artichoke hearts, halved
4  poached eggs
4  slices toast, halved diagonally
2 tbsp. chopped chives, tarragon, parsley and chervil
2  egg yolks
1 tbsp. lemon juice
2 tsp. water
Pinch cayenne pepper
Salt and freshly ground white pepper to taste
16 tbsp. unsalted butter, melted
recipes.Procedure:
Make Hollandaise sauce by  whisking together in a double boiler the egg yolks, lemon juice and water until the mixture begins to thicken, then whisk one min. more.  Season with salt, white pepper and cayenne.  Whisk mixture while slowly pouring in melted butter in a thin stream until incorporated; about 2 min.  Keep warm but not hot.
Divide creamed spinach among 2 plates; top each with 2 artichoke halves.  Place 2 poached eggs atop artichokes.  Ladle about ¼ cup Hollandaise sauce over each serving; arrange toast around plates.

recipes.Ingredients:
1 tsp. salt
1 tsp. cayenne pepper
1 tsp. paprika
½ tsp. white pepper
½ tsp. black pepper
½ tsp. oregano
¼ tsp. garlic powder
¼ tsp. onion powder
½ cup lemon juice
¼ cup vegetable oil
4  boneless skinless chicken breast halves
recipes.Procedure:
Combine the dry spices in a small bowl. In a shallow glass dish (large enough to hold the chicken in a single layer), or a gallon size zip lock bag, place the lemon juice and oil. add half of the spice mix; stir to combine. 
Add the chicken breasts, turning to coat both sides. Marinate for 30 to 60 minutes at room temperature or at least 2 hours to overnight in the refrigerator, covered. 
Drain the chicken and sprinkle both sides with the remaining seasoning mix. Place the breasts on a hot grill with the thin ends away from the flames. Cook, turning once, until just cooked through, 3 to 8 minutes per side, depending on the heat intensity and the thickness of the meat. 
.

recipes.Ingredients:
3  eggs
1½ tbsp. mayonnaise
2 tsp. mustard
2 tsp. cider vinegar
¼ tsp. sugar
1 tbsp. cream cheese, softened
2 tsp. fresh dill
recipes.Procedure: Hard boil eggs, slice in half and remove yolks.  In a small mixing bowl, combine yolks, mayonnaise, vinegar, sugar, cream cheese and dill.  Fill each half-egg white with 1/6 of the mixture.  Cover, chill and serve.

recipes.RecipeName: Spaghetti With Tomato, Green Pepper And Anchovy
recipes.Author: Family Circle
recipes.Ingredients:
2 tbsp. olive oil
½  large green pepper, seeded and thinly sliced
4  cloves garlic, chopped
1  tin (2 oz) anchovies in oil, drained and rinsed
1  pint grape tomatoes, halved (about 2 cups)
⅛ tsp. salt
⅛ tsp. black pepper
½  lb. uncooked spaghetti
¼ cup shredded Parmesan cheese
recipes.Procedure:
1. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil
2. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.  Add green pepper and cook 2 min.  Add garlic and anchovies and cook for 1 min., mashing anchovies with spoon.
3. Add tomatoes, salt and pepper.  Cook 5 min., stirring.
4.  While sauce is cooking, prepare pasta.  Drain, reserving ½ cup cooking water.
5.  Toss pasta with tomatoe mixture and remaining ½ tbsp olive oil.  Add 2 tbsp pasta water, if needed.  Serve with cheese.

recipes.Author: Julia Child
recipes.Ingredients:
1  lamb shank, small
4  large cloves garlic, peeled and chopped
2 cups tomato pulp (canned and/or fresh, seeded and juiced)
½ tsp. rosemary
2  bay leaves
2½ cups onion, sliced
2 tbsp. olive oil
2 cups dry white wine
4 cups white beans, drained and rinsed
chicken stock
salt
recipes.Procedure: Rinse and dry lamb shank.  Brown in hot olive oil in a frying pan; transfer to a heavy casserole.  Pour oil out of pan, add 2 tbsp olive oil and brown onions lightly.  Pour in wine and bring to a boil, scraping up the coagulated browning juices.  Pour wine and onions into casserole.  Add garlic, tomato pulp, rosemary, bay leave and enough chicken stock to barely cover the indredients.  Salt to taste, cover and simmer slowly about 1¼ hours, or until meat is almost tender (when it needs about 10 min. more).  Tip the casserole and skim off surface fat.  Coorect seasoning and strength of cooking liquid.  Fold in beans; cover and simmer 10 min.  or until meat is tender but still clings to the bone.  Serve from casserole.

recipes.Author: Lori Hiscock
recipes.Ingredients:
3 cups frozen shredded hash brown potatoes, thawed
1  egg, lightly beaten
¼ cup Parmesan cheese, grated
1½ cups zucchini, sliced
¾ cup diced sweet red pepper
1 tbsp. butter or margarine
½ cup diced fully cooked ham
2  eggs, lightly beaten
¼ cup milk
1½ tsp. dried basil
Salt and pepper to taste
¾ cup Monterey Jack cheese, shredded`
recipes.Procedure: In a bowl, combine the hash browns, egg and Parmesan cheese.  Press into the bottom and up the sides of a greased 9-in pie plate.  Bake at 400º for 15-20 min.  or until golden brown.  Meanwhile, in a skillet, sauté zucchini and red pepper in butter until al dente.  Remove from the heat; stir in the ham, eggs, milk, basil, salt and pepper.  Pour into crust.  Sprinkle with Monterey Jack cheese.  Bake at 400º for 15-20 min. or until a knife inserted near the center comes out clean.  Let stand 5 min. before cutting.

recipes.Author: Rosemary Robbins
recipes.Ingredients:
1 cup (1-8 oz. bottle) clam juice
6½ oz. clams, drained, liquid reserved
1 cup tomato juice
1  medium potato, cubed
1  small carrot, shredded
½  medium onion, chopped fine
1  slice bacon, cooked and crumbled
parsley leaves
celery leaves
bay leaf
thyme
salt and pepper
recipes.Procedure: In saucepan, stir together clam juice and reserved clam liquid, tomato juice, potato, carrot, bacon, onion and seasonings to taste.  Bring mixture to a boil; reduce heat and simmer until potatoes and carrots are tender.  Add clams and continue simmering just until clams are heated throughout.  Serve at once.

recipes.Blurb: These may be made a day ahead and refigerated, or frozen for longer storage.
recipes.Ingredients:
1  egg
¾ cup soft bread crumbs (about 1 slice bread)
¼ cup chili sauce
½ tsp. salt
½ tsp. minced onion
⅛ tsp. garlic powder
¾  lb. ground beef
¼ cup minced celery
recipes.Procedure: Beat egg in medium bowl.  Mix in bread crumbs, chili sauce, salt, onion, garlic powder, ground beef and celery.  Shape into meatballs of desired size and place on waxed paper to refrigerate or freeze until ready to cook.  Add uncooked meatballs to choice of sauce and simmer until meat is cooked through.

recipes.Blurb: Brown and crumble a bit, then mix with scrambled eggs for breakfast.
recipes.Ingredients:
2  lbs.ground pork
3½ tsp. salt
6 tbsp. ground red chile
6  small hot dried peppers
4  cloves garlic, minced
2 tbsp. dry leaf oregano
2 tsp. cumin seed, crushed
1 tsp. ground black pepper
1½ tsp. sugar
4 tbsp. cider or wine vinegar
2½ tbsp. water
recipes.Procedure: Have everything cool.  Break up the meat, sprinkle evenly with the rest of the indredients and cut in with a fork.  Knead by hand until well-mixed.  At this point, keep the Chorizo in you refrigerator up to two weeks; or let season in the refrigerator for a couple of days, then package into 3-4 oz packages (serves two people) and freeze.  Can be stuffed into casings and smoked, if desired.

recipes.Author: Country Living
recipes.Ingredients:
1 tbsp. canola oil
½ lb. raw Chorizo
½  large red onion
1  large red bell pepper
½ tsp. salt
1 tsp. dried oregano
½ tsp. ground black pepper
2½ cups crumbled cornbread
3½ cups white bread cubes (about  1/2-in)
¾ cup chopped cilantro
¾ cup chicken broth
¼ cup toasted pumpkin seeds
1  lime, cut into wedges
recipes.Procedure: Heat oven to 350º.  Lightly butter a 9- by 13-in baking dish and set aside.  Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over meadium-high heat, add the Chorizo and brown it, crumbling it as it cooks, about  5 min.  Add onion, bell peppers, salt, oregano and pepper and continue to cook until soft, 3 to 4 min.  Remove from heat; toss with remaining indredients, except lime.  Transfer to prepared dish and bake until heated through and golden; about 30-40 min.  Serve with lime wedges.

recipes.Ingredients:
1  package short ribs (about 6 ribs)
1  carrot, chopped
1  stalk celery, chopped
1  medium onion, chopped
1  tomato, cut into eighths
3  cloves garlic, chopped
3 tbsp. extra virgin olive oil
1 cup white wine
1 cup unsalted broth (any kind)
recipes.Procedure: Preheat oven to 350º.  Heat oil in pan until it begins to smoke (about 360º).  Add ribs to pan and brown on all sides.  Transfer ribs to a covered baking dish.  Add a small amount of the broth to pan and deglaze.  Add carrot, celery, onion and garlic and cook several minutes.  Add wine, remaining broth and tomatoes; cook until mixture begins to boil.  Pour over ribs, cover and bake at 350º for 3 hours.  Remove ribs; strain liquid into a saucepan and reduce by half, scraping off any fat that froths up.  Remove meat from bones and remove tendon and gristle. (At this point the meat can be packaged with the reduced liquid and kept for up to a week.)  Arrange meat on a plate and cover with the reduced liquid.

recipes.Author: Jan Seibert
recipes.Ingredients:
½  lb. ground beef
½  lb. chorizo (or pork sausage, if you're a wimp)
1 cup onion, chopped
2  cloves garlic, minced or pressed
2 cans (4 oz. each) whole green chilies, drained and seeded
2 cups sharp cheddar cheese, divided
4  eggs
¼ cup all-purpose flour
1½ cups milk
½ tsp. salt
Pepper sauce
recipes.Procedure: In a large skillet, crumble together the ground beef and chorizo.  Cook over medium heat, stirring until meat is browned.  Add onion and garlic; cook until onion is tender.  Drain off fat.  Line a 9in.x 9in. baking dish with half the chilies; top with 1/½ cups of the cheese.  Add the meat mixture and top with remaining chilies; set aside.  Beat together eggs and flour until smooth; add milk, salt and pepper sauce; blend well.  Pour the egg mixture over casserole.  Bake, uncovered, at 350º for about 40 min. or until knife inserted into the center comes out clean.  Sprinkle remaing ½ cup cheese on top; let stand 5 min. before serving;.

recipes.Author: Men's Health
recipes.Ingredients:
2  Chicken breasts, boned and skinned
2 tbsp. chopped sun-dried tomatoes
2 tbsp. feta cheese, crumbled
2 tbsp. chopped olives
1 tsp. garlic, minced
1 tbsp. pine nuts
1 tbsp. balsamic vinegar
Extra-virgin olive oil
Salt and pepper
recipes.Procedure:
1. Preheat oven to 450º.  Toss together the tomatoes, feta cheese, olives, garlic, pine nuits and vinegar
2. Using a small, sharp knife, cut a slit along the thick part of each breast, creating a pocket.  Fill each pocket with the stuffing.  Mix salt, pepper and olive oil and brush each breast with the mixture.  Transfer each breast to a baking pan.
3.  Bake for 15-20 min. or until interior temperature reaches 175º.  Top with any remaining stuffing.

recipes.Ingredients:
1 cup sugar
3 tbsp. cornstarch
2  14.5-oz cans red tart pie cherries
¼ tsp. nutmeg
¼ tsp. red food coloring (optional)
¼ tsp. almond extract (optional)
1 tbsp. lemon juice
1 tbsp. unsalted butter
2  crusts for 9-in pie
recipes.Procedure: Preheat oven to 400º.  Drain the cherries and reserve the juice from one can only.  In a saucepan, stir the cherry juice into the combined mixture of the cornstarch and half the sugar.  Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly until thickened.  Remove from heat.  Gently stir in the remaining sugar, cherries and optional ingredients.  Pour filling into pastry-lined pie pan.  Dot with butter.  Adjust crust, seal and vent.  Bake 45 min. or until crust browns and filling begins to bubble.  If necessary, cover edges with aluminum foil during last 15 min to prevent over-browning.  Cool pie several hours to allow filling to thicken before slicing.

recipes.Blurb: This is a fruit salad dressing
recipes.Ingredients:
½ cup cider vinegar
½ cup sugar
1 tsp. dry mustard
1 tbsp. grated onion
1 tsp. salt
1 cup salad oil
1 tbsp. celery seed
recipes.Procedure: In covered blender at low speed blend all ingredients except oil until well mixed.  Turn to high speed and very slowly add oil until well mixed.  Refrigerate.

recipes.Author: Penzeys
recipes.Ingredients:
6  slices white sandwich bread
3  eggs
3 tbsp. milk
½ cup chopped ham
½ cup swiss cheese, shredded
1 tsp. seasoning (Mural of Flavor or Fox Point or make your own)
⅛ tsp. black pepper
recipes.Procedure: Preheat oven to 325º.  Spray 2 mini-muffin pans with vegetable spray; set aside.  Remove the crust from the bread.  Cut each slice into 4 squares.  Press one bread square into each mini-muffin cup.  It will line the bottom and go up the sides slightly.  Beat the eggs; add milk,  ham, cheese, seasoning and pepper.  Divide the mixture evenly between the 24 cups (about 2 tsp per cup).  Bake at 325º for 13-15 min. or until eggs are set.

recipes.Author: Joy Of Cooking
recipes.Ingredients:
¼ cup butter
1 tsp. anchovy paste
⅛ tsp. onion juice
¼ tsp. lemon juice
a few grains of cayenne
recipes.Procedure: Cream the butter until soft.  Beat in remaining ingredients.

recipes.Ingredients:
1½ lb. boneless chuck steak, or pork tenderloin
1  clove garlic, peeled and minced
¼ cup wine vinegar
1 tbsp. brown sugar
1 tsp. paprika
2 tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
½ cup ketchup
1 tsp. salt
1 tsp. dry mustard
¼ tsp. black pepper
recipes.Procedure: Slice meat into slices about ½" thick; place into crockpot.  Mix remaining ingredients in a small bowl and pour over meat; mix.  Cover and cook 3-5 hours

recipes.Ingredients:
1  loaf Italian bread
½ cup soft butter
1 tsp. parsley flakes
¼ tsp. oregano, crumbled
¼ tsp. dried dill weed
1  clove garlic, minced
Parmesan cheese
recipes.Procedure: Cut bread diagonally into 1 in. slices.  Blend butter, herbs and garlic.  Put bread slices together with butter mixture in between slices.  Wrap in foil, twisting ends and leaving the top open.  Sprinkle liberally with Parmesan cheese and parsley flakes.  Heat in oven at 400º for 10 min.

recipes.Author: Rosemary Robbins
recipes.Ingredients:
1 cup sugar
3 tbsp. cornstarch
2  14 1/2oz cans tart pie cherries
¼ tsp. nutmeg
¼ tsp. red food coloring
¼ tsp. lemon extract
1 tbsp. lemon juice
1 tbsp. unsalted butter
recipes.Procedure: Drain cherries, reserving one can of juice.  Mix juice, cornstarch and ½ of the sugar.  Heat over medium heat until simmering.  Add cherries, and remaining ingredients except butter.  Stir until thickened; add butter and stir until melted.

recipes.Author: Cuisine At Home
recipes.Ingredients:
1  Boneless, skinless chicken breast
1 tsp. black pepper
½ tsp. kosher salt
1 cup bread crumbs, freshly made
¼ cup oil-packed sun-dried tomatoes, drained and sliced
2  large cloves garlic, peeled
¼ cup all-purpose flour
1  egg
1 tbsp. water
1 tbsp. olive oil
recipes.Procedure: Preheat oven to 375º. Slice the breast in half lengthwise; lb. each piece to ½" thick. Season with pepper and salt. In a food processor, mix bread crumbs, tomatoes and garlic. Transfer to a shallow dish. Coat chicken with flour; dredge in egg beaten with water. Dredge in crumb mixture and pat on both sides. Sauté in olive oil 3 min. or until golden brown. Place in baking dish; roast 8-10 min until cooked through. Serve with Sunny Butter Sauce.

recipes.Blurb: A variation on lemon-caper sauce, this sauce is great on Sun-dried Tomato Crusted Chicken
recipes.Author: Cuisine At Home
recipes.Ingredients:
1 cup dry white wine
2 tbsp. capers
2 tbsp. lemon juice
½ cup cold unsalted butter, sliced
¼ cup oil-packed sun-dried tomatoes, drained and sliced
½ cup fresh parsley, chopped
recipes.Procedure: Boil wine in skillet until reduced by half.  Add capers and lemon juice; reduce heat to low.  Whisk in butter and allow to melt, a piece at a time.  Stir in tomatoes and parsley.

recipes.Author: Bratton's Seafood Gr
recipes.Ingredients:
1 cup chopped potatoes
1 cup chopped celery
1 cup chopped onions
2  (4) cans chopped clams
¾ cup butter
½  - 3/4 cup flour
½ tsp. white pepper
1 tsp. salt
½ tsp. sugar
pinch thyme
1  qt half-and-half (or milk for lower fat)
recipes.Procedure: Drain clams, pouring clam juice into pot with potatoes, celery and onions.  Add enough water to cover and simmer 20 min.  Make a creamy mixture of melted butter and flour.  Slowly add half-and-half and seasonings and let simmer until thickened.  Add potatoes, celery, onions, clams.  Stir and simmer.  If too thick, thin with milk.

recipes.Ingredients:
½ cup onions, chopped
1 tbsp. garlic, minced
2 tbsp. olive oil
5 cans tomatoes plus juice
⅔ cup puréed basil
2 tsp. sugar
⅛ tsp. cayenne
2 tbsp. red wine vinegar
½ tsp. dry mustard
1 cup grated paremesan cheese
4 cups vegetable stock
recipes.Procedure: In bottom of heavy stock pot, sauté garlic and onion in olive oil for about 5 min, or until soft.  All all other ingredients except Parmesan and bring to a simmer.  Simmer for about 20 min.  Remove 2 cup of hot soup and whisk the Parmesan cheese into it.  Return the cheese aned soup mixture to the pot.  Adjust seasonings and serve.

recipes.Author: Joy Of Cooking
recipes.Ingredients:
3½ cups all-purpose flour
2 tsp. salt
2 tbsp. baking powder
6 tbsp. unsalted butter
5 tbsp. buttermilk powder (optional)
1⅓ cup milk
½ cup shredded cheddar cheese (optional)
1 tsp. garlic powder (optional)
recipes.Procedure:
Place flour, salt, baking powder and butter into food processor. Process until the butter is fully blended with flour (flour will be dense). While processor is running, slowly add milk. Continue processing until dough forms a ball (add additional milk, a little at a time, if dough is too dry to form ball). Remove from food processor and roll on lightly floured surface to a thickness of 3/4 in. Cut with biscuit cutter, taking care not to twist the cutter. Place biscuits on ungreased baking sheet and bake at 450º for 12-15 min. Brush the biscuits with melted butter after the first 7 min of baking and, if desired, again after 9 min.
FOR GARLIC-CHEDDAR BISCUITS:
Reduce butter to 3 tbsp. Add optional cheese and garlic powder before processing in food processor.

recipes.Blurb: This is a "knock-off" recipe of Red Lobster's cheddar buiscuits.
recipes.Ingredients:
3½ cups all-purpose flour
2 tsp. salt
2 tbsp. baking powder
6 tbsp. unsalted butter
¼ tsp. garlic powder
1 cup grated cheddar cheese
1 cup milk
recipes.Procedure: Place flour, salt, baking powder and butter into food processor. Process until the butter is fully blended with flour (flour will be dense). Add grated cheese and process until mixed with flour. While processor is running, slowly add milk. Continue processing until dough forms a ball (add additional milk, a little at a time, if dough is too dry to form ball). Remove from food processor and roll on lightly floured surface to a thickness of 3/4 in. Cut with biscuit cutter, taking care not to twist the cutter. Place biscuits on ungreased baking sheet and bake at 450º for 12-15 min. Brush the biscuits with melted butter mixed with 1/4 tsp. dried parsley and 1/2 tsp. garlic powder after the first 7 min of baking and, if desired, again after 9 min.

recipes.Ingredients:
5  lbs.chicken wings
salt and fresh ground black pepper to taste
3 tbsp. Frank's hot sauce
2 tbsp. veg oil
flour
For the glaze:
3  crushed garlic cloves
2 tbsp. grated ginger
1 tbsp. Sambal chili sauce (or 1/2 tsp. hot pepper flakes)
½ cup rice vinegar
½ cup packed brown sugar
1 tsp. soy sauce
recipes.Procedure: Separate wings into flat, drum and tip.  Discard tips.  Place wings in bowl; add salt and pepper to taste and 3 tbsp hot sauce.  Mix well.  Add oil and mix.  Place wings in bag with enough flour to coat thoroughly and shake until wings are thoroughly coated.    Place wings on greased baking sheet and spray lightly with oil.  Bake at 400º for 30 min.  Turn wings and bake another 30 min.  While wings are baking, mix incredients for the glaze in a small saucepan.  Heat glaze until boiling.  Place baked wings in a bowl and pour the sauce over them and mix to coat.  Using tongs, place coated wings back on baking sheet to cool.

recipes.Ingredients:
1½ cups kosher salt
¾ cup coarsely ground black pepper
1  head of garlic, peeled
½ cup rosemary
2 tbsp. chile powder
¾ cup extra-virgin olive oil
One 15- to 16-pound prime rib roast (6 bones)
recipes.Procedure:
1.In a food processor, combine the salt, pepper, garlic cloves, rosemary and chile powder and process until fine. Add the olive oil and pulse to form a paste. Place the prime rib roast on a cutting board, bone-side up and rub with 1 tablespoon of the salt paste. Transfer the meat to a large roasting pan and pack the salt paste all over the fatty surface, pressing to help it adhere. Let the prime rib stand at room temperature for 1 hour.
2.Preheat the oven to 450°. Roast the prime rib for 1 hour, until the crust is slightly darkened. Lower the oven temperature to 300° and roast for about 2 hours and 15 minutes longer, until an instant-read thermometer inserted into the center of the roast (not touching the bone) registers 135°. Transfer the roast to a large carving board and let the meat rest for 30 minutes.
3.Carefully lift the salt crust off the meat and transfer to a bowl. Brush away any excess salt. To remove the roast in one piece while keeping the rib rack intact, run a long sharp carving knife along the bones, using them as your guide. Leave on 1/2 inch of meat, more if reserving for leftovers. Carve the prime rib roast 1/2 inch thick and serve, passing some of the crumbled salt crust as a condiment

recipes.Ingredients:
1  (4-rib) standing beef rib roast (bone-in prime rib; 9 to 10 pounds), at room temperature 1 hour
2 tbsp. extra-virgin olive oil
3 tbsp. kosher salt
⅓ cup mixed peppercorns (pink, white, and green)
recipes.Procedure:
Preheat oven to 450°F with rack in middle. 

Rub roast all over with oil, then sprinkle all over with kosher salt. Coarsely crush peppercorns in a folded kitchen towel (not terry cloth) with a meat pounder or bottom of a heavy skillet. Coat meat on all sides with peppercorns, pressing to help them adhere. 

Roast on a rack in a 13- by 9-inch roasting pan 20 minutes. Reduce oven temperature to 350°F and roast until an instant-read thermometer inserted into center of meat (do not touch bone) registers 110°F, 1 1/2 to 2 hours more. Transfer to platter and let rest, uncovered, 30 minutes (temperature of meat will rise to about 130°F for medium-rare).?

recipes.Ingredients:
5 cup egg whites
2 lb. rock salt
1  8-10 lb. prime rib roasts (fat cap on)
recipes.Procedure:
Add a quantity of the salt to a large metal bowl. Add some of the egg whites, and stir together. You may need to use your hands as it will be rather difficult. Continue alternating adding salt and egg whites.
Stop when you've reached a very thick, cement-like consistency. The crust mix should be thick enough to pack into a ball that holds its shape. Exact measurements aren't necessary, but you'll need enough to coat the rib roast.Heat the oven to 325º. 
Line the bottom and sides of a roasting pan completely with heavy-duty aluminum foil. Place a layer of the crust mix in the bottom of the pan in a shape that matches the dimensions of the roast. This base layer should be about 1/2-inch thick.Place the roast on top, and then cover all of it with a 1/2-inch thick layer of the crust mix so that it is completely encased. Place the roast in the oven, and cook for about four to five hours. Figure 25 to 30 minutes per pound for medium rare.Let meat rest in the crust for 30 minutes.Crack the crust open with a hammer, and discard it. Serve the meat.

recipes.Author: Jeanne Jones
recipes.Ingredients:
12  slices white bread, crusts removed and cut into halves, diagonally
2 cups grated Cheddar cheese
3 cups nonfat milk
4  large eggs
¼ tsp. ground black pepper
½ tsp. salt
¾ tsp. dried sage, crushed
1½ tsp. dried thyme, crushed
recipes.Procedure: Spray a 13x9-inch baking dish with nonstick spray.  Line the dish with half the bread, overlapping to make them fit.  Top with half the grated cheese.  Combine all remaining ingredients in a bowl and mix well.  Pour half of the liquid mixture over hte bread and cheese.  Layer the second layer of bread, cheese and liquid.  Cover the dish tightly with plastic wrap.  Refrigerate for several hours or overnight before baking.  Remove from the refrigerator 2 hours before baking.  Preheat oven to 325º.  Place baking dish in the oven and bake uncovered 40 min, or until a knife inserted into the center comes out clean.  Allow to stand 5 min. before cutting.

recipes.Ingredients:
2  packages Jimmy Dean hot sausage
2  packages Philadelphia cream cheese
1  green bell pepper, diced
1  red bell pepper, diced
1  medium onion, diced
⅛ tsp. garlic, minced
3  jalepeno peppers, diced
1  bunch fresh parsley
lemon pepper, to taste
seasoned salt, to taste
Large mushrooms (about 2-2 1/2 boxes), stems removed and reserved.
6  mushroom stems, diced
recipes.Procedure: Brown sausage lightly; chop as finely as possible.  Drain off all but 1 tbsp fat.  Add red and green pepers, seasoned salt, lemon pepper, garlic and parsley; cook at medium  heat for 8-10 min in frying pan.  Add onions, jalepenos and mushroom stems; cook for 10 min (longer if you want the flavor extra hot).  Blend in 1½-2 packages of the cream cheese; remove from heat and allow to cool slightly.  Stuff mushrooms; cook in microwave oven for 3-5 min or until mushrooms turn light brown.  Serve at once.

recipes.Author: Rosemary Robbins
recipes.Ingredients:
2  prepared pie crusts
¾ cup sugar
2 tbsp. all-purpose flour
1½ tsp. apple pie spice
½ tsp. lemon peel
¼ tsp. salt
2  green apples, peeled, cored and sliced thin
3 cups fresh or frozen cranberries
recipes.Procedure: Preheat oven to 425º. In bowl combine flour, sugar, spice, lemon peel and salt. Mix well. Slice apples, placing the slices in a bowl of water to which lemon juice has been added to prevent turning brown. Add fruit to spice mixture and mix well. Add to pie crust and top with second crust. Bake 35-45 min or until fruit is tender. Cover edges of pie crust during the last 15 min of baking to prevent burning.

recipes.Author: Rosemary Robbins
recipes.Ingredients:
1  Betty Crocker white cake mix
1½ cups water
⅓ cup vegetable oil
3  egg whites
¾ cup dry sherry
3 oz. chopped dried apricots
3 oz. chopped cranberries
3 oz. chopped golden raisins
3 oz. dried pineapple or pineapple-fruit mix
¼ cup chopped pecans or walnuts
1 tsp. grated nutmeg
1 tsp. lemon peel
1 tsp. orange peel
½ cup brandy
recipes.Procedure: Put fruit in medium saucepan with brandy.  Bring to a simmer; remove from heat and let sit for 30 min., then drain.  Add to cake mix water, vegetable oil, sherry, egg whites, nutmeg, lemon peel and orange peel. Stir well in mixing pan then beat with mixer for 5 min.  Add fruit when cool and nuts.  Mix thoroughly.  Pour into greased and floured bundt pan and bake at 350º for 45 min.

recipes.Ingredients:
3 tbsp. kosher salt
2 tbsp. sugar
1 tbsp. brown sugar
2 tsp. ground black pepper
2 tsp. ground celery seed
2 tsp. paprika
2 tsp. garlic powder
1 tsp. cayenne
1 tsp. onion powder
½ tsp. chili powder
¼ tsp. ground cumin
¼ tsp. ground fennel seed
recipes.Procedure: May substitute dill seed for fennel.  Mix ingredients together and use to rub salmon before broiling or baking.

recipes.Author: Aarp Magazine
recipes.Ingredients:
1 lb. frozen French fries
2 tbsp. minced garlic
2 tbsp. olive oil
2 tbsp. fresh parsley leaves, chopped
Salt to taste
recipes.Procedure: Cook fries according to package directions.  While fries are baking, sauté the garlic in the olive oil for 2-3 min.  Do not let brown.  Remove fries from the oven, and toss with the garlic mixture and parsley.  Sprinkle with salt and serve.

recipes.Author: Epicurious.Com
recipes.Ingredients:
2  Tbsp Olive oil
1  (2 oz.) can anchovies drained
2 tsp. minced garlic
2  Tbsp capers drained
2 cups diced fresh or canned tomatoes drained
½ cup fresh parsley chopped
Fresh ground black pepper
recipes.Procedure: Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium high heat. Add the anchovies and stir until they start to dissolve about 30 seconds. Add the garlic and sauté another 30 seconds. Add the capers and tomatoes. Sauté 2 minutes more. Remove from heat, and add the parsley and pepper to taste. Serve over spaghetti.

recipes.Blurb: Old recipe from 1910
recipes.Author: Ruth Douglass
recipes.Ingredients:
1½ cup cooked rice
½ cup chopped green onions
½ cup chopped parsley
½ cup chopped tomatoes
2 tbsp. capers, drained
Salt
Pepper
Salad oil
Red wine vinegar
recipes.Procedure: Toss rice in large bowl with other ingredients; season to taste with salt, pepper, oil and vinegar

recipes.Author: Nellie Bramwell
recipes.Ingredients:
4  qts tomatoes, chopped
2 cups onion, chopped
2 cups green bell peppers, chopped
1  hot red pepper, chopped
¾ cup sugar
1½ cup vinegar
3 tbsp. salt
1 tbsp. celery seed
1 tsp. allspice
1 tsp. cinnamon
1 tsp. cloves
1 tbsp. pickling spice
recipes.Procedure: Bring ingredients to a boil, simmer until thickened, stirring frequently, about 1-2 hours.  Pur into hot sterile jars, leaving ¼" head space.  Process 15 min. in boiling water bath.  Makes about 8 pts.

recipes.Author: Bh&G
recipes.Ingredients:
3  medium potatoes, thinly sliced (1 pound)
1  small onion, thinly sliced
1 lb. boneless veal leg round steak, cut 1/2 inch thick
1 tbsp. cooking oil
1 tbsp. vinegar or lemon juice
1 tsp. honey
1 tsp. cornstarch
½ tsp. instant beef or chicken bouillon granules
¼ tsp. dried thyme, crushed
⅛ tsp. salt
Dash pepper
recipes.Procedure:
Spray a large skillet with nonstick spray coating. Preheat skillet over medium heat. Add potatoes and onion, spreading evenly. Add 1 cup water. Bring to boiling; reduce heat. Cover and cook for 15 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Uncover and cook 3 to 5 minutes more or until lightly browned, turning occasionally with spatula. Transfer vegetables to a serving platter; keep warm. 
Meanwhile, cut veal into 8 pieces. Pound each piece to 1/4-inch thickness. Add oil to skillet. Cook veal, half at a time, in hot oil over medium-high heat about 1 minute per side or until tender. Remove veal from skillet; arrange atop vegetables. 
In a mixing bowl stir together vinegar, honey, cornstarch, bouillon granules, thyme, salt, pepper, and 2/3 cup water. Stir into skillet. Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly. Cook and stir 1 minute more. Pour vinegar mixture over meat and vegetables. Serve immediately. If desired, garnish with tomato wedges.

recipes.Author: Family Circle
recipes.Ingredients:
½ cup butter, softened
½ cup sugar
2 tsp. vanilla
1  egg, separated
1¼ cups all purpose flour
⅔ cup chopped nuts (almonds, walnuts, pecans, or other)
Raspberry jam
recipes.Procedure:
1. Beat butter, sugar, vanilla and egg yolk in food processor until fluffy.  Add flour, process until dough separates from side of bowl.
2.  Divide dough into 24 pieces of equal size; roll each piece into a ball.  Dip into slightly beaten egg white; roll in chopped nuts.  Place on ungreased baking sheet; press and indentation in each with finger; fill with ¼ tsp jam.
3. Bake at 300º for 20 min. or until golden.  Cool on wire racks.

recipes.Author: Patsy's Restaurant
recipes.Ingredients:
5  medium white mushrooms, cleaned and sliced
¼ cup olive oil
1  small yellow onion, finely chopped
3  garlic cloves, minced
½  lb. finely ground lean beef
1  16-ounce can plum tomatoes, with juice
2  bay leaves
¼ cup Cabernet Sauvignon
¼ cup beef broth
Pinch of oregano
2 tbsp. unsalted butter
1 tbsp. chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley
Salt and freshly ground black pepper, to taste
4 tbsp. freshly grated Parmigiano-Reggiano
1 lb. penne (or spirali pasta), cooked al dente
recipes.Procedure:
Bring a large pot of water to a boil, add the mushrooms, and blanch for 2 minutes. Drain, chop finely, and reserve.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high flame and sauté the onions for 3 to 4 minutes, or until lightly browned. Add the blanched mushrooms, garlic, and ground beef, and continue to cook and stir for 7 to 8 minutes, until the meat is browned. Coarsely chop the tomatoes and add with their juice, then bay leaves, wine, broth, and oregano. Bring to a boil, reduce the heat to low, and simmer for 15 minutes.
Remove the bay leaves. Add the butter and parsley and season with salt and pepper. Sprinkle and stir in the Parmigiano-Reggiano and serve over the cooked pasta.

recipes.Author: W. Florence Johns
recipes.Ingredients:
½ cup chopped onion
½ cup chopped green pepper
1  celery rib, chopped
1 tsp. minced garlic
2 tbsp. vegetable oil
2  (8 ounce) cans tomato sauce
1 tsp. chili powder
½ tsp. sugar
¼ tsp. cayenne pepper
1 lb. frozen, peeled shrimp, thawed
Hot cooked rice
recipes.Procedure:
In a large skillet, saute the onion, green pepper, celery and garlic in oil for 6 minutes. Stir in the tomato sauce, chili powder, sugar and cayenne. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat; simmer, uncovered, for 10 minutes. Add shrimp; cook and stir 2-3 minutes until shrimp turn  pink.
Serve with rice.

recipes.RecipeName: Shrimp With Feta Cheese And Artichoke Hearts
recipes.Ingredients:
¾ cup chicken broth
¼ cup dry white wine
1 tbsp. lemon peel
1 cup frozen peas
6 oz. artichoke hearts, drained and sliced
8 oz. shelled uncooked shrimp
½ cup Feta cheese, crumbled
1 cup rice
¼ cup orzo
recipes.Procedure:
Add rice and orzo to water and bring to a boil.  Cover and let cook, about 25 min.   While water heats, combine chicken broth, wine, shrimp and lemon peel in a 2-3 quart sauce pan.  Bring to boil over high heat.  Cook 2-3 min, or until shrimp turn pink.  Keep warm.  When rice is tender, add peas and stir.  
Mix shrimp mixture and rice and stir.  Add Feta cheese and stir. Serve at once.

recipes.Blurb: A cold version of German potato salad
recipes.Author: Rosemary Robbins
recipes.Ingredients:
2  medium potatoes, diced
2  slices bacon fried crisp and crumbled
¼ cup cider vinegar
¼ cup onion, chopped
1  egg, hard-boiled and chopped fine
Mayonnaise
1  stalk celery, diced
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.Procedure: Add salt and pepper together and mix.  Add bacon, onion and celery; mix.  Add  mayonnaise to moisten; mix.  Sprinkle egg on top of salad; serve cold.

recipes.Blurb: A great seasoning; the ribs STILL require a good barbeque sauce, though.
recipes.Author: Williams-Sonoma
recipes.Ingredients:
Ingredients:
2 tbsp. Rib Rub
1½ cups water
1 can tomato paste
3½  lb. pork baby back ribs, cut into 3- or 4-bone slabs
recipes.Procedure:
Prepare a grill for indirect grilling over medium-high heat. If using a gas grill, set a smoker box filled with hickory chips over direct heat. 

In the base of a 10-quart stovetop pressure cooker, stir together the water, ketchup and 2 Tbs. of the Rib Rub mixture; reserve the remaining mixture. Place the ribs, bone side down, in the pressure cooker. Close and lock the lid and bring up to high pressure over high heat. Reduce the heat to medium-low and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from the heat and let the pressure dissipate naturally, about 10 minutes. Carefully remove the lid and transfer the ribs to a steel grill roaster set on a baking sheet. Pour the cooking sauce from the pressure cooker into a basting pot or liquid measuring cup. Brush the meaty side of the ribs with the sauce. 

Set the roaster on the grill over indirect heat. Cover the grill and cook for 15 to 20 minutes, brushing the ribs every 5 minutes with the sauce. Transfer the ribs to a cutting board and sprinkle with the remaining spice mixture. Cut into individual ribs and serve immediately. Serves 4.

recipes.Author: Cooks.Com
recipes.Ingredients:
3 tbsp. butter or olive oil
1  onion, chopped
1  garlic clove, chopped or minced
1  med. carrot, chopped
2  celery stalks, chopped
2  med. potatoes, cubed
2 tbsp. chopped green pepper
1  bay leaf
pinch of thyme
1  tomato, chopped
1  8oz. can tomato sauce
2  14oz cans vegetable stock
1 cup water
Tabasco to taste
salt and pepper to taste
Juice of 1 lemon
1  filet cod, cut into bite-sized pieced
12  medium raw shrimp, shelled
recipes.Procedure: Sauté the onions and garlic in butter or oil until onions are translucent.  Add carrots, celery and potatoes; sauté gently for 5 min.  Add bay leaf, thyme, tomatoes, tomato sauce, stock and water.  Simmer for 15-20 min. or until vegetables are tender.  Add pepper sauce, salt and pepper to taste.  Stir in lemon juice, fish and shrimp.  Simmer 5 min until fish is just cooked and shrimp have turned pink.  Serve with fresh corn bread.

recipes.Author: Taste Of Home
recipes.Ingredients:
1 lb. pork tenderloin
1 tbsp. butter, softened
¼ tsp. dried thyme
Dash cayenne (use paprika for the faint of heart)
1 cup orange juice, divided
1 tbsp. all-purpose flour
1½ tsp. sugar
recipes.Procedure:
Slice pork thickly; place in an ungreased 13inx9in baking dish.  Combine butter, thyme and cayenne; spread over pork.  Pour 3/4 cup orange juice over meat.  Bake uncovered at 425º for 25-30 min. or until a meat thermometer reads 160º-170º, basting occasionally.
Remove pork and keep warm.  Pour pan drippings into a measuring cup and add enough remaining orange juice to make 3/4 cup total.  Pour into a saucepan and stir in flour and sugar.
Bring to a boil over medium heat; cook and stir for 2 min. or until thickened.  Pour over pork and serve.

recipes.Ingredients:
4  dried hot peppers
3  dried ancho peppers (optional)
4 tsp. cumin seed
1 tsp. garlic powder
1 tsp. ground coriander
1 tsp. ground oregano
½ tsp. whole cloves
recipes.Procedure: Add ingredients to spice mill and grind together until powdered and well mixed.  Store in an airtight container.

recipes.Author: Good Housekeeping
recipes.Ingredients:
1¾ cups dried beans
5 cups cold water
¼  lb. salt pork
1  peeled small onion
2½ tsp. salt
¼ tsp. dry mustard
⅛ tsp. pepper
¼ cup molasses
recipes.Procedure: Wash beans; pick over and soak in cold water overnight.  Cover, gring to a boil in the same water in which they were soaked.  Skim, then simmer, covered until easily pierced with a fork—about 30 min.  Drain, reserving liquid.  Pour boiling water over salt pork; scrape rind until white; then cut almost through at ½ in. intervals.  Place beans in a 2 qt. bean pot, tucking in onion.  Bury pork in beans so only rind is exposed.  Put salt, mustard, pepper and molasses in measuring cup and fill with about 2 cups of reserved bean liquid.  Stir until dissolved; pour over beans.  Cover and bake in a slow oven of 300º until tender—about 3½ hours—adding more bean liquid if necessary, to keep beans from drying out.  Remove cover, then bake ½ hour longer.

recipes.Author: Epicurious
recipes.Ingredients:
1  Cod Filet Cut In Half
½  Cup Flour
1  Egg
½  Cup Milk
1  Cup Crushed Corn Tortilla Chips
1 tsp. granulated garlic
1 tsp. onion powder
1 tsp. paprika
¼ tsp. cayenne powder
½  cumin
recipes.Procedure:
1. Whisk together egg and milk.
2. Process tortilla chips and seasonings in food processor.
3. Coat fish in flour; shake off excess. Dip in egg mixture; let excess run off. Dip in tortilla chip mixture, pressing firmly into mixture.
4. Coat bottom of sauté pan with oil. Fry fish until edges looked cooked; flip and fry other side.
5. Place fish in baking pan. Bake in preheated 400º oven for 6 minutes or until flakey.
6. Serve with lemon wedge and sprig of cilantro.

recipes.RecipeName: McCormick Gourmet Collection Chocolate Crackle Coo
recipes.Ingredients:
12 oz. semisweet baking chocolate divided
¾ cup all-purpose flour
2 tsp. roasted cinnamon
1 tsp. ancho chili pepper
½ tsp. baking powder
¼ tsp. salt
¼ cup butter, softened
½ cup granulated sugar
¼ cup packed brown sugar
2  eggs, slightly beaten
2 tsp. vanilla extract
recipes.Procedure:
Melt 8 oz chocolate as directed on package.
Set aside. Coarsely chop remaining 4 oz. chocolate. Mix flour, roasted cinnamom, chili peppers, baking powder and salt in a small bowl.  Beat butter and sugar in a large bowl with electric mixer on medium speed until light and fluffy. Add eggs and vanilla, and mix well.  Add melted chocolate; beat  until well blended.  Gradually beat in flour mixture on low speed until well mixed.  Stir in chopped chocolate.  Drop dough by rounded tablespoons 1½ in apart on parchment paper lined baking sheet. Bake in 375º oven about 10 min. or just until cookies are set and slightly cracked on top.  Transfer on parchment to wire rack; cool.

recipes.Ingredients:
2½ cups milk
5  egg yolks
¾ cup sugar
½ cup cornstarch
1 tbsp. unsalted butter
1 tbsp. vanilla
(3 squares unsweetened chocolate if making chocolate custard)
recipes.Procedure: Mix ingredients in saucepan over medium heat, stirring constantly.  Watch spoon for coating, indicating the custard  is thickening and nearly cooked, then cook about 10 sec longer.  Remove from heat; cover with plastic wrap on the surface of the custard and chill.

recipes.Author: Cooks.Com
recipes.Ingredients:
1⅔ cup powdered sugar
6 tbsp. lemon juice
¼ tsp. lemon extract
2 tbsp. Rum
2 tsp. grated lemon rind
recipes.Procedure: Whisk ingredients together in a small bowl until well-blended; drizzle over cake or cupcakes

recipes.Author: Emeril Lagresse
recipes.Ingredients:
¼ cup mustard seeds
3 tbsp. coriander seeds
2 tbsp. whole allspice
2 tbsp. dill seeds
1 tsp. whole cloves
6  small dried red chilis, crumbled
8  bay leaves
recipes.Procedure: Mix ingredients together (I crumble the bay leaves).  Store in an airtight jar.  When ready to use, tie ingredients in a bag of cheesecloth and add to water ahead of boiling vegetables.

recipes.Author: Rhonda Parkinson
recipes.Ingredients:
½  lb. ground pork (1 cup)
¾ cup shredded Napa cabbage
1  green onion, diced
2 tsp. minced ginger
1  egg, lightly beaten
1 tbsp. soy sauce
¼ tsp. hot chili oil or to taste
¼ tsp. sesame oil
2 tbsp. vegetable oil for frying
30  gyoza wrappers or as needed
soy sauce
red wine vinegar
recipes.Procedure:
Bring a pot of salted water to a boil.  Blanch the shredded cabbage until it is tender but still crisp.  Plunge into ice cold water; remove and drain.
In a medium bowl combine the pork, cabbage, onion, ginger, egg, soy sauce, chili- and sesame oils.  Lay a gyoza wrapper in front of you.  Wet the edges with water.  Place a teaspoon of filling in middle of wrapper; fold sides to form a semicircle then pinch edges to seal.  Continue until all filling is used up.
To cook, heat 1 tbsp vegetable oil in a heavy frying pan over medium-high heat.  Add 12-15 potstickers and cook for 2 min. or until golden brown on bottom.  Add ½ cup water to the pan.  Cover the potstickers and cook until water is absorbed, about 5-7 min.  Repeat with remainder of potstickers.  Serve with a sauce of soy sauce mixed with red wine vinegar to taste.

recipes.Author: Cooksrecipes.Com
recipes.Ingredients:
2  large cloves garlic, halved and lightly crushed
4  dried hot chilis, slightly crumbled
2  serrano peppers, sliced
1 tbsp. pickling spice
sliced carrots, to taste
sliced celery, to taste
1  medium onion, cut into bite-sized pieces
1  large head cauliflower. broken into flowerets
4 cups white vinegar
recipes.Procedure: Fill each of two sterilzed quart canning jars with a mixture of celery, onion, carrot, serrano pepper, hot pepper and cauliflower.  Pour boiling vinegar into each bottle until filled.  Seal lids; let cool until lids lock.  Refrigerate 2 weeks or longer as desired before eating.

recipes.Author: Lucinda Scala Quinn
recipes.Ingredients:
½ cup white vinegar
⅓ cup sugar
2 cups water
1 tbsp. salt
1½ tsp. pickling spice
recipes.Procedure: Sterilize 3 quart canning jars by placing in boiling water for 30 min.  Meanwhile, simmer 3 canning lids in boiling water.  Remove jars nd drain.  Put ½ tsp pickling spice in each jar.  Pack jars with cucumber spears. Mix white vinegar and sugar in a pan; add 2 cups water, heat to boiling.  Add 1 tbsp salt, remove from heat; pour vinegar mixture over cucumbers, filling jar nearly full.  Place a canning lid on each jar, seal with ring.  Let jars cool and check for sealing.  When cooled and sealed, refrigerate for 2 weeks before eating.

recipes.Ingredients:
½ cup unsalted butter, softened
1½ cup sugar
1 cup pumpkin
1  egg
1 tsp. vanilla
2½ cup flour
1 tsp. baking powder
1 tsp. baking soda
2 tsp. ground cinnamnon
½ tsp. nutmeg
½ tsp. cloves
½ tsp. salt
For the frosting:
¼ cup unsalted butter
4 oz. cream cheese
1 tsp. vanilla
1 tsp. ground cinnamon
recipes.Procedure:
1. Cream together the ½ cup butter and sugar, then add pumpkin, egg and vanilla. Mix well.
2. In a small bowl, combine the flour, baking powder, baking soda, 2 tsp. cinammon, nutmeg, cloves and salt. Add to pumpkin mixture and mix well.
3. Drop by tbsp. onto a baking sheet lined with parchment (or ungreased). Bake at 350º for 15-20 min.
 4. Cream together the ¼ cup butter, cream cheese, 1 tsp. vanilla and 1 tsp. cinammon. Frost cookies.

recipes.Author: Allrecipes.Com
recipes.Ingredients:
½ cup butter
2 tbsp. lemon juice
½ tsp. lemon extract
3 cups confectioners sugar
recipes.Procedure: 1.Combine the butter, lemon juice, vanilla, and confectioner's sugar and beat until light and fluffy. Add more confectioner's sugar, or lemon juice to adjust the consistency as needed.

recipes.Author: Allrecipes.Com
recipes.Ingredients:
½ cup butter
1 cup sugar
2  eggs
1 tsp. vanilla extract
⅓ cup unsweetened cocoa powder
1 cup flour
¼ tsp. salt
½ tsp. baking powder
recipes.Procedure:
1. Preheat oven to 350º.  Grease and flour an 8" square baking pan.
2. Melt butter in pan; stir in sugar, eggs and vanilla.  Beat in cocoa, flour, salt and baking powder.  Spread into baking pan.
3. Bake 25-30 min.  Do not overbake.

recipes.Author: Taste Of Home
recipes.Ingredients:
1  prepared pie crust
2 cups fresh sliced fresh plums (about 3 large)
3 tbsp. plus 1/4 tsp. brown sugar, divided
1 tbsp. all-purpose flour
1  egg, slightly beaten
recipes.Procedure:
1. Place pie crust into a deep-dish 10" pie pan lined with parchment.
2.  In a bowl, combine plums and 3 tbsp of the brown sugar.    Place in center of crust.  Bring edges of crust together toward center, leaving 3½ in. of the filling uncovered.  Brush with egg, then sprinkle with remaining brown sugar.
3. Bake at 375º for 40-45 min. or until filling is bubbling and crust is a golden brown.

recipes.Ingredients:
1¼ cups all purpose flour
¾ cup sugar
½ cup unsalted butter, softened
1  egg
½ tbsp. grated lemon peel
½ tbsp. lemon juice
¼ tsp. lemon extract
¾ tsp. cream of tartar
½ tsp. baking soda
⅛ tsp. salt

For the glaze:
1¼ cup confectioner's sugar
2 tbsp. lemon juice
recipes.Procedure:
1. Heat oven to 400º.  Combine all ingredients in a mixing bowl and beat at low speed until well mixed.
2. Drop by rounded teaspoons on an ungreased baking sheet (or one lined with parchment) 2 in. apart.  Bake 6-8 min. or until edges are lightly browned.
3. Meanwhile, combine confectioner's sugar and lemon juice in a small bowl and stir until smooth.  Frost warm cookies with glaze.

Makes about 4 dozen cookies.

recipes.Ingredients:
1 cup butter
½ tsp. salt
½ cup cold water
1  package cranberries
½ cup sugar
2  green apples
2 tsp. orange peel
1  egg
1 tbsp. water
sugar
2½ cups flour
2 tsp. sugar
recipes.Procedure: Prepare the crust (or use about 4 premade crusts).  In food processor, mix flour, 2 tsp sugar, 1 cup butter, cubed and ½ tsp salt until well blended.  Texture will be like cornmeal.  Add COLD water until dough just forms a ball: dough should be somewhat dry.  Refrigerate 30 min. while preparing the filling.  In large saucepan, heat cranberries over medium heat stirring occasionally.  When berries pop, stir in ½ cup sugar and orange peel.  Simmer on med-low heat for 15 min., until texture is jam-like.  Meanwhile peel and core apples, dicing into ¼" dice.  Remove cranberries from heat and stir in apples.  Preheat oven to 425º.  On a floured surface, roll dough out to 1/16" thick.  With a cookie cutter, cut out 3" circles.  In half of the circles, slice an "X"—these are the tops to the pies.  Lay out bottom circles on a baking pan covered with parchment and fill each with 1 tbsp of the filling.  Beat the egg with 1 tbsp water.  Brush the outer edge of each pie with the egg solution, then place top crust over, sealing the edges with a fork.  When all pies are assembled, brush all pies with the remaining egg and sprinkle with sugar.  Bake for 15-18 min. or until tops are golden.

recipes.Author: Daniel Humm And Jame
recipes.Ingredients:
Marinade:
3½ cups buttermilk
3½ cups milk
1  small onion, cut into  1/2 inch slices
2  medium jalapeno peppers, sliced
1 tbsp. kosher salt
1 tbsp. Tabasco
2  lbs.boned and skinned chicken thighs, cut into 2x4 in. strips

Seasoned Flour:
3½ cups all-purpose flour
2 tbsp. granulated garlic
2 tbsp. onion powder
4 tsp. dried thyme
2 tsp. ground sage
½ tsp. cayenne pepper
4 tsp. kosher salt
4 tsp. ground black pepper
canola oil for frying
recipes.Procedure:
1. In a wide, shallow bowl combine marinade ingredients.  Add chicken and refrigerate 24 hours.
2. Preheat oven to 250º.  Set cooling racks over rimmed baking sheets.  In a large bowl, combine seasoned flour ingredients.
3. In a large pot, pour in enough oil to fill to 2".  Set over medium high heat and heat to 350º.  Working in batches of 4-5 pieces, remove chicken from marinade, shaking to remove any vegetables and excess liquid.  Dredge pieces in seasoned flour.  Fry pieces, turning once, until golden and cooked through, about 6-7 min. per batch.  Transfer to wire racks and warm in oven while frying remaining batches.

Serve with ranch dressing, if desired.

recipes.Ingredients:
1  shallot
3  strips bacon
3  mushrooms
1 tsp. dried thyme leaves
1  clove garlic
1 tbsp. olive oil
2  boneless steaks, sirloin or top round
mustard
½  onion
1  stick celery
1  carrot, peeled
¼ cup red wine
1 can (14 oz) beef bouillon
2 tsp. tomato sauce or paste
recipes.Procedure:
1. Preheat oven to 225º
2. Chop shallot, garlic, bacon and mushrooms.
3. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in frying pan and fry shallot until translucent and beginning to brown.  Remove and set aside.
4. In same pan, cook mushroom until starting to brown; add garlic, cook another minute.  Remove and set aside.
5.  In a small bowl, mix mushroom, garlic, shallot, thyme leaves and bacon.
6. Pound each of the steaks with a meat hammer until ½ - 1 cm. thick.  
7. Spread each steak with mustard, and place ½ the stuffing in the middle of each steak.
8. Roll up each steak starting at smaller end to form a tube, and tie with string at each end and in the middle.
9.  In the same frying pan used to cook the shallot and mushrooms, fry the steaks on all sides until browned.  Place in an oven proof dish with lid.
10.  Coarsely chop onion, celery and carrolt and fry until browned. Transfer to dish with beef.
11.  Add red wine, beef stock and tomato paste into the frying pan; mix well and deglaze pan. Pour over beef.  Place beef into oven and cook for 3 hours.
12.  When beef is ready, remove from dish and strain juices to remove onion, carrot and celery; discard.
13.  Boil sauce until it has reached desired consistency (may be thickened with cornstarch or flour, if desired).  
14.  Place been into sauce and reheat for 5 min.  Serve with vegetables or potatoes.

recipes.Blurb: Choose your own favorite vegetable mixture.  Applebee's uses butter instead of olive oil.
recipes.Author: Applebee's Restauran
recipes.Ingredients:
1  zuchinni
1 yellow crookneck squash
1 medium head of brocolli
12 baby carrots or 1 large regular carrot
½ tsp. sea salt
½ tsp. granulated garlic
1 tbsp. Worchestershire sauce
1 tbsp. soy sauce
2 tsp. fresh parsely or 1 tsp. dried parsley
½ tsp. sugar
3 tbsp. extra virgin olive oil or clarified butter
recipes.Procedure:
Rinse and wash vegetables. Cut ends off zuchinni and squash, slice down center lengthwise. Cut halfs into ¼" in. half moons.
Slice ends off brocolli florets, leaving just enough stem to hold florets together.
Slice baby carrots lengthwise. (If using regular carrots, peel and cut into 2 in. lengths, then cut each section into fourths lengthwise.)
Heat 3 Tbsp olive oil, salt, garlic and sugar in frying pan over medium-high heat. (If using different vegetables than those specified, add denser vegetables, which take longer to cook, before the less dense vegetables.) Add brocolli and cook rapidly, about 1 min., stirring frequently. Add carrots and cook 1-2 min., continuing to stir frequently. Finally, add zuchinni and yellow squash and cook about 1 min. Add soy sauce, parsley and Worchestershire sauce. Continue cooking until all vegetables are hot and al dente. Mix thoroughly and serve.

recipes.Blurb: Substitue chopped sweet pepper for hot peppers if less heat is desired.
recipes.Author: Taste Of Home
recipes.Ingredients:
1 lb. ground beef
1  medium onion, chopped
1  hot pepper (jalapeño or other), chopped
1 cup fresh bread crumbs
1  egg, beaten
1 tbsp. dried parsley
1 tsp. dried basil
1 tsp. Italian seasoning
1 tsp. salt
⅛ tsp. pepper
2  8 oz. cans tomato sauce
1  medium tomato, coarsely chopped
1  large zucchini
shredded mozzarella cheese
recipes.Procedure:
1. Preheat oven to 375°. Cut the ends from the zucchini, split lengthwise.  Scoop out  seeds.
2. Mix beef, onion, pepper, bread crumbs, egg, seasonings and 1 can of the tomato sauce in a large bowl.  Fill each zucchini half with half of the meat mixture; place in a 13 in. x 9 in. baking dish.  Cover with remaining can of tomato sauce.
3. Bake uncovered for 35 min.  Top with shredded mozarella cheese and bake for additional 10 min.

recipes.Ingredients:
1 cup chopped onions
½ cup sliced carrots
½ cup chopped celery
1 tbsp. minced ginger
2  cloves minced garlic
½ tsp. turmeric
4 cups chicken stock
8 oz. cooked chicken, chopped
1 cup pearl couscous
½  lemon
salt
pepper
fresh parsley
recipes.Procedure:
1. Heat one tbsp of the stock in a dutch oven over medium heat.  When it begins to sizzle, add onions, carrots and celery.  Sauté until tender.  Stir in ginger and garlic and heat until aromatic.  Sprinkle the turmeric over the vegetables and stir.

2. Add the stock, chicken and couscous and bring to a light boil.  Reduce hat to a gentle simmer, cook for 15 min.  Squeeze the lemon into the soup.  Season to taste with salt and pepper.  Top with parsley before serving.

recipes.Blurb: This recipe is reduced from the full-sized recipe whick serves 3 times as many.
recipes.Ingredients:
⅔ cup olive oil
3 tbsp. red wine vinegar
3 tsp. dried basil
2 tbsp. chopped green onion
2 tbsp. grated Parmesan cheese
1¼ tsp. salt
¼ tsp. ground black pepper
¼ tsp. mustard powder
3 oz. rotelle pasta, freshly cooked and drained
3  small sweet peppers: red, yellow and orange, halved lengthwise and cut into thin strips
½  medium-sized tomato, cut in thin wedges
2 tbsp. toasted pignoli (pine nuts)
¼ cup Greek-style or pitted ripe black olives
2 oz. feta or mozarella cheese, cubed
¼ tsp. crumbled dried oregano
recipes.Procedure: Process oil, vinegar, 2 tsp basil, the green onion, Parmesan cheese, salt and pepper in blender or food processor until smooth.  Put pasta, pepper strips, tomato wedges, nuts and olives in a large bowl.  Pour in dressing; toss to mix.  Roll cheese cubes in remaining 1 tsp basil to coat.  Add to salad; sprinkel with oregano, toss lightly.  Serve at room temperature.

recipes.Ingredients:
2 lb. flank steak
4 tsp. vegetable oil
2 tsp. minced ginger
2 tbsp. minced garlic
1 cup soy sauce
1 cup water
1 cup brown sugar
2 cups vegetable oil
½ cup cornstarch
3  large green onions
recipes.Procedure:
1) Make the sauce by heating 4 tsp. vegetable oil in a medium saucepan over medium/low heat. Add ginger and garlic to the pan and quickly add the soy sauce an water before the garlic scorches. Dissolve the brown sugar in the sauce, then raise the heat to medium and boil the sauce for 2-3 min. or until the sauce thickens a bit. Remove from heat.
2) Slick the flank steak against the grain into ¼" clices. Tile the knife blade at a 45° angle to the top of the steak to get wider cuts. Dip the steak pieces into cornstarch to apply a very thin dusting to both sides of each piece of beef. Let the beef sit about 10 min so the cornstarch sticks. As the beef sits, heat up 1 cup oil in a wok or skillet. Heat the oil over medium heat until it is hot but not smoking. Add the beef to the oil and sauté for just 2 min. or until beef just begins to darken on the edges. Stir meat to ensure that it cooks evenly.
3) After a few minutes remove the meat with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels. Pour most of the oil out of the skillet. Put the pan back on the heat, dump the meat back into it and stir fry for 1 min. Add the sauce, cook for 1 min. and add the green onions. Cook for 1 min. You may now remove the beef with a slotted spoon and discard the sauce, or thicken the sauce with cornstarch and serve over rice with the beef.

recipes.Author: Pgraymendoza
recipes.Ingredients:
2  lamb chops  3/4" thick
¾ tsp. dried rosemary
¼ tsp. dried basil
½ tsp. dried thyme
salt and pepper to taste
1 tbsp. olive oil
¼ cup minced shallots
⅓ cup balsamic vinegar
¾ cup chicken broth
1 tbsp. butter
recipes.Procedure:
1. In a small bowl, mix together rosemary, basil, thyme, salt and pepper.  Rub mixture onto lamb chops on both sides.  Place on a plate in the refrigerator for several hours to absorb flavors.
