2.  Heat olive oil in skillet over med-high meat.  Add lamb chops, cook for about 3½ min. per side for medium rare.  Remove from skillet and keep warm on a platter.
3. Add shallots to the skillet and cook for a few minutes, just until browned.  Stir in vinegar and deglaze the pan, then stir in the chicken broth.  Continue to cook and stir over med-high heat for about 5 min, until sauce has reduced by half (important).  Remove from heat and stir in the butter.  Pour over lamb chops and serve.

recipes.Author: Foodnetwork.Com
recipes.Ingredients:
For the chips:
12  large russet potatoes
canola oil for frying

Seasoned flour:
2 cups all purpose flour
3 tsp. kosher salt
1 tbsp. freshly ground black pepper

Beer Batter:
3 cups all purpose flour
3 tbsp. paprika
3 tbsp. kosher salt
1  12-oz bottle of lager

Fish:
3  lbs.skinless boneless fish (cod is best)
Canola oil for frying
kosher salt
malt vinegar
recipes.Procedure:
1) Slice potatoes into 5/8" long chips (french fries). Store in water.
2) Heat oil to 275º.  Thoroughly drain the potatoes and add them to the oil, working in batches to avoid overcrowding.  Fry until soft, but not yet browned, about 10 min.  Spread on a sheet tray and store in refrigerator for several hours or overnight.
3) When ready to serve, heat oil to 375º and fry, in batches, until golden brown and crispy on the outside and still fluffy on the inside.
4) Make seasoned flour by mising 2 cups flour, 3 tsp kosher salt and pepper in a large bowl.
5) Make batter by by mixing 3 c. flour, paprika and salt in a large bowl.  While whisking constantly, add enough beer to stiffen the mix.  While still continuing to whisk, add cold water until the consistency of the batter resembles heavy cream and contains no lumps.
6) Dip fish into seasoned flour and shake off any excess..  Dip the fish into the batter, briefly allow to drain off and gently place into oil, allowing fish to float away from you.  Cook, in batches as necessary, until golden brown and trying to float, 5-7 min.  Remove with a spatula and drain.  Serve on a bed of chips with kosher salt and malt vinegar.

recipes.Author: About.Com
recipes.Ingredients:
¼ cup kosher salt
2  bay leaves
2  mashed garlic cloves
1  hot chile, cut in half
¼ cup olive oil
1  large onion, sliced into half-moons
1 tsp. black peppercorns
½ tsp. cumin seeds
1 tsp. dried thyme leaves
1 tsp. coriander seed
1 tsp. dried oregano leaves
1 cup fish or chicken broth
1 cup white wine
1 cup white wine vinegar
2  more bay leaves
1 lb. fish fillets, cut into 2-3 inch pieces
recipes.Procedure:
Combine the ¼ cup salt with 4 cups of water, stir to combine and brine the fish in this mixture for 30-45 minutes.
Meanwhile, heat the olive oil in a large pan and add the mashed garlic cloves, chile and 2 bay leaves. Cook these aromatics in the oil over medium heat until the garlic browns, about 4-6 minutes. Do not let the garlic burn. Remove the aromatics and discard.
Turn the heat up to medium-high and cook the fish.
You want a good sear, so if the fish are not cooking hot enough, turn the heat all the way up to high. Sear each side of the fish for 1-3 minutes, depending on the thickness. You don't need to cook the fish all the way through.
Remove the fish to cool, then add the slivered onion, lower the heat to medium and cook until translucent. Remove to cool.
Now add all the remaining ingredients, turn the heat up to high and bring to a rolling boil. Reduce by half, turn off the heat and let cool.
When everything is at room temperature, pour the sauce into a container and add the fish and onions. Store in the refigerator overnight to let the flavors marry.
This fish will stay in good shape for a week or more, so long as it is covered by the vinegar sauce. Serve cool or at room temperature.

recipes.Author: Taste Of Home
recipes.Ingredients:
2 tbsp. butter
3 tbsp. all-purpose flour
1½ tsp. minced garlic
1¼ cups water
2 tsp. chicken bouillon granules
4  ounces cream cheese, cubed
recipes.Procedure: In a large saucepan, melt butter. Stir in flour and garlic until blended. Gradually add water and bouillon. Bring to a boil; cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened. Reduce heat; add cream cheese. Stir until blended and heated through. Serve with chicken, vegetables and pasta

recipes.Author: Food.Com
recipes.Ingredients:
8  (8 ounce) pieces boneless skinless chicken breasts
1 cup flour
1 tsp. salt
1 tsp. white pepper
1 cup butter
2 tsp. olive oil
1  1/2 cups champagne
1 cup whipping cream
1 tsp. ground rosemary
1 tsp. chopped parsley
recipes.Procedure:
Flatten chicken and dust with the flour, salt and pepper.
In a very large skillet Melt butter and olive oil together over medium heat.
Add chicken and saute 5 minutes, turn and add the champagne, continue to cook for 12-15 minutes.
Add the cream and rosemary and cook until thickened.
Remove to a serving plate, pour sauce over chicken and garnish with parsley.
Serve with rice.

recipes.Blurb: This can be made hot or spicy by adding red pepper flakes, or using hot chili powder
recipes.Author: Allrecipes.Com
recipes.Procedure: Mix ingredients in small bowl; store in air tight container.

recipes.Author: Allrecipes.Com
recipes.Ingredients:
4 cups distilled white vinegar
4 cups water
2  heads cauliflower, broken into florets
Baby carrots, halved
Sweet peppers, sliced into strips
1  small onion, cut into bite-sized pieces
Celery, sliced
Jalapeño peppers, sliced
3  cloves garlic, sliced
4 tsp. mustard seed
4 tsp. peppercorns
4 tsp. coriander seeds
4 tsp. dill seeds
4 tsp. whole allspice
8  hot peppers
4  bay leaves
recipes.Procedure: Wash vegetables.  Place in large pan and cover with canning salt; let sit overnight.  Wash vegetables.  Sterilize 4 qt, bottles and lids.  Mix salt with vinegar and water and bring to a boil.  Fill 4 canning jars with vegetables and ¼ each of the spices; fill with boiling vinegar mixture, seal.  Process bottles, completely covered with boiling water, for 25 min. (over 6000 ft.).  Let cool and check seals.  Store in a cool, dark place for 2 weeks minimum before eating.  For crisper vegetables, refrigerate after sealing and do not process in boiling water.  Keep refrigerated.

recipes.Author: Aaron Scott
recipes.Ingredients:
About 7 pickling cucumbers
2 cups distilled white vinegar
2  cloves garlic, sliced
½ tsp. mustard seed
½ tsp. peppercorns
½ tsp. coriander seeds
1 tsp. dill weed
½ tsp. whole allspice
½ tsp. whole cloves
1  bay leaf, crumbled
½ tsp. turmeric
1 tsp. canning salt
recipes.Procedure: Sterilize 1 quart bottle and lid in boiling water for 10 min.  Meanwhile, bring white vinegar to a boil.  Slice cucumbers into quarters lengthwise.  Place spices in bottom of bottle, fill with cucumbers.  Fill bottle with boiling vinegar, leaving a ½" space at the top. Place lid on top and screw ring down tightly.  Allow to cool; check for proper seal.  Refrigerate for at least 2 weeks.

recipes.RecipeName: Tony Roma's Red Hot Bbq Sauce
recipes.Author: Adapted from Top Secret Recipes
recipes.Ingredients:
1 cup passata
1 cup apple cider vinegar
2 tbsp. brown sugar
2 tbsp. molasses
2 tsp. sugar
1 tsp. liquid smoke
½ tsp. salt (smoked salt is ideal)
1 tsp. crushed dried habanero/Caribbean Red Hot peppers
1 tsp. Tabasco pepper sauce
1 tsp. cayenne pepper
¼ tsp. ground black pepper
¼ tsp. garlic powder
¼ tsp. onion powder
recipes.Procedure:
1. Combine all of the ingredients for the barbecue sauce in a saucepan over high heat. Use a whisk to blend the ingredients until smooth.
2. When the mixture comes to a boil, reduce the heat and simmer uncovered.
3. In 30 to 45 minutes, when the mixture thickens, remove it from the heat. If you want a thicker sauce, cook it longer. If you make the sauce too thick, thin it with more vinegar.
recipes.Notes: The original recipe calls for ketchup instead of passata, and ¼ tsp each of cayenne, Tabasco and red pepper flakes.

recipes.Author: Food.Com
recipes.Ingredients:
Marinade:
5½ oz. tomato juice
2 tsp. brown sugar
½ tsp. celery seed
½ tsp. garlic powder
½ tsp. black pepper
⅛ tsp. salt
Meat:
3  lbs.beef chuck roast.
2  medium potatoes, cut into eighths
1  onion, sliced
2  stalks celery, cut into 1 in. pieces
3  medium carrots, cut into 1 in. pieces
4  or more garlic cloves
3 cup beef broth
¼ tsp. thyme
¼ tsp. salt
recipes.Procedure:
1. Mix tomato juice, brown sugar, celery seed, garlic powder, pepper and salt.  Pierce roast several times and place in ziplock bag with marinade.  Refrigerate at least 5 hours.
2. Preheat grill.  Remove roast from marinade; discard marinade.  Grill roast at med-high with hood down until well seared; about 20 min.
3. Line baking pan with enough foil to enable foil to seal.
4. Mix beef broth, thyme and salt in a small bowl.  Place seared roast, veggies and garlic in pan; pour broth mixture over all.
5. Seal foil; grill for about 75 min. with the hood down.  Remove roast, let sit for 10 min. and serve with veggies.

recipes.Author: Food.Com
recipes.Ingredients:
3½  lb. chuck roast
½ cup chopped onion
⅓ cup chopped bell pepper
2  garlic cloves, minced
¼ cup Worcestershire sauce
¼ cup sherry
2 tbsp. white wine vinegar
1 can tomato paste
1 cup water
¼  brown sugar
1 tbsp. grape jam
¾ tsp. thyme
½ tsp. pepper
½ tsp. parsley
¼ tsp. marjoram
¼ tsp. salt
recipes.Procedure:
1. Place roast in crockpot with onion, bell pepper and garlic.
2. In bowl, mix remaining ingredients. Pour over meat.
3. Cook on low for 6-8 hours until done.

recipes.Author: Food.Com
recipes.Ingredients:
½ cup red wine
⅓ cup soy sauce
3  lbs.chuck roast
½ tsp. meat tenderizer
oregano
garlic powder
recipes.Procedure:
1. Combine red wine and soy sauce in a dish big enough to hold roast.
2. Put roast in dish; turn over.  Sprinkle with half the meat tenderizer; prick surface with fork all over.  Sprinkle with oregano and garlic powder.
3. Turn roast over.  Repeat step 2 with other half of tenderizer and more oregano and garlic powder.
4. Flip over gain and let rest in marinade.  Marinade at least overnight, turning at least once.
5. Grill to desired doneness.

recipes.Author: Madame Wong
recipes.Ingredients:
Preparation:
1 lb. shrimp, shelled and deveined or 1 lb. boneless skinless chicken breast, cubed
1 tbsp. cornstarch
2 tbsp. oil
½ cup cashews
10  whole dried red chilies
1  green onion, cut into 1 inch pieces
1  clove garlic, minced
½  onion, in large dice
1  green pepper, in large dice
Sauce:
¼ cup chicken stock
2 tbsp. light soy sauce
1 tsp. red wine vinegar
1 tsp. cornstarch, dissolved in
2 tsp. water
recipes.Procedure:
1. Combine sauce ingredients and set aside.
2. Mix shrimp with cornstarch.
3. Stir-fry shrimp until color changes.
4 . Add 2 tbsp to wok.  Stir-fry cashews in wok until light brown (about 30 seconds). Remove and drain.
5. Reheat 2 tbsp oil in wok. Fry chilies until dark brown. Add scallion and garlic. Stir-fry 30 seconds. Add onion, stir-fry 1 minute. Add green pepper, stir-fry 30 seconds more.  Remove chilies.
6.  Pour in sauce, bring to a boil. Add shrimp and nuts. Mix until shrimp (or chicken) and nuts are glazed. Remove to serving platter. Serve over rice.

recipes.Author: Aaron Scott
recipes.Ingredients:
2  pie crusts, 9"
1 can chicken broth
¼ cup sherry
2 tbsp. boiled cider
2 tbsp. red wine vinegar
chopped, cooked chicken.
recipes.Procedure:
Line round baking dish with one of the crusts.  In a bowl, mix peas, corn, potato, pecans and chicken with sauce; fill lined pan.
Place second crust on top of pan and seal edges with the prongs of a fork; trim around pan edge with sharp knife.  Make 4 cuts in top crust.  Bake at 350º for 1 hour or until the sauce bubbles through slits in the crust.  Serve immediately.

recipes.Ingredients:
½ tsp. nutmeg
¼ tsp. cardamom
¼ tsp. kosher salt
8 tbsp. Unsalted butter
2 cups dark brown sugar
3  ounces rum
recipes.Procedure:
Cream together the butter, spices and sugar. At this point you can roll up the mixture with parchment into a log. Cover well and refrigerate or freeze for later use. In the fridge the mixture will keep for two weeks, in the freezer a couple of months. 

In a mug add a tablespoon of the butter and sugar mixture Top with a couple ounces of rum and roughly 1/2 cup of hot water. The ratio of the ingredients is really preference.

recipes.Author: Simplyrecipes.Com
recipes.Ingredients:
1 cup sugar
6 tbsp. butter
1 tsp. vanilla
½ cup heavy whipping cream
recipes.Procedure:
1. Heat sugar on moderately high heat in a heavy-bottomed 2-quart or 3-quart saucepan. As the sugar begins to melt, stir vigorously with a whisk or wooden spoon. As soon as the sugar comes to a boil, stop stirring. You can swirl the pan a bit if you want, from this point on.If you find that you end up burning some of the sugar before the rest of it is melted, the next time you attempt it, add a half cup of water to the sugar at the beginning of the process, this will help the sugar to cook more evenly, though it will take longer as the water will need to evaporate before the sugar will caramelize.
2.As soon as all of the sugar crystals have melted (the liquid sugar should be dark amber in color), immediately add the butter to the pan. Whisk until the butter has melted.
3. Once the butter has melted, take the pan off the heat. Count to three, then slowly add the cream to the pan and continue to whisk to incorporate. Note than when you add the butter and the cream, the mixture will foam up considerably. This is why you must use a pan that is at least 2-quarts (preferably 3-quarts) big.
4. Whisk until caramel sauce is smooth. Let cool in the pan for a couple minutes, then pour into a glass mason jar and let sit to cool to room temperature. (Remember to use pot holders when handling the jar filled with hot caramel sauce.) Store in the refrigerator for up to 2 weeks. Warm before serving.

recipes.Author: Food.Com
recipes.Ingredients:
8  baking potatoes
⅓ cup dried onion
8 oz. cream cheese
8 oz. sour cream
2 tbsp. unsalted butter
salt to taste
pepper to taste
Parmesan cheese
recipes.Procedure:
1. Bake potatoes (not until soft), cool, peel and shred.
2. In a large bowl combine onion, cream cheese, sour cream, butter, salt and pepper
3. Mix in shredded potatoes until well combined.
4. Scoop out potato mixture and shape into balls; roll each ball in Parmesan cheese to coat.
5. Freeze balls.  When ready to cook, bake at 350º for 10-12 min. or until lightly browned.

recipes.Ingredients:
2 cups heavy whipping cream
4 tbsp. cultured buttermilk
recipes.Procedure:
Mix cream and buttermilk in a bowl. Cover the bowl with cheesecloth or a thin kitchen towel and let sit at room temperature (68°) until it thickens (12-24 hours). 
Stir until smooth and refrigerate. Will stay fresh for several weeks.  As it ages, it will give off some liquid.
Either stir it back in, or spoon it off and discard it.

recipes.Author: Chiara
recipes.Ingredients:
5  egg yolks
½ cup white sugar
6 tbsp. Marsala wine
2  pints fresh raspberries
recipes.Procedure:
1. In top of a double boiler over simmering water, mix together egg yolks and sugar until sugar has dissolved. Stir in Marsala.
2. Whisk mixture until it is thick and foamy; continue cooking, whisking constantly, until mixture is thick and very hot to the touch. Remove from heat and serve immediately over fresh berries in dessert bowls or wine glasses.

recipes.Blurb: If replacing cream with olive oil, use MUCH less: I used 2 oz. only, and it was plenty.
recipes.Author: Williams-Sonoma
recipes.Ingredients:
6 oz. heavy cream, or substitute extra-virgin olive oil
12  green olives, pitted and finely chopped
4 oz. sun-dried tomatoes in olive oil, drained and finely chopped
1 tsp. capers (optional)
freshly ground pepper
freshly grated Parmesan cheese
recipes.Procedure: Combine cream, olives sun-dried tomatoes and capers, if used, in frying pan over very low heat.  Add pepper to taste.  Heat just until the cream is lukewarm and slightly pink.  Drain pasta, reserving 2 oz. cooking water. Stir reserved water into the cream sauce.  (If using olive oil instead of cream, omit water.)  Immediately pour sauce over cooked pasta.  Add the Parmesan cheese.  Toss well.  Serve at once.

recipes.Ingredients:
1 cup flour
2 tsp. baking powder
1 tsp. sugar
¼ tsp. salt
7 oz. milk
1  egg
1 tbsp. vegetable oil
recipes.Procedure: Mix dry ingredients together.  In separate bowl, beat egg slightly, add milk and oil, whisk until well mixed.  Add to dry ingredients and whisk until mixed—don't worry about small lumps.  Pour onto hot greased griddle.  When top is well-bubbly, check bottom and flip when done to desired brownness. Cook other side to desired browness, remove with spatula and serve immediately.

recipes.Blurb: This recipe is intended for using a bread machine to mix the dough
recipes.Author: West Bend
recipes.Ingredients:
1 cup water
3 tbsp. butter
½ cup cold butter
3 cups bread flour
2 tbsp. dry milk
3 tbsp. sugar
¾ tsp. salt
3 tsp. dry yeast
recipes.Procedure:
1. Add water and 3 tbsp. butter to pan.
2. Add flour, dry milk, sugar and salt to pan.
3. Make well in center of dry ingredients and add yeast. Lock pan into bread maker. Program for dough; start bread maker.
4. When done, place dough into a greased bowl, cover and refrigerate for 30 min.
5. Place dough on lightly floured surface and roll into 12x15 in. rectangle. Cover 2/3 of the surface with sliced cold butter. Fold unbuttered third over the center buttered third, then fold again, over the remaining buttered third. Seal ends and long side of dough. Place on lightly greased cookie sheet, cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 30 min.
6. Place dough on lightly floured surface and roll into a 15 x 12 in. rectangle. Fold in thirds, as before. Place back onto greased cookie sheet, cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate over night.
7. Place dough on lightly floured surface and roll into a 15 x 12 in. rectangle. Cut rectangle into thirds both lengthwise and widthwise. Cut each piece diagonally to form 18 triangles. Roll each triangle up, starting at the base of the triangle; when rolled up to the point, continue to roll, as rolling into a rope, until the dough is long enough to bend into the crescent shape. Place on greased cookie sheets, curving ends so that they almost touch. Brush or spray lightly with water; cover and let rise until double in size.
8. Brush croissants with slightly beaten egg white. Bake in preheated 375º oven for 15-20 min. until golden brown.

recipes.Blurb: The paprika and ground pepper are the ingredients that give this dish a goulash touch.  I prefer half-sharp paprika and lots of pepper.
recipes.Author: Aaron Scott
recipes.Ingredients:
½ lb. round steak
3  medium tomatoes (frozen work best) cut into eighths
1  small onion, chopped coarsely
1  medium potato, cut into eighths
1 cup beef bouillon
1 tbsp. olive oil
seasoned flour
1 tbsp. paprika
freshly ground pepper to taste
recipes.Procedure:
1. Pound the round steak with a mallet in a bed of seasoned flour, working the flour into the meat, until it can hold no more.
2. In a small pan. boil the tomatoes.  Meanwhile, sear the first side of the steak in a large frying pan over medium-high heat.  When the first side has been seared, turn it over, and add the chopped onions.  Cook until the second side is seared, stirring to onions to prevent browning.
3.  Add the potatoes and boiled tomatoes and mix together.  Add the bouillon, paprika and pepper to taste; stir, reduce heat and cover.  Allow to simmer on low heat for 30 min. or until meat is fork-tender.

recipes.Ingredients:
1  (5-lb.) beef eye of round
2 cups red wine
1  1/2 cups red wine vinegar
3  large onions, thinly sliced
1  large carrot, thinly sliced
1  bouquet garni (1 tbsp. pickling spices, 14 whole cloves, 8 whole black peppercorns, 3 bay leaves, 3 sprigs thyme, 2 sprigs parsley, wrapped in cheesecloth, tied with kitchen twine)
4 tbsp. unsalted butter
4  slices bacon, finely chopped
3 tbsp. flour
2 tbsp. sugar
1 cup golden raisins
6  gingersnaps, crumbled
Juice of 1/2 lemon
2 tbsp. chopped parsley
Kosher salt, to taste
recipes.Procedure:
Season beef liberally with salt in large bowl. Bring wine, vinegar, 1 onion, carrot, bouquet garni, and 4 cups water to a boil in a 4-qt. saucepan; pour over beef. Cover and refrigerate, turning once or twice a day, for 5 days. Remove beef from marinade; pour marinade through a fine strainer into a bowl, and dry beef thoroughly. (Reserve 5 cups of the marinade and the bouquet garni.) Heat 2 tbsp. butter and bacon in an 8-qt. Dutch oven over medium-high heat; cook until bacon renders its fat, about 10 minutes. Transfer bacon to a plate; set aside. Add beef; cook, turning, until browned all over, about 25 minutes. Transfer to a plate; set aside. 
Heat oven to 325°. Add remaining onions to pot; cook, stirring, until caramelized, about 18 minutes. Return beef to pot with reserved marinade and sachet; boil. Cover; bake until beef is very tender, about 2 1/2 hours. Transfer beef to a platter; pour sauce through a fine strainer into a bowl. 
Return pot to medium-high heat; add remaining butter. Add flour and sugar; cook, whisking constantly, until lightly browned, about 5 minutes. Add sauce, raisins, gingersnaps, and juice; return beef to sauce. Bring to a simmer, cover pot, and cook until slightly reduced, about 10 minutes. Thinly slice beef; arrange on a platter. Spoon sauce over top; sprinkle with bacon and parsley.

recipes.Author: Food.Com
recipes.Ingredients:
4  large eggs
2½ tbsp. mayonnaise
1 tsp. Dijon mustard
1 tsp. sweet pickle juice
¼ tsp. Worcestershire sauce
⅛ tsp. salt
⅛ tsp. paprika
pinch cayenne pepper

.
recipes.Procedure:
1. Cook eggs in simmering water for 20 minutes, cool under running water. 
2. Peel and cut eggs in half lenghtwise, remove yolks and set whites aside. 
3. put still warm yolks into a plastic food storage bag with mayonnaise, mustard, pickle juice, worcestershire sauce and seasonings; squeeze bag to mash yolks and mix ingredients. 
4. refrigerate filling and eggs whites seperately. Fill egg whites just before service. 
5. sprinkle eggs with paprika before service.

recipes.Blurb: This is an easier version of the traditional cookie recipe.
recipes.Author: Aaron Scott
recipes.Ingredients:
½ cup butter, softened
½ cup sugar
2 tsp. vanilla
1  egg
1½ cups all purpose flour
⅔ cup chopped nuts (almonds, walnuts, pecans, or other)
Raspberry or other jam
recipes.Procedure:
1. Beat butter, sugar, vanilla and egg in food processor until fluffy.  Add flour, process until dough separates from side of bowl.
2.  Roll dough to about 3/8" thick.  Sprinkle evenly with chopped nuts, and roll nuts into dough until dough is about ¼" thick.  With cookie cutter, cut dough into approximately 24 cookies.  Place on parchment-covered baking sheet; press an indentation in each cookie with finger; fill with ¼ tsp. jam.
3. Bake at 300º for 30 min. or until golden.  Cool on wire racks.

recipes.Ingredients:
1 tbsp. oil
5  garlic cloves, peeled and thinly sliced
1 cup beef broth
⅓ cup dry red wine
1 tbsp. parsley, minced
1 tsp. Worcestershire sauce
½ tsp. dijon-style mustard
¼ tsp. pepper
1 tsp. cornstarch
recipes.Procedure:
1. Heat the oil in a small saucepan. Add garlic and sauté for 3 minutes over medium-low heat, until garlic is almost tender.
2. Stir in broth, wine, parsley, Worcestershire sauce, mustard and pepper.
3. Bring to a boil; reduce heat to low and allow sauce to reduce by a third.  Stir in cornstarch dissolved in 1 tbsp water; allow to thicken.  Serve immediately.

recipes.Ingredients:
1½ tbsp. butter
2 tbsp. prepared mustard
¼ cup boiled cider
4  frankfurters
2  tart apples, peeled, cored and cut into eighths
recipes.Procedure:
1. Broil franks until lightly browned, turning as each side is done.  Score each frank at 1 in. intervals.
2. Melt butter in skillet; blend in mustard and boiled cider.  Add franks and apples. Cover; simmer 15-20 minutes, turning apples and franks halfway through cooking.
3.  Arrange franks on platter; surround with apples; pour sauce over and serve immediately.

recipes.Blurb: Serve with a mint sauce and warmed flatbread
recipes.Author: Allrecipes.Com
recipes.Ingredients:
½ cup olive oil
¼ cup lemon juice
1 tbsp. chopped fresh thyme
12  lamb chops
salt and pepper to taste
recipes.Procedure:
1. Stir together olive oil, lemon juice and thyme in a small bowl.  Season with salt and pepper to taste.  Place lamb chops in a shallow dish and brush with the mixture.  Marinate in the refrigerator 1 hour.
2. Preheat grill for high heat.
3. Lightly oil grill grate.  Place lamb chops on grill and discard marinade.  Cook for 10 min., turning once, or to desired doneness.

recipes.Author: Myrecipes.Com
recipes.Ingredients:
3 tbsp. dried oregano
1 tsp. salt
½ tsp. freshly ground pepper
8  (4-oz.) lamb loin chops, trimmed
4  garlic cloves, thinly sliced
3 tbsp. sherry or dry white wine
lime wedges (optional)
recipes.Procedure:
Combine first 3 ingredients; sprinkle evenly over lamb.  Place lamb in a heavy-duty zip-top plastic bag.  Add garlic and sherry; seal bag, turning to coat.  Marinate in the refrigerator 3 hours.
Prepare grill or broiler.
Place lamb on grill rack or broiler pan coated with cooking spray; cook 5 min. on each side or to desired degree of doneness.  Serve with lime wedges if desired.

recipes.Author: Allrecipes.Com
recipes.Ingredients:
2¼ tsp. active dry yeast
¼ cup warm milk (110° F)
3  eggs, separated
2¾ cup warm milk (110° F)
¾ cup butter, melted and cooled to lukewarm
½ cup sugar
1½ tsp. salt
2 tsp. vanilla extract
4 cups all-purpose flour
recipes.Procedure:
1. In a small bowl, dissolve yeast in ¼ cup warm milk  Let stand until creamy; about 10 min.
2 In a large bowl, whist together the egg yolks, sugar, salt and vanilla.  Stir in the remaining 2½ cups milk alternately with the flour, ending with the flour.  Beat the egg whites until they form soft peaks; fold into the batter.  Cover the bowl with plastic wrap.  Let rise in a warm place until doubled in volume, about 1 hour.
3. Preheat the waffle iron.  Spoon about ½ cup batter onto the center of the iron.  Close the lid and bake until steaming stops and the waffle is golden brown.  Serve immediately.

recipes.Blurb: Personally, I use a hollandaise sauce mix for the sauce: it's far easier.
recipes.Author: Allrecipes.Com
recipes.Ingredients:
4  veal cutlets , flattened or pounded very thin
2 tbsp. fresh lemon juice
pepper
seasoned flour (your choice of seasonings)
16  asparagus spears, cooked
4  crab legs, cooked,shells removed
2  egg yolks
½ cup butter, divided into 3 pieces
1 tbsp. fresh lemon juice
recipes.Procedure:
1 Sprinkle cutlets with lemon juice and pepper on both sides.
2 Dust with seasoned flour.
3 Heat butter in a large skillet.
4 Saute cutlets over moderately high heat for 4 minutes on each side, until lightly browned.
5 Remove to a warm platter.
6 On each cutlet place 4 spears of asparagus and one crab leg.
7 Cover with Hollandaise sauce.
8 For the sauce: Combine egg yolks and lemon juice in the top of a double boiler over hot, not boiling water.
9 Add butter, 1 piece at a time, stirring constantly until melted.
10 Continue stirring until thickened.
11 Serve over veal oscar.
12 The sauce makes about 3/4 cup.

recipes.Blurb: This is as close to the real thing as any recipe I've found.
recipes.Author: Greekfood.Com
recipes.Ingredients:
1  medium onion, finely chopped or shredded
2 lb. ground lamb
1 tbsp. finely minced garlic
1 tsp. dried marjoram
1 tsp. dried ground rosemary
1 tsp. dried oregano
1 tsp. ground cumin
1 tsp. dried ground thyme
2 tsp. kosher salt
½ tsp. freshly ground pepper
For the sauce:
3 cups Greek yogurt
1  cucumber
3 tbsp. lemon juice
1  clove garlic, minced
1 tbsp. salt (for salting cucumber)
1 tbsp. fresh dill or fresh mint, or both
recipes.Procedure:
1. Process the onion in a food processor for 10-15 sec.. Turn out into the center of a tea towel. Gather up the ends and squeeze until almost all of the juice is removed.
2. Return the onion to the food processor and add the lamb, garlic, marjoram, rosemary, salt and pepper and process until it is a fine paste; about 1 min. Stop and scrape down the sides of the bowl as needed.

To cook meat as a loaf:

3. Preheat oven to 325º. Place mixture into a loaf pan, making sure to press into the sides of the pan. Place the loaf pan in a water bath and bake for 60-75 min. or until the mixture reaches 165º-170º. Remove from the oven and drain off any fat. Place the loaf pan on a cooling rack and place a brick wrapped in foil directly onto the surface and allow to sit for 15-20 min until the internal temperature reaches 175º. Slice and serve on pita bread with tzatziki sauce, chopped red onion and tomatoes.

To cook meat on a rotisserie:

3. Form the meat mixture into a loaf shape and place on top of 2 overlapping pieces of plastic wrap that are at least 18 inches long. Roll the mixture in the plastic wrap tightly, making sure to remove any air pockets. Once the meat is completely rolled in the wrap, twist the ends of the plastic wrap until the surface of the wrap is tight. Store in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours or up to overnight, to allow the mixture to firm up. 

Preheat the grill to high. 

Place the meat onto the rotisserie skewer. Place a double-thick piece of aluminum foil folded into a tray directly under the meat to catch any drippings. Cook on high for 15 minutes. Decrease the heat to medium and continue to cook for another 20 to 30 minutes or until the internal temperature of the meat reaches 165 degrees F. Turn off the heat and allow to continue to spin for another 10 to 15 minutes or until the internal temperature reaches 175 degrees. 

Prepare the sauce:
1. Drain the yogurt in a sieve or tea towel over a bowl in the refrigerator for two hours.
2. Peel cucumber and dice. Put in a colander and sprinkle with the salt. Let sit for 30 min. Drain well and wipe dry with a paper towel.
3. In a blender, add cucmber, garlic, lemon juice, dill and/or mint and a few grinds of black pepper. Process until well blended then stir into yogurt. Add salt to taste. Place in refrigerator for at least two hours for flavors to blend..

recipes.Author: Country Living
recipes.Ingredients:
½ cup butter, softened.
1 cup shortening
1 cup dark brown sugar
1 cup granulated sugar
4  eggs
1½ cups buttermilk
1 tsp. vanilla extract
2 cups flour
1 tbsp. cocoa
2 tsp. baking powder
1 tsp. baking soda
1½ tsp. ground cinnamon
½ tsp. ground nutmeg
½ tsp. ground allspice
½ tsp. ground cloves.
1  package cream cheese, or 1 cup whipped cream (optional)
semi-sweet chocolate for topping (optional)
recipes.Procedure: Heat oven to 300º. Line two 9-in. cake pans with parchment paper and lightly butter. Beat butter, shortening and sugars together until smooth. Beat in the eggs, one at a time, until smooth and light. Stir the buttermilk and vanilla together. Sift the flour, cocoa, baking powder, baking soda and spices together in a large bowl. Alternately stir the flour mixture and buttermilk mixture, in thirds, into the beaten butter. Blend well with each addition. Pour bater into pans and bake until the center tests clean; about 60 min. Cool cakes in the pans on a rack for 30 min.; unmold and cool completely before frosting. Frost with cream cheese or whipped cream to which have been added 1 drop red and 5 drops yellow food coloring. Top with shaved chocolate.

recipes.Author: Allrecipes.Com
recipes.Ingredients:
2 tbsp. butter
1  onion, chopped
1  stalk celery, chopped
3 cups chicken broth
8 cups broccoli florets
3 tbsp. butter
3 tbsp. all-purpose flour
2 cups milk
ground black pepper to taste
recipes.Procedure:
1. Melt 2 tbsp butter in a medium sized stock pot, and sauté onion and celery until tender.  Add broccoli and broth, cover and simmer for 10 min.
2. Pour the soup into a blender, filling no more than half full.  Hold down the lid with a kitchen towel, and carefully start the blender, using a few quick pulses to get the soup moving before leaving it on to purée.  Purée in batches until smooth and pour into a clean pot.
3. In a small saucepan, over medium heat, melt 3 tbsp butter; stir in flour and add milk.  Stir until thick and bubbly and add to soup.  Season with pepper and serve.

recipes.Ingredients:
1  large carrot, minced
1  medium onion, minced
2  stalks celery, minced
¼ cup butter
pinch thyme
½  bay leaf
2  lbs.large shrimp
¼ cup brandy
2 cups dry white wine
3  egg yolks
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.Procedure: Put carrot, onion and celery in a pan with the ¼ cup butter, thyme and bay leaf.  Simmer until the vegetables are tender.  Discard bay leaf and season with salt and pepper.  Wash and devein the shrip, but do not remove shells.  Put into a saucepan.  Warm brandy, pour over shrimp and ignite.  When flame dies, add vegetables and wine.  Cover and cook 10 min.  Remove shrimp with a slotted spoon to a rimmed platter and keep warm.  Beat egg yolks with a little of the hot sauce in a cup, then stir into the sauce.  Cook, stirring constantly, over very low heat just until thick.  Do not allow to boil.  Pour over shrimp and serve.

recipes.Blurb: This is most easily made in a food processor.
recipes.Author: Madam Wong
recipes.Ingredients:
½ lb. ground pork
½ tsp. salt
1 tbsp. soy sauce
1 tbsp. sherry
4  water chestnuts, chopped fine
1  scallion, chopped fine
½  egg, beaten
2  leaves bok choy, optional
60  won ton wrappings
oil for deep frying
recipes.Procedure:
1. Combine pork with salt, soy sauce, sherry, water chestnuts,
scallion, beaten egg and bok choy (if using boy choy, blanch it in boiling
water for 1 min.).  Mix well.
2. Put 1 tsp. filling in the center of each wrapping.  Fold wrapping in
half, then fold again lengthwise.  Bring edges together.
3. Dab a little water on one corner, put one corner over the other and
seal together.
4. Heat oil to 400º.  Deep-fry won tons, 10 or 12 at a time for about 3
min.  Drain.  Serve with sweet-sour sauce, or a mixture of soy sauce and
red wine vinegar to taste.

recipes.RecipeName: Greek Chicken And Lemon Soup With Orzo
recipes.Blurb: Serve this with toasted pita or hunks of sesame break
recipes.Author: Williams-Sonoma
recipes.Ingredients:
8 cups chicken stock
¾ cup orzo
1  boneless, skinless chicken breast (about ½ lb.), cut crosswise into slices  ¼" thick
3  eggs
⅓ cup lemon juice
1 tbsp. grated lemon zest
2 tbsp. finely chopped fresh parsley
salt and white pepper
recipes.Procedure:
1. In a large saucepan, bring the stock to a boil over medium heat.  Reduce heat to medium-low, add the orzo (you can use long grain white rice, too) and cook, uncovered, until very tender, about 15-20 min.  About 5 min. before the past is done, add the chicken breast slices.
2. Place eggs in a mixing bowl.  Whisk the eggs while pouring in the lemon juice.  Stir in the zest.  Whisking continuously, slow pour a ladleful of the hot stock into the egg mixture.  Reduce the heat to very low.  Then, while whisking the soup in the pan, slow pour in the egg mixture.  The soup should thicken slightly.
3. Season to taste with salt and pepper.  Remove from the heat, ladle immediately into warmed bowls and garnish with the parsley.

recipes.Author: Williams-Sonoma
recipes.Ingredients:
½ cup unsalted butter
4  large yellow onions, thinly sliced
5 cups beef stock
½ lb. Gruyere or Swiss cheese, shredded
2  bay leaves
salt
freshly ground pepper
4  slices French bread, toasted.
¼ cup each, dry red and white wine (optional)
recipes.Procedure:
1. In a large saucepan, melt the butter over low heat.  Add the onions and sprinkle with taste to salt.  Stir to coat well with the butter.  Cover and cook, stirring occasionally, until very tender, about 20-30 min.
2. Remove the cover, raise the heat slightly, and sauté, stirring frequently, until the onions turn a deep caramel brown; about 1 hour.  Take care not to let them burn.
3. Add the stock, optional wine, and bay leaves, bring to a boil, reduce the heat, cover and simmer about 30 min. more.  Meanwhile, preheat a broiler.
4. Discard the bay leaves.  Taste and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper.  Ladle the soup into heavy heatproof bowls placed on a baking tray.  Spring a little of the cheese into each bowl, then place a slice of toasted bread on top.  Top with more cheese.  Broil until the cheese is bubbly and golden, about 2-3 min.  Serve immediately.

recipes.RecipeName: Peppered Beef Fillet With Bearnaise Sauce
recipes.Author: Food.Com
recipes.Ingredients:
2  lbs.filet of beef (or substitute sirloin tip roast)
1 tbsp. olive oil
2  cloves garlic, crushed
1 tbsp. black peppercorns, crushed
2 tsp. coriander, crushed
For the sauce:
5 oz. butter
3  shallots
½ cup dry white wine
2 tbsp. tarragon vinegar
1 tbsp. fresh tarragon
4  egg yolks
1 tbsp. lemon juice
recipes.Procedure:
1. Preheat oven to 450º. Tie filet up with string to keep its shape. Brush with oil, and rub with garlic.
2. Roll filet in crushed peppercorns and coriander.
3. Place filet on a rack in a baking pan. Roast for 10 min.; reduce heat to 350º. Roast for 20 min. more for medium rare. Let stand, tented with foil, for 10-15 min.
4. Meanwhile, melt butter in saucepan. Carefully pour off clear butter; discard sediment.
5. Place shallots, wine, vinegar and tarragon in a small saucepan; cook rapidly, reducing to 2 tbsp. in volume. Strain and set aside.
6. Place egg yolks in food processor or blender; process for 10 seconds. Add lemon juice; process for 5 seconds.
7. Slowly add melted butter while motor is running. Add seasoning and strained shallot mixture; process for a few seconds more; serve with beef.

recipes.Author: Tatyana's Everyday Food
recipes.Ingredients:
For dough:
1½ cups milk
1 tbsp. dry yeast
½ tsp. sugar
1 tsp. salt
3 tbsp. melted butter
1  egg
3½ cups all-purpose flour
For the filling:
1 lb. ground beef, turkey or pork
½  large onion
3  cloves garlic
1  egg
1½ cups mozarella cheese
1 cup cheddar cheese
1½ tsp. salt
½ tsp. ground black pepper
¼  chopped fresh dill
1  beaten egg, for egg wash
recipes.Procedure:
1.Heat the milk until warm to touch, then pour into a large mixing bowl. Add the sugar and sprinkle the yeast evenly over the milk. Allow the yeast to proof for 5 minutes. After 5 minutes, whisk in the melted butter, salt and egg. Gradually add the flour, whisking the mixture until it thickens into a thick batter. Continue adding flour until soft dough forms. 
2.Turn dough out onto well-floured work surface; use additional flour as needed. Knead the dough for 4 to 5 minutes until smooth and elastic. Return the dough to mixing bowl, cover the bowl with a clean towel and allow the dough to proof until doubled in size; about 45 to 60 minutes. 
3.Meanwhile, prepare the filling. Place the onion and garlic into a food processor and pulse into a puree. In a large bowl combine all of the filling ingredients: pureed onion, garlic, meat, cheeses, egg and seasonings. Use your hands to knead the ingredients together to form a uniform mixture. 
4.Once dough has proofed, punch it down and knead again for a few minutes. Divide the dough into even portions - 8 pieces for large piroshki, 16 pieces for smaller piroshki. Roll each piece of dough into a circle, add filling into the center, then press the dough together to seal the filling inside.
5.Place piroshki seam side up onto baking sheets lined with parchment paper. Brush the tops with an egg wash using a pastry brush. Allow the piroshki to proof for 30 to 45 minutes. Meanwhile, preheat oven to 350°
6.Bake piroshki for 25 to 30 minutes, depending on the size of your piroshki. Remove from baking sheet onto a cooling rack to cool for 15 to 20 minutes before enjoying. The filling will be extremely hot when the piroshki come out of the oven! Allow them to cool before enjoying.

recipes.Ingredients:
½ cup extra virgin olive oil
4  cloves garlic, thinly sliced
Balsamic vinegar
Pinch red pepper flakes
Pinch salt
Freshly ground black pepper
Finely grated Parmesan or Romano cheese
recipes.Procedure:
1. Heat oil in a small saucepan over medium heat.  Add garlic and cook until it is fragrant, but has not changed color; 3-5 min.  Remove from heat and let cool.  Cover and let step 1 hour.  Strain into sterilized dipping bowl.
2. Swirl in a drizzle of balsamic vinegar, decoratively into the center.  Sprinkle with the pepper flakes, salt and ground black pepper, and top with a light coating of cheese.

Serve with hot crusty Italian or French bread.

recipes.Ingredients:
3 cups all-purpose or semolina flour
4  eggs
water, as needed
recipes.Procedure: Put flour in mixing  bowl, or pan of bread maker.  Make a well in the center, and crack the eggs into the well.  Using the dough hook if using a mixer, begin mixing the dough.  If dough fails to come together, add water, a teaspoon at a time, just until dough forms into a ball.  Knead dough for 15-20 min.  Remove dough from pan and wrap tightly in plastic wrap for 10 minutes to rest, or until you are ready to begin making the pasta.

recipes.Author: Aaron Scott
recipes.Ingredients:
1  medium onion, chopped fine
3 tbsp. butter
2  bay leaves
½ cup dry white wiine
¼ tsp. celery seed
⅛ tsp. dill weed
⅛ tsp. cilantro
¼ tsp. oregano
1 tsp. beef bouillon
1 cup warm water
1 tbsp. rice flour
recipes.Procedure:
1. Caramelize the chopped onions in the melted butter, with the whole bay leaves, over medium-low heat, stirring often.
2. Add white wine, reduce heat to low, and allow mixture to reduce by about half.
3.  Add herbs to mixture; mix.  Stir 1 tsp. beef bouillon into 1 cup warm water; add to mixture.  Cover and let simmer about 1 hour.
4. Thicken sauce with 1 tbsp rice flour dissolved in about ½ cup water.  Serve.

recipes.Ingredients:
2  lbs.potatoes (peeled and thinly sliced, about 5 cups)
4 tbsp. melted butter
to taste kosher salt and black pepper
1 cup cheese of your choice (or grated sharp cheddar cheese)
½ cup milk
¼ cup panko bread crumbs (or fresh)
recipes.Procedure:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees.
2. Lightly grease a shallow 1 and 1/2 quart casserole with butter.
3. Arrange sliced potatoes in layers. Sprinkle each layer with melted butter and season with salt and pepper.
4. Add milk. Top evenly with grated cheese and bread crumbs.
5. Cover casserole with foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Uncover and bake for an additional 15 minutes or until the potatoes are tender and the top is golden brown.

recipes.Ingredients:
6  medium potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced
4 tbsp. butter
3 tbsp. flour
1 tsp. salt
¼ tsp. pepper
2½ cups milk
1  small onion, finely chopped
Crumbled, cooked bacon (optional)
recipes.Procedure:
1. Preheat oven to 375ºF.
2. Heat 3 tablespoons of butter in a saucepan over low heat until melted. Blend in flour, salt and pepper. Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until mixture is smooth and bubbly. Gradually stir in milk, 1/2 cup at a time. Heat to boiling. Boil and stir 1 minute.
3. Arrange potatoes in greased 2 quart casserole in 3 layers, topping each layer with part of the chopped onions and 1/3 of the sauce. Dot the top with the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter, broken into little pieces.
4. Cover and bake at 375ºF until potatoes are tender, about 60-70 minutes. If adding crumbled bacon, add during last 15 min.  of cooking.  Let stand 5 to 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.Author: Allrecipes.Com
recipes.Ingredients:
1  4-pound boneless pork loin roast
½ cup Dijon mustard
2 tbsp. packed brown sugar
1½ cups apple juice, divided
1 cup dried apricots, chopped
1 cup pitted prunes, chopped
1 cup red wine
¼ cup packed brown sugar
⅛ tsp. ground cloves
2 tsp. cornstarch
recipes.Procedure:
1. Preheat oven to 325º.
2. Place roast in a shallow roasting pan.  Mix together mustard and 2 tbsp of brown sugar; spread over roast.
3. Roast for 3 hours, basting with ¼ cup of the apple juice every 30 min.  Roast is done when the internal temperature reads 145º.  (Roast must sit for 3 minutes.)
4. During the last hour the roast is cooking, combine the prunes, apricots, red wine, ¼ cup brown sugar, ¾ cup of the juices from the roasting pan, and cloves in a saucepan over medium heat.  Bring to a boil, then cover and simmer for 15 min.  Spoon the fruit around the roast during the last 30 min. of cooking.
5. When the roast is done, place it onto a serving platter and spoon the fruit around it.  Remove ¼ cup of the dripping from the roasting pan and mix with the cornstarch in a small sauce pan.  Cook over medium-high heat, stirring gently until thickened and no longer cloudy; about 5 min.  Transfer to a gravy boat or serving bowl.
6. Slice the roast, and pass the sauce for the guests to serve themselves.

recipes.Author: Aaron Scott
recipes.Ingredients:
2  14-oz. cans white beans, drained and rinsed.
1  small tomato (Roma), diced
1 tsp. dried oregano
1 tsp. dried basil or savory
4  cloves garlic, finely minced
2 tbsp. extra virgin olive oil or canola oil
red wine vinegar
recipes.Procedure: Put beans into a bowl just large enough to contain them.  Sprinkle the herbs over the beans.  Add minced garlic and diced tomatoes and olive oil.  Mix. (If beans will be refrigerated overnight or longer, do not use olive oil, as it will congeal and separate.)  Add red wine vinegar until it covers at least half the beans.  Mix well and refrigerate for at least 1 hour, stirring several times.  These will stay good, uncovered, in the refrigerator for 2-3 days.  The longer the marinating period, the more flavorful the beans.

recipes.Ingredients:
1  whole fryer chicken, cut up
For the dry dip:
1 cup all-purpose flour
½ cup cornstarch
1 tbsp. paprika
2 tsp. onion salt
1 tsp. chili powder
1 tsp. black pepper
½ tsp. celery salt
½ tsp. dried sage
½ tsp. garlic powder
½ tsp. ground allspice
½ tsp. dried oregano
½ tsp. dried basil
½ tsp. dried marjoram
For the batter:
1 cup all-purpose flour
1 tsp. salt
¼ tsp. black pepper
1  egg
beer, milk or water
recipes.Procedure:
1. Brine chicken in a mixture of buttermilk, plus 1 tsp. kosher salt per cup of buttermilk, and 1/4 tsp ground black pepper, for 24-48 hours.  Remove chicken from brine; place on wire rack to drain.
2. In one mixing bowl, mix together 1 cup flour, ½ cup cornstarch, and seasonings.  In a separate bowl, mix together 1 cup flour, salt, black pepper and egg.  Add water, milk or beer until  mixture is runny.
3. Heat oil in a deep fryer or deep skillet to 350º.   If using a skillet, be sure oil comes halfway up the sides of the chicken pieces.  While chicken is still wet from brine, dip in the dry mix.  Shake off excess, and return to wire rack to dry, for 30 minutes.  Dip each piece in the batter.  Let extra batter run off, and dip in the dry mix once more.
4. Place the chicken pieces in the hot oil and fry for 15-18 minutes, or until well browned.  Remove and drain on paper towels before serving.

recipes.Author: Emeril Lagasse
recipes.Ingredients:
1 cup pimento-stuffed olives, plus 2 tbsp. of liquid from the jar.
1 cup chopped pickled Italian vegetables plus 1 tbsp. of liquid from the jar
2 tbsp. drained capers, plus 2 tsp. of liquid from the jar
½ cup pitted, sliced Kalmata olives.
2½ tsp. minced garlic
1  tbsl minced shallot
1 tsp. dried oregano
1 tsp. dried parsley
pinch dried thyme
pinch crushed red pepper
½ cup extra virgin olive oil
1  loaf fresh Italian bread, split
¼ lb. sliced mozarella cheese
6 oz. slicked capocollo or prosciutto
¼ lb. sliced Genoa salami
¼ lb. sliced mortadella
¼ lb. sliced provolone cheese
pepperocini for serving.
recipes.Procedure:
1.  In a medium bowl, stir the pimento-stuffed olives with the chopped Italian vegetables, capers and their respective liquids.  Add the Kalmata olives, garlic, shallot, oregano, parsley, thyme and crushed red pepper.  Stir in the olive oil and let the mixture stand for 1 hour.
2. Slice the Italian bread lengthwise.  Spoon the olive mixture on both sides of the bread and spread evenly.  Arrange the mozzarella slices on the bottom half of the bread and top with the capocollo, Genoa salami and mortadella.  Arrange the provolone chees on the top half of the bread, covering the olive salad completely.  Carefull close the sandwich.  Wrap the sandwich tightly in plastic and let stand for 30 minutes, or up to 2 hours.  Cut the sandwich into 8 pieces and serve pepperocini on the side.

The olive salad may be made ahead and refrigerated up to 2 days.

recipes.Blurb: Best with shells or farfalle. For an interesting variation, use extra-virgin olive oil in place of cream.
recipes.Author: Williams-Sonoma
recipes.Ingredients:
¾ cup heavy cream or extra-virgin olive oil
12  green olives, pitted and finely chopped
4 oz. sun-dried tomatoes (drained if in olive oil) and finely chopped
salt
freshly ground pepper. ¾ cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese
½ tbsp. capers (optional)
recipes.Procedure:
Add your choice of pasta to boiling water. When it is almost cooked, combine the cream or oil, olives, capers if used and tomatoes in a frying pan over very low heat.  Heat until the cream or oil is lukewarm (cream, if used, should be slightly pink).
Drain the pasta as soon as it is al dente,  If using cream, reserve about ¼ cup of the cooking water, and stir into sauce.
Transfer the pasta to a warmed serving dish.  Immediately pour the sauce over the pasta; add salt and pepper to taste and the parmesan cheese.  Toss well and serve at once.

recipes.Blurb: This version has been modified to use canned oysters.
recipes.Author: Williams-Sonoma
recipes.Ingredients:
2 cans oysters, drained and liquor reserved.
6 tbsp. (3/4 stick) unsalted butter
6  green onions, white and light green
portions, chopped
½ cup dry vermouth
2 cups milk
2 cups heavy cream
Coarse salt and freshly ground pepper, to taste
Sweet Hungarian paprika for garnish
2 tbsp. chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley
recipes.Procedure:
Drain oysters and reserve liquor. Set the oyster liquor and oysters aside.

In a large saucepan over medium heat, melt the butter. Add the green onions and sauté until soft, about 3 minutes. Pour in the vermouth and simmer until almost all the liquid has evaporated, about 3 minutes. Stir in the milk, cream and reserved oyster liquor and bring to a simmer, stirring constantly. Add the oysters and cook until they are heated thoroughly, about 3 minutes. Remove from the heat and season with salt.

Ladle the stew into warmed soup bowls and garnish each serving with a grind of pepper and a sprinkle each of paprika and parsley. Serve immediately. Serves 6.

recipes.RecipeName: Roast Duck With Dried Cherry Reduction
recipes.Author: Aaron Scott
recipes.Ingredients:
1  duck, washed and patted dry
1 cup marsala
½ cup dried cherries
1  shallot, chopped fine
thyme
rosemary
orange zest
recipes.Procedure: Soak the cherries in the marsala overnight.  Rub duck with thyme, rosemary and orange zest and roast at 350º until done.  Remove duck and pour off and skim the drippings.  Keep duck warm.  Meanwhile, sauté the shallots in the duck drippings, then add the cherry and wine mixture and reduce.  Pour reduction over duck and serve.

recipes.Ingredients:
2  large tart apples, peeled, cored and chopped
½ cup chopped onion
¼ cup apple cider vinegar
¼ cup brown sugar
1 tbsp. grated orange peel
1 tbsp. grated fresh ginger
½ tsp. ground cinnammon
recipes.Procedure:
1. Add all ingredients to a medium saucepan and stir to combine.
2. Heat on high until mixture comes to a boil.  Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer for about 40 min.
3. Uncover and simmer off excess liquid.  Remove from heat and let cool.  Cover and refrigerate for up to 2 weeks.

recipes.Ingredients:
1 tbsp. butter
½ cup sliced mushrooms
2 tbsp. chopped shallots
2 cups demi-glace
2 tbsp. sherry
lemon juice to taste
recipes.Procedure:
1. In a heavy-bottomed saucepan, heat the butter over medium heat until it is frothy.  Add the mushrooms and shallots and sauté until the mushrooms are soft and the shallots are translucent; about 5 min.
2. Add the demi-glace, bring to a boil, then lower heat to reduce the sauce, cooking at a simmmer for about 10 min.
3.  Stir in the sherry, season to taste with lemon juice and serve immediately.

recipes.Blurb: This is a twice-reduced sauce base, which may be used as is, or as the base of another sauce.
recipes.Author: Thespruceeats.Com
recipes.Ingredients:
½ tsp. dried thyme
3  fresh parsley stems
7  whole black peppercorns
2 cups Espagnole sauce
2 cups beef or chicken stock
1  bay leaf
recipes.Procedure:
1. Wrap the thyme, parsley and peppercorns in a piece of cheesecloth; tie with twine to make a small bundle.
2. Combine the Espagnole and the stock in a saucepan.  Bring to a boil over medium-high heat, then lower heat to simmer.
3.  Add the cheesecloth bundle, and reduce the liquid until the volume has reduced by half.
4. Remove pan from heat and remove the sachet.  Carefully pour liquid through a fine-mesh strainer lined with a piece of cheesecloth.  Season and serve as is, or use to make another sauce.

recipes.Blurb: This is a basic sauce used as is, or as the basis for other sauces.
recipes.Author: Thespruceeats.Com
recipes.Ingredients:
1  bay leaf
½ tsp. dried thyme
3  fresh parsley stems
7  whole black peppercorns
1  ounce clarified butter
1 cup mirapoix, made of: (
½ cup onions, diced
¼ cup carrots, diced
¼ cup celery, diced)
1 oz. all-purpose flour
3 cups beef or chicken stock
2 tbsp. tomato purée.
recipes.Procedure:
1.  Place thyme, parsely and peppercorns in a bit of cheesecloth and tie with twine.
2. Melt butter in a saucepan until it becomes frothy.  Add the mirapoix and sauté for a few minutes until it is lightly browned.
3.  With a wooden spoon, stir the flour into the mirapoix until it is fully incorporated and forms a thick paste (roux).
4. Lower the heat and cook the roux for about 5 min. until it just starts to brown.
5. Using a whisk, add the stock and tomato purée to the roux, whisking vigorously to be sure it's free of lumps.
6.  Bring to a boil, add the sachet and simmer until the volume is reduced by one-third, stirring frequently.
7.  Remove the sachet, and pour the sauce through a fine wire mesh sieve lined with cheesecloth.

recipes.Author: Taste Of Home
recipes.Ingredients:
1  package (8 ounces) cream cheese, softened
1 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese
½ cup crumbled blue cheese
1 tbsp. butter
1½ tsp. curry powder
½ cup finely chopped pecans
2 tbsp. minced fresh parsley
Assorted crackers
recipes.Procedure:
1. Beat cream cheese until smooth. Fold in cheddar and blue cheeses. Refrigerate, covered, at least 2 hours.
2. In a small skillet, heat butter over medium heat. Add curry powder; saute 1-2 minutes. Stir in pecans; cook and stir 1 minute. Stir in parsley. Cool slightly. Roll cheese mixture into two logs, each about 5 in. long. Roll in pecan mixture; refrigerate. Serve with crackers.

recipes.Blurb: This is a basic seasoning for French cooking.  It may be made in any amount: just use half as much celery and carrot as onion.
recipes.Ingredients:
1 cup onion, diced
½ cup celery, diced
½ cup carrot, diced
recipes.Procedure: Chop onion, carrot and celery and mix together.  May be made ahead and frozen.

recipes.Blurb: This recipe is easily doubled, tripled, or made as big as you'd like.
recipes.Ingredients:
¼ cup instant potatoes
About 2 cups all-purpose flour
1  egg
recipes.Procedure:
1. Prepare the instant potatoes according to package directions.  Add egg and about 1 cup flour and mix together.  Continue adding flour and mixing until the dough holds together.  Place on a floured surface and knead additional flour into it until it retains just a bit of stickiness.  Do not overwork the dough by using a machine to blend.  Test the dough by pinching off a piece and placing in a pan of boiling water until it rises to the surface, then cook for 30 seconds more.  Remove and taste: it should be firm, but not tough. If it’s too soft, continue adding flour a bit at a time and kneading it into the dough. 
2. On a well-floured surface, take a portion of the dough and roll it into a rope about ¾ in. in diameter.  Cut rope into pieces about ¾ in. long.  Holding a fork tines down with one hand, take each piece with the other hand and roll it over the tines of the fork.  The result should have a finger-indentation on one side, and be grooved on the other.  Place on a baking sheet floured or lined with parchment.  Do not let the pieces touch.  Repeat with the remainder of the dough.  Dust with flour and refrigerate for at least 3 hours, or freeze.  If frozen, do not thaw before cooking. 
3.  Cook gnocchi by dropping a few at a time into boiling water.  When they rise to the surface, cook an additional 30 seconds.  Remove with a slotted spoon; drain thoroughly.  Serve with your selected sauce, such as Neapolitan Ragù, Sausage Ragù or Fresh Tomato Sauce.

recipes.Author: Michele Scicolone
recipes.Ingredients:
4  lbs.Roma tomaotes, peeled, seeded and chopped
1  medium carrot, chopped
1  medium onion, chopped
1  small rib celery, chopped
salt
6  fresh basil leaves, torn into pieces
¼ cup extra-virgin olive oil
recipes.Procedure:
1. In a large saucepan, combine tomaotes, carrot, onion and celery, a pinch of salt and basil.  Cover and cook over medium  heat until the mixture comes to a simmer.  Uncover and cook, stirring occasionally, until the sauce is thickened, about 20 min.
2. Let sauce cool slightly.  Purée in a food processor or blender.  Reheat gently and taste for seasoning.  Stir in the oil.  Serve hot.  Can be made ahead and stored in a sealed container in the refrigerator for up to 5 days, or in the freezer up to 2 months.

recipes.Author: Michele Scicolone
recipes.Ingredients:
1 lb. Italian sausage
2 tbsp. olive oil
2  cloves garlic, finely chopped
½ cup dry white wine
2  lbs.Roma tomatoes, peeled, seeded and chopped.
salt
freshly ground pepper
3  basil leaves, torn into bits
recipes.Procedure:
1.  Remove sausage from casings and chop finely.
2.  In a large pot, heat oil over medium heat.  Add sausage and garlic.  Cook, stirring frequently, until the sausage is slightly browned, about 10  min.  Add wine and bring to a simmer.  Cook until most of the wine has evaporated.
3.  Stir in the tomatoes and salt to taste.  Bring to a simmer.  Reduce heat to low.  Cook, stirring occasionally, until the sauce is thickened, about 90 min.  Stir in the basil just before serving.  Serve hot.

recipes.Author: Epicuriious.Com
recipes.Ingredients:
1 tbsp. extra-virgin olive oil
½ cup chopped onion
3  cloves garlic, crushed
1 tbsp. finely chopped shallot
1 tsp. tomato paste
½ tsp. black pepper
½ tsp. ground cumin
¼ tsp. hot red pepper flakes
¾ tsp. salt
½ cup coarsely chopped red bell pepper
1  Roma tomato, coarsely chopped
¼ cup dry red wine
1½ tbsp. apple cider vinegar
2 tbsp. sugar
½ tsp. Dijon mustard
1½ cups sweet cherries, quartered and pitted
recipes.Procedure:
1. Heat oil in saucepan over moderate heat until hot but not smoking, then cook onion, garlic and shallot, stirring occasionally, until golden, about 7 min.
2. Add tomato paste, black pepper, cumin, hot pepper flakes, and ¼ tsp salt and cook, stirring, 30 seconds.  Add bell pepper and tomato and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 5 min.
3. Stir in wine, vinegar to taste and sugar and simmer 1 min.  Stir in mustard, cherries and remaining ½ tsp salt and simmer 1 min.
4. Purée mixture in blender until very smooth.  Force through a fine-mesh sieve into a bowl.

recipes.Blurb: This is a shortcut version of Peking Duck
recipes.Author: Allrecipes.Com
recipes.Ingredients:
1  4- lb. duck
½ tsp. ground cinnamon
½ tsp. ground ginger
¼ tsp. ground nutmeg
¼ tsp. ground white pepper
⅛ tsp. ground cloves
3 tbsp. soy sauce
1 tbsp. honey
1  orange, sliced in rounds
1 tbsp. chopped fresh parsely for garnish
5  green onions
recipes.Procedure:
1.  Rinse duck inside and out and pat dry.  Cut off tail and discard.  In a small bowl, mix together the cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg, white pepper and cloves.  Sprinkle one tsp of the mixture into the cavity of the duck.  Stir one tbsp of the soy sauce into the remaining spice mixture and rub evenly over the entire outside of the duck.  Cut one of the green onions in half and tuck inside the cavity.  Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or overnight.
2.  Place duck, breast-side up, on a rack in a big wok or pot and steam for an hour, adding water as necessary.  Remove duck with two large spoons and drain juices and green onion.
3.  Preheat oven to 375º.  Place duck breast-side up in a roasting pan and prick skin all over with fork.
4.  Roast for 30 min.  While duck is roasting, mix the remaining 2 tbsp of soy sauce and honey.  After 30 min., brush the honey mixture onto the duck and return it to the oven.  Raise temperature to 500º.  Roast for 5 min. or until the skin is richly browned.  To not allow the skin to char.
5.  Place duck onto a serving platter and garnish with orange slices and fresh parsely.  Serve with a fruit sauce for dipping, such as plum sauce or sweet cherry sauce.

recipes.Author: Wisebread.Com
recipes.Ingredients:
¼ cup instant potatoes
1  egg
¼ tsp. salt
¼ cup ricotta cheese
2 tsp. butter, clarified
¼ cup Roman cheese
About 1 ½ cups all-purpose flour
recipes.Procedure:
1.  Prepare instant potatoes according to package instructions.
2.  Combine potato with egg and salt and whip until fluffy.
3.  Add ricotta cheese, butter, Romano cheese and about ½ cup flour.   Continue adding flour and mixing until the dough holds together.  Place on a floured surface and knead additional flour into it until it retains just a bit of stickiness.  Do not overwork the dough by using a machine to blend.  Test the dough by pinching off a piece and placing in a pan of boiling water until it rises to the surface, then cook for 30 seconds more.  Remove and taste: it should be firm, but not tough. If it’s too soft, continue adding flour a bit at a time and kneading it into the dough. 
4. On a well-floured surface, take a portion of the dough and roll it into a rope about ¾ in. in diameter.  Cut rope into pieces about ¾ in. long.  Holding a fork tines down with one hand, take each piece with the other hand and roll it over the tines of the fork.  The result should have a finger-indentation on one side, and be grooved on the other.  Place on a baking sheet floured or lined with parchment.  Do not let the pieces touch.  Repeat with the remainder of the dough.  Dust with flour and refrigerate for at least 3 hours, or freeze.  If frozen, do not thaw before cooking. 
5.  Cook gnocchi by dropping a few at a time into boiling water.  When they rise to the surface, cook an additional 30 seconds.  Remove with a slotted spoon; drain thoroughly.  Serve with your selected sauce

recipes.Blurb: This is a "from scratch" version of The Cake.  One can never find a full-sized cake mix any more, and from scratch is better, anyway.
recipes.Author: Aaron Scott
recipes.Ingredients:
2 cups plus 3 tbsp. all-purpose flour.
5 tbsp. cornstarch
1½ tsp. baking powder
½ tsp. baking soda
1¼ cups sugar
¾ cup butter, softened
1 tsp. vanilla
4  eggs
¾ cup buttermilk
1 pkg. vanilla instant pudding
¾ cup salad oil
¾ cup sherry
1 tsp. nutmeg, ground
recipes.Procedure:
1. Preheat oven to 300º.  Mix flour, cornstarch, baking powder and baking soda in a bowl.
2.  In mixer on low speed, cream together the sugar and butter.
3.  Beat in vanilla and eggs.
4.  Add dry ingredients and buttermilk, oil, sherry and nutmeg.  Mix thoroughly on low speed.
5.  Spread batter evenly into two greased and floured cake pans.
6.  Bake for 50 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.

recipes.Author: Aaron Scott
recipes.Ingredients:
For the cupcakes:
1 tsp. lemon extract
1  batch batter for The Cake II (*See Procedure)
For the lemon custard:
3  eggs
6 tbsp. sugar
6 tbsp. lemon juice
1 tsp. lemon extract (optional)
5 tbsp. butter
Lemon rum glaze
recipes.Procedure:
1.  Preheat oven to 300°.  Prepare batter for The Cake II, substituting 1 tsp of lemon extract for the vanilla extract.  Pour the batter into lined 2 lined cupcake pans.  Bake for 50 min. or until a toothpick inserted into a cupcake comes out clean.  Cool on wire racks.
2.  Prepare lemon custard.  In a 1-qt saucepan over medium heat or in the top of a double boiler over simmering water, whisk eggs with sugar until yellow.  Beat in lemon juice, lemon extract and butter.  Cook mixture, stirring constantly, with a spatula until thick enough to coat the spatula.  Do not boil, or the mixture will curdle.  Pour into bowl; cover surface directly with plastic and refrigerate until cold.
3.  Using a pastry injector, fill each cupcake with a shot of the lemon custard.
4. Top cupcakes with lemon rum glaze.

recipes.Author: Allrecipes.Com
recipes.Ingredients:
1 tbsp. soy sauce
1 tbsp. olive oil
1 tbsp. lemon juice
2 tsp. Worcestershire sauce
¼ tsp. garlic powder
1 tsp. dried basil
½ tsp. dried parsley flakes
¼ tsp. ground white pepper
¼ tsp. hot pepper sauce (optional)
recipes.Procedure: Mix ingredients in blender; pour over steak in a shallow bowl and let sit up to 8 hours.  Pricking the steak will help the meat absorb the flavors.  This recipe will marinate two typical steaks.

recipes.Author: William-Sonoma
recipes.Ingredients:
¼ cup kosher salt
2 tbsp. freshly ground pepper
Zest of 1 lemon
1 tbsp. paprika
1½ tsp. garlic powder
1½ tsp. fresh oregano leaves, minced
1½ tsp. piment d'Espelette (substitue Ancho pepper if desired)
½ tsp. ground allspice
¾ tsp. celery seed
1½ tsp. toasted and ground coriander
1½ tsp. toasted and ground fennel seed (may substitute cumin or dill seed in equal amount)
recipes.Procedure: Mix ingredients and store in sealed jar.

recipes.Blurb: Do not substitute breasts for thighs. They just will not add that sticky goodness to the braising liquid that the thighs will.
recipes.Author: Allrecipes.Com
recipes.Ingredients:
6  bone-in, skin-on chicken thighs
1  pinch kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste
8  ounces bacon, sliced crosswise into ½-inch pieces
10  large button mushrooms, quartered
½  large yellow onion, diced
2  shallots, sliced
2 tsp. all-purpose flour
2 tsp. butter
1½ cups red wine
6  sprigs fresh thyme
1 cup chicken broth
recipes.Procedure:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). 
2. Season chicken thighs all over with salt and black pepper. 
3. Place bacon in a large, oven-proof skillet and cook over medium-high heat, turning occasionally, until evenly browned, about 10 minutes. Transfer bacon with a slotted spoon to a paper-towel lined plate, leaving drippings in the skillet. 
4. Increase heat to high and place chicken, skin-side down, into skillet. Cook in hot skillet until browned, 2 to 4 minutes per side. Transfer chicken to a plate; drain and discard all but 1 tablespoon drippings from the skillet. 
5. Lower heat to medium-high; saute mushrooms, onion, and shallots with a pinch of salt in the hot skillet until golden and caramelized, 7 to 12 minutes. 
6. Stir flour and butter into vegetable mixture until completely incorporated, about 1 minute. 
7. Pour red wine into the skillet and bring to a boil while scraping browned bits of food off of the bottom of the pan with a wooden spoon. Stir bacon and thyme into red wine mixture; simmer until wine is about 1/3 reduced, 3 to 5 minutes. Pour chicken broth into wine mixture and set chicken thighs into skillet; bring wine and stock to a simmer. 
8. Cook chicken in the preheated oven for 30 minutes. Spoon pan juices over the chicken and continue cooking until no longer pink at the bone and the juices run clear, about 30 minutes more. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the thickest part of the thigh, near the bone should read 165 degrees F (74 degrees C). Transfer chicken to a platter. 
9. Place skillet over high heat and reduce pan juices, skimming fat off the top as necessary, until sauce thickens slightly, about 5 minutes. Season with salt and pepper; remove and discard thyme. Pour sauce over chicken.

recipes.Author: Jessica Wood
recipes.Ingredients:
2½ lb. Chuck Roast
1 tbsp. Kosher Salt
½ tbsp. Black Pepper
1 tbsp. Garlic Powder
1 tsp. Ground Coriander
1 tbsp. Ancho Chili Powder
½ tbsp. Dried Oregano
2  Onions, peeled and quartered
6  Garlic Cloves, peeled
14½ oz. can Diced Tomatoes
4½ oz. Can Chopped Green Chilies
1  Lime
1 cup Beef Stock
19 oz. Can Red Enchilada Sauce
15  Corn Tortillas
1½ cup Shredded Mexican Cheese (more to taste)
recipes.Procedure:
1.The night before: Prepare rub by mixing salt, pepper, garlic powder, ground coriander, ancho chili powder, and dried oregano in a bowl. Coat roast thoroughly with rub and reserve any remaining rub. Cover and store in fridge overnight.
2.Day of: Preheat oven to 300. Heat olive oil in a large dutch oven or oven-safe pot. Once oil is simmering, sear roast on each side 1-2 minutes or until dark crust begins to form. Remove roast from pot.
3.To dutch oven, add quartered onions and let sear for 1-2 minutes or until onions start to brown. Add garlic cloves, green chilies, diced tomatoes, and all remaining rub. Stir together and add juice of one lime and the lime halves.
4.Return roast to dutch oven and cover about halfway with beef stock.  Bring liquid in pot to a boil then cover pot with lid and place in oven. Cook with lid on for 5-6 hours, turning roast and stirring pot liquids once about halfway through cooking time.
5.Once beef is so tender that you can shred it with a fork, remove from pot and shred using two forks, discarding any fatty pieces. At this point, you can discard the liquid in the pot. However, if you want to shred the beef to be used for this recipe a few days later, I recommend storing shredded beef in covered container with some of the liquid from the dutch oven so it will stay moist.
6.Make the enchiladas: Preheat oven to 375.
7.Spray a 9x13 baking dish with cooking spray. Pour some enchilada sauce in the bottom, just enough to cover the dish.
9.In corn tortilla, place shredded beef and a pinch of cheese on one side of tortilla. Roll tightly and place seam side down in dish. Repeat with remaining tortillas
10.Cover enchiladas with remaining sauce and sprinkle with cheese.
11.Cover dish with foil and bake at 375 for 30 minutes. Remove foil and bake an additional 10 minutes.  Serve immediately.

recipes.Author: Adapted From Nagi
recipes.Ingredients:
1 tbsp. cornstarch
700  tomato passata (1 bottle) or 2-6 oz. cans tomato paste and 12 oz. water
1½ cups chicken broth
1 tbsp. dried oregano
2 tsp. cumin
2 tsp. paprika
1 tsp. garlic powder
1 tsp. onion powder
1 tsp. cilantro
1 tsp. cayenne
1 tbsp. brown sugar
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.Procedure:
1. In a small saucepan, add chicken broth and cornstarch. Whisk until cornstarch is all dissolved.
2. Add remaining ingredients except salt and pepper, whisk, bring to boil over medium heat, then reduce to simmer.
3. Simmer for 10 minutes or so, until thickened, whisking occasionally.
4. Season with salt and pepper.

recipes.Author: Nagi
recipes.Ingredients:
1 tsp. garlic powder
1 tsp. onion powder
1 tsp. dried oregano
2 tsp. cumin powder
2 tsp. paprika
1 tsp. ground ancho chili pepper
1 tsp. cornstarch
¼ tsp. cayenne pepper (adjust spiciness to taste)
1 tsp. salt
¼ tsp. black pepper
recipes.Procedure: This recipe does not use chili powder, which is a blend of spices, as that makes the taste subject to the variety of chili powder used.  Making the recipe from scratch gives it a reliability not otherwise possible.

recipes.Author: Allrecipes.Com
recipes.Ingredients:
3 lbs. skinless, boneless chicken breast halves
3 tbsp. lemon juice
2 tbsp. honey
1 tbsp. olive oil
3  cloves garlic, minced
2 tsp. dried oregano
recipes.Procedure:
1. Preheat oven to 375°.  Grease a 9x13-inch baking dish.
2. Place chicken breast halves into prepared baking dish. Whisk lemon juice, honey, olive oil, garlic, and oregano together in a bowl and pour the mixture over chicken breasts. 
3. Bake in the preheated oven until chicken is no longer pink inside, the juices run clear, and an instant-read meat thermometer inserted into the thickest part of a breast reads 180°, about 45 minutes. Baste chicken with pan juices every 15 minutes while baking.

recipes.Author: Tasteofhome.Cm
recipes.Ingredients:
4 tbsp. canola oil, divided
2 tbsp. lemon juice
1½ tsp. seasoned salt
1½ tsp. dried oregano
1½ tsp. ground cumin
1 tsp. garlic powder
½ tsp. chili powder
½ tsp. paprika
½ tsp. crushed red pepper flakes, optional
1½  lbs.boneless skinless chicken breast, cut into thin strips
½  medium sweet red pepper, julienned
½  medium green pepper, julienned
4  green onions, thinly sliced
½ cup chopped onion
6  flour tortillas (8 inches), warmed
Shredded cheddar cheese, taco sauce, salsa, guacamole and sour cream, optional
recipes.Procedure:
1. In a large bowl, combine 2 tablespoons oil, lemon juice and seasonings; add the chicken. Turn to coat; cover. Refrigerate for 1-4 hours. 
2. In a large skillet, saute peppers and onions in remaining oil until crisp-tender. Remove and keep warm. 
3. Drain chicken, discarding marinade. In the same skillet, cook chicken over medium-high heat for 5-6 minutes or until no longer pink. Return pepper mixture to pan; heat through. 
4. Spoon filling down the center of tortillas; fold in half. Serve with toppings as desired.

recipes.Blurb: This recipe makes two crusts
recipes.Ingredients:
1⅛ cups hot water
1 tbsp. plus 2 tsp. lard or shortening
1¼ tsp. powdered milk
1¼ tsp. salt
1¼ tsp. sugar
1¼ tsp. diastatic malt powder
¾ tsp. active dry yeast
⅛ tsp. baking soda
3 cups all-purpose flour
Cornmeal for dusting
recipes.Procedure:
1. In a standing mixer, combine the hot water and lard. Stir until the lard is dissolved. Add the powdered milk, salt, sugar, malt powder, dry yeast and baking soda. Add the flour. Mix until the dough just begins to form. It will look dry. Do not mix the dough until it's soft and elastic as you would for bread dough.
2. Turn dough out into a greased bowl, turn to coat and let rise, uncovered, overnight.
3. Punch down, turn out and cut into two pieces.
4. Heat the oven to the hottest setting. Put pan or pizza stone in the oven to heat. Roll out each dough piece until 1/8 inch thick. Fold the dough over and re-roll two more times. Shape the dough rounds to match the desired pan or pizza stone.
5. Pierce the dough rounds with a fork in numerous places to avoid bubbles. Spread on tomato sauce, grated cheese and desired toppings. Sprinkle pan or stone with cornmeal to prevent sticking. Load up and bake on the pre-heated pizza stone. Bake pizza until crust is browned and cheese is bubbling.

recipes.Ingredients:
4½ oz. hot water
2½ tsp. lard or shortening
⅝ tsp. powdered milk
⅝ tsp. salt
⅝ tsp. sugar
⅝ tsp. diastatic malt powder
⅜ tsp. active dry yeast
Pinch baking soda
1½ cups all-purpose flour
Cornmeal for dusting
recipes.Procedure:
1. In a standing mixer, combine the hot water and lard. Stir until the lard is dissolved. Add the powdered milk, salt, sugar, malt powder, dry yeast and baking soda. Add the flour. Mix until the dough just begins to form. It will look dry. Do not mix the dough until it's soft and elastic as you would for bread dough.
2. Turn dough out into a greased bowl, turn to coat and let rise, uncovered, overnight.
3. Punch down and, turn out on floured surface.
4. Heat the oven to the hottest setting. Put pan or pizza stone in the oven to heat. Roll out each dough piece until 1/8 inch thick. Fold the dough over and re-roll two more times. Shape the dough rounds to match the desired pan or pizza stone.
5. Pierce the dough rounds with a fork in numerous places to avoid bubbles. Spread on tomato sauce, grated cheese and desired toppings. Sprinkle pan or stone with cornmeal to prevent sticking. Load up and bake on the pre-heated pizza stone. Bake pizza until crust is browned and cheese is bubbling.

recipes.Blurb: This is a sauce made from the same ingredients as Penzey's Pizza Seasoning.  I've estimated the amounts.
recipes.Author: Aaron Scott
recipes.Ingredients:
1  8-oz can tomato sauce
½ tsp. salt
⅜ tsp. fennel seed, ground
⅜ tsp. dried oregano, ground
¼ tsp. sugar
⅛ tsp. garlic powder
⅛ tsp. ground black pepper
⅛ tsp. dried basil, ground
⅛ tsp. onion powder
⅛ tsp. ancho chili powder
small pinch cayenne pepper
recipes.Procedure:
1 In a small saucepan, add tomato sauce and all ingredients.  Stir to blend.
2. Bring to slow simmer. Simmer for 15-60 minutes to allow flavors to blend together. (Simmer the longer time, depending on how thick you want the sauce).

recipes.Author: Taste Of Home
recipes.Ingredients:
4  ounces uncooked fettuccine
1 tbsp. olive oil
½  medium sweet red pepper, julienned
1  garlic clove, minced
½ tsp. grated lemon zest
¼ tsp. crushed red pepper flakes
½ cup reduced-sodium chicken broth
¼ cup white wine or additional broth
1 tbsp. lemon juice
6  sea scallops (about  ¾ pound)
2 tsp. grated Parmesan cheese
recipes.Procedure:
1. Cook fettuccine according to package directions; drain.
2. Meanwhile, in a large skillet, heat oil over medium-high heat. Add red pepper, garlic, lemon zest and pepper flakes; cook and stir 2 minutes. Stir in broth, wine and lemon juice. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat; simmer, uncovered, 5-6 minutes or until liquid is reduced by half.
3. Cut each scallop horizontally in half; add to skillet. Cook, covered, 4-5 minutes or until scallops are firm and opaque, stirring occasionally. Serve with fettuccine. Sprinkle with cheese.

recipes.RecipeName: Penne With Tomato And White Beans
recipes.Author: Taste Of Home
recipes.Ingredients:
8  ounces uncooked penne pasta
2 tbsp. olive oil
1  garlic clove, minced
2 cans (14½ ounces each) Italian diced tomatoes, undrained
1 can (15 ounces) cannellini beans, rinsed and drained
1  package (10 ounces) fresh spinach, trimmed
¼ cup sliced ripe olives
½ tsp. salt
¼ tsp. pepper
½ cup grated Parmesan cheese
recipes.Procedure:
Cook pasta according to package directions. Meanwhile, in a large skillet, heat oil over medium-high heat. Add garlic; cook and stir 1 minute. Add tomatoes and beans. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat; simmer, uncovered, 5-7 minutes to allow flavors to blend.
Add spinach, olives, salt and pepper; cook and stir over medium heat until spinach is wilted. Drain pasta; top with tomato mixture and cheese.

recipes.Author: Taste of Home
recipes.Ingredients:
1 cup uncooked whole wheat orzo pasta
1 tbsp. olive oil
¼ cup grated Parmesan cheese
2 tbsp. minced fresh parsley
½ tsp. grated lemon zest
¼ tsp. salt
¼ tsp. pepper
recipes.Procedure: Cook orzo according to package directions; drain. Transfer to a small bowl; drizzle with oil. Stir in remaining ingredients.

recipes.Author: Taste of Home
recipes.Ingredients:
1  package (16 ounces) penne pasta
3 tbsp. butter
2  garlic cloves, minced
4  ounces thinly sliced prosciutto, cut into strips
1 can (28 ounces) whole plum tomatoes, drained and chopped
¼ cup vodka
½ tsp. salt
½ tsp. crushed red pepper flakes
½ cup heavy whipping cream
½ cup shredded Parmesan cheese
recipes.Procedure:
Cook pasta according to package directions.
Meanwhile, in a large skillet, heat butter over medium-high heat. Add garlic; cook and stir 1 minute. Add prosciutto; cook 2 minutes longer. Stir in tomatoes, vodka, salt and pepper flakes. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat; simmer, uncovered, 5 minutes. Stir in cream; cook 2-3 minutes longer, stirring occasionally.
Drain pasta. Add pasta and cheese to sauce; toss to combine.

recipes.Author: Taste Of Home
recipes.Ingredients:
1 tbsp. olive oil
5  garlic cloves, minced
1 can (14½ ounces) Italian diced tomatoes, undrained
1 can (14½ ounces) diced tomatoes with garlic and onion, undrained
1 can (6 ounces) tomato paste
½ cup water
2 tbsp. sugar
½ tsp. salt
GNOCCHI:
1  carton (15 ounces) whole-milk ricotta cheese
2  eggs, lightly beaten
1 cup grated Parmesan cheese
2 tsp. garlic powder
1 tsp. salt
½ tsp. pepper
2  to 2½ cups all-purpose flour
½ lb. fresh mozzarella cheese, cubed
Minced fresh basil, optional
recipes.Procedure:
